title: Magazijnmedewerker
description:
Ben jij iemand die graag de handen uit de mouwen steekt en het leuk vindt om in een hecht team te werken? Zorg jij ervoor dat alles in het magazijn op rolletjes loopt en dat onze monteurs met de juiste materialen op pad kunnen? Dan is deze baan bij Circet in Hedel precies wat je zoekt!

Als Magazijnmedewerker ben jij een onmisbare schakel binnen onze organisatie. Jij zorgt dat bestellingen klaarstaan voor onze monteurs, controleert inkomende goederen en houdt het magazijn netjes en overzichtelijk. Dankzij jouw inzet kunnen onze monteurs hun werk goed doen en onze klanten de beste service bieden.

Een greep uit jouw taken:

  • Je bent de belangrijkste factor in het werkende leven van onze monteurs: JIJ zorgt er voor dat zij de juiste producten hebben om hun werk goed te kunnen doen.

  • Vanuit jouw rol hou je je dus bezig met orderpicken en zet je bestellingen klaar voor collega’s in de buitendienst.

  • Wij zijn goed gedigitaliseerd dus alles werkt met scanners. Je bent handig met computers en het systeem Dynamics 365.

  • Daarnaast controleer je de producten die binnenkomen in het magazijn op hoeveelheid, de kwaliteit en de verpakking en beheer en keur je het gereedschap

  • Je bent samen met je team verantwoordelijk voor een schone, opgeruimde en gestructureerde werkomgeving.

Dit krijg je van ons:

  • Een superleuke werkplek met een team van jonge enthousiaste collega’s in Hedel. Bestaande uit 3 dames in de logistiek en 3 chauffeurs, waarmee je dagelijks samenwerkt.

  • Een functie voor 40 uur per week.

  • Vaste werktijden tussen 07:00 – 17:00.

  • Een salaris dat past bij jouw ervaring, met groeimogelijkheden tijdens je tijd bij Circet. Circet heeft een goed cao (Metaal & Techniek - Technisch Installatiebedrijf) met bijhorend pensioen.

  • Naast jouw vaste salaris is er een jaarlijkse bonus die gebaseerd is op een vooraf vastgestelde jaarlijkse doelstelling.

  • 8% vakantiegeld, wat we in mei uitbetalen.

  • Je krijgt lekker veel vrije dagen: 25 vakantiedagen + 13 Adv-dagen, samen 38 dagen per jaar (als je fulltime werkt). De mogelijkheid om maximaal 10 vrije dagen in te ruilen voor een hoger brutosalaris.

Wat jij meebrengt

  • Je hebt mbo werk- en denkniveau.

  • Natuurlijk ben je communicatief sterk, zelfstandig en staat stevig in je schoenen.

  • Daarnaast heb je affiniteit met techniek en logistiek.

  • Uiteraard ben je ervaren in order picken met behulp van scanapparatuur.

  • Ook ben je nauwkeurig en houd je van aanpakken.

  • Je bent bij voorkeur bekend met de werkzaamheden binnen het magazijn.

  • Heb je een vca-certificaat? Dan heb je zeker al een streepje voor, anders kun je deze via ons behalen.

  • Je bent in bezit van een reachtruck certificaat, of bent bereid om deze te halen.

  • Met jouw team houd je ons magazijn tiptop in orde. Je zet je keihard in om het magazijn opgeruimd en gestructureerd te houden voor een goede workflow.

Wie is Circet

Facetimen met je familie, razendsnel internetten, je elektrische auto opladen, een avondje Netflix: allemaal mogelijk dankzij ons werk bij Circet. Wat we dan precies doen? We leggen supersnelle glasvezelnetwerken aan, zetten het mobiele netwerk om naar 5G, installeren digitale meters en laadpalen en upgraden het elektriciteitsnet. Bouwen aan de vitale infrastructuur van de toekomst, noemen wij dat.

Daarbij kunnen we jou goed gebruiken. We zijn wereldwijd een van de snelst groeiende organisaties in ons vakgebied. Dat komt omdat we experts zijn in wat we doen, maar vooral omdat we er samen helemaal voor gaan.

Solliciteren

Enthousiast geworden na het lezen van deze uitdaging? Solliciteer dan direct.

The Dutch language is mandatory for this job

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our diverse and rapidly growing team in Montreal. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, maintaining the data transformation layer and building dimensional models that will feed BI tools. The objective for the role is to facilitate reporting and analytics for technical and non-technical users alike. We are looking for big picture thinkers with strong communication skills and a track record of independent problem-solving. We value creativity and innovation, hard work and on-the-job excellence. The ideal candidate is someone who is highly motivated and who seeks to take on a challenging role.

What you’ll do

  • Design and develop complex data models and transformations that standardize data definitions and promote data democratization
  • Lead discussions with technical and non-technical stakeholders in order to understand business objectives and document requirements.
  • Work with our engineering team to understand what data is captured by our ELT pipelines, where, and how.
  • Produce detailed documentation describing the data models and the jobs that generate them
  • Build and own analytics infrastructure that delivers good quality data, reliably

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience writing production-grade SQL as an analytics engineer, data engineer, data analyst, or related role.
  • 2+ years hands‑on experience with dbt (models, tests, macros) in production.
  • Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts (ETL/ELT, data marts), and data modeling techniques (dimensional modeling, one big tables, etc.).
  • Familiarity with data warehouses such as Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks.
  • Experience with version control (Git), DevOps practices, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to generate technical requirements from a set of non-technical stakeholder interviews.
  • Strong attention to detail, with a focus on data accuracy, quality, and integrity.
  • Some experience with common BI tools are an asset (e.g. Power BI, Tableau, Looker).

Additional Assets

  • Demonstrate a strong intuition for data product design
  • Experience working with an orchestrator (Airflow, Dagster, AWS Step Functions)
  • Familiarity with semantic modeling using LookML, Cube, MetricFlow, etc. is a plus
  • Knowledge of Python, bash.

We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and are committed to equal employment opportunities. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruitment process or by emailing hiring@datasciences.ca.

title: Claims Handler - Insurance

For our people, that means working with colleagues across markets, contributing to work with international reach and helping teams deliver consistently in an environment built on collaboration, accountability and quality.

  • 8+ years of experience in Cybersecurity, Application Security, Product Security, Information Security or a related field.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Application Security / Product Security and Secure SDLC practices.
  • Experience with SAST, DAST and SCA tools, including Veracode or a comparable application security platform.
  • Experience integrating application security testing into CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps processes.
  • Strong understanding of application vulnerabilities, vulnerability triage, remediation, risk prioritization and exception management.
  • Experience conducting application security risk assessments, security architecture reviews and application design reviews.
  • Knowledge of OWASP standards, particularly OWASP ASVS, and ability to apply them in product and application security assessments.
  • Experience working directly with Product, Engineering, DevOps and Architecture teams across the software lifecycle.
  • Experience conducting third-party / SaaS security assessments and reviewing vendor security evidence.
  • Strong understanding of modern application, API, integration and cloud architectures.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills, with the ability to translate technical risks into clear business recommendations
  • Fluency in English and Polish.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AI security assessments, AI governance, AI risk management or agentic AI security.
  • Experience with threat modeling, API security, application security architecture and application risk assessment.
  • Knowledge of cloud security across Azure, AWS or GCP environments.
  • Experience with tools such as Checkmarx, Fortify, Snyk, SonarQube or other equivalent SAST/DAST/SCA platforms.
  • Understanding of third-party security evidence and frameworks, including SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001, Trust Center reviews and vendor security questionnaires.
  • Experience supporting M&A integration, application onboarding or security integration of acquired technology environments.
  • Ability to build scalable processes, metrics, dashboards and reporting for application security leadership and governance forums.
  • Leadership, mentoring and ownership mindset, with the ability to influence teams without relying solely on authority.

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Preferred certifications: CISSP, CSSLP, CISM, OSCP / OSWE, CEH, GIAC certifications, Azure / AWS / GCP Security certifications or AI Security / AI Risk certifications.

We are looking for an experienced Application Security Manager to lead application, product and AI security initiatives across the organization. In this role, you will embed security into the software development lifecycle, manage application security testing capabilities, support DevSecOps adoption, assess risks related to third-party products and AI-enabled solutions, and partner closely with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, AI, TPRM and Security teams.

title: Examiners- Health (Therapy Teams)
description:

title: Optical Engineer
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As an Optical Engineer in the Gimbal team, you are responsible for the optical performance of our EO/IR imaging payloads, which drive image quality, detection range, and robustness in operation. You will work on current products and shape the design of future ones. You follow each product from sizing and prototyping through validation and mass production, working closely with the mechanical, electronics, software, computer vision and industrialization teams.

Responsibilities

  • Sizing and design of EO/IR imaging payloads, arbitrating between field of view, resolution, range, and sensor choice.

  • Select lenses and sensors, or lead custom optical designs, against image quality and robustness targets.

  • Design, build, and maintain optical test benches for development, validation, and production.

  • Measure and validate image quality: MTF, focus, boresight, distortion, and NETD for infrared.

  • Develop the camera calibration pipeline (intrinsics, extrinsics, distortion, photometric and radiometric correction) with the software and perception teams.

  • Integrate optics into mechanical assemblies, covering tolerancing, athermalisation, windows, coatings, and sealing.

  • Investigate optical issues across the product life cycle, from prototype to series production.

  • Manage optical suppliers and support industrialization of lenses, sensors, and components.

  • Run field tests to assess image quality in real operating conditions.

Candidate Requirements

  • Master's degree or engineering degree with a specialization in optics.

  • 3+ years of experience in optical engineering, ideally on camera or imaging systems.

  • Proven experience sizing an electro-optical or infrared optical system.

  • Hands-on experience with standard optical measurements such as camera calibration, MTF, and NETD.

  • Experience developing optical test benches, from architecture to validation and integration.

  • Solid grounding in image processing: distortion, gamma, and geometric and photometric correction.

  • Experience with thermal cameras is a strong plus.

  • Hands-on, rigorous, and pragmatic, with the autonomy to iterate fast in a startup environment.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Staff Engineer / Senior Engineer - ALOMAR Observatory
description:
Andøya Space søker en engasjert ingeniør til ALOMAR Observatory på Andøya.

Fra ALOMARs beliggenhet på toppen av det 378 meter høye Ramnan-fjellet på Andøya får forskere mulighet til å studere den arktiske atmosfæren ved hjelp av avansert LiDAR- og radarinstrumentering. ALOMAR (Arctic Lidar Observatory for Middle Atmosphere Research) er et avansert forskningsobservatorium for optisk og radarbasert fjernmåling av atmosfæren. Som ingerniør blir du en del av Ground-Based Instrumentation-avdelingen og vil arbeide med drift, vedlikehold og videreutvikling av vitenskapelig instrumentering og datainnsamling.

Stillingen inngår i Ground-Based Instrumentation-avdelingen, som er en del av Andøya Space sin Sub-Orbital-divisjon. Arbeidsstedet er ved ALOMAR Observatory, og stillingen innebærer turnusarbeid etter vaktplan. Arbeidstiden er normalt på hverdager mellom 08:00–16:00 og 15:00–01:00. I forbindelse med kampanjeperioder og i sommermånedene kan andre arbeidstider forekomme, inkludert natt- og helgearbeid.

Søknadsfrist: 01.11.2026

Stillingen stiller strenge krav til sikkerhetsmessig skikkethet, og krever at man oppfyller vilkår for sikkerhetsklarering i henhold til Lov om nasjonal sikkerhet (Sikkerhetsloven). Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Drift og vedlikehold av LiDAR-, radar- og annen forskningsinstrumentering ved ALOMAR.
  • Teknisk støtte til forskere, kunder og interne fagmiljøer.
  • Kvalitetssikring, prosessering og analyse av måledata, inkludert data fra satellitter.
  • Vitenskapelig og teknisk rapportering til kunder, samt bidrag til søknader om forskningsfinansiering til Norges forskningsråd, EU, ESA og andre finansieringskilder.
  • Delta i relevante forsknings- og utviklingsprosjekter, konferanser og formidlingsaktiviteter.
  • Bidra ved studentkurs og omvisninger ved ALOMAR.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Mastergrad eller tilsvarende innen fysikk, atmosfærefag, ingeniørfag eller annet relevant fagområde.
  • Gode ferdigheter i programmeringsspråket Python; kunnskap i andre programmeringsspråk er en fordel.
  • Evne til å gjennomføre selvstendige vitenskapelige dataanalyser, inkludert utarbeidelse av vitenskapelige rapporter, basert på data fra LiDAR- og vitenskapelig radarbasert fjernmåling, in-situ-målinger og jordobservasjonssatellitter.
  • Gode skriftlige og muntlige kommunikasjonsevner på både norsk og engelsk, med evne til å rapportere til finansieringsinstitusjoner og presentere vitenskapelige resultater på faglige konferanser og for allmennheten.
  • Erfaring med søknader om forskningsfinansiering, for eksempel til Norges forskningsråd, EU, ESA og andre finansieringskilder.
  • Erfaring med å utarbeide tekniske rapporter og prosjektrapportering.
  • Gyldig førerkort klasse B med manuell girkasse, og evne til å kjøre trygt til ALOMAR under krevende vinterforhold.
  • Arbeidsstedet ligger på toppen av Ramnan-fjellet, og arbeidet kan i enkelte tilfeller innebære å gå til eller fra observatoriet under krevende værforhold.

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner og erfaring:

  • Erfaring med metoder for kalibrering og validering av jordobservasjonssatellitter.
  • Erfaring med vedlikehold av LiDAR- eller radarsystemer.
  • Erfaring med store datasett, prosessering av satellittdata og statistisk analyse.
  • Erfaring innen Space Surveillance and Tracking (SST).
  • Programmeringsferdigheter utover Python.
Personlige egenskaper
  • Evne til å arbeide selvstendig og strukturert
  • Gode samarbeidsevner og evne til å kommunisere tydelig og presist
  • Høy grad av sikkerhetsbevissthet og forståelse for konsekvensene av egne handlinger
  • Profesjonell, ansvarsbevisst og pålitelig, med god gjennomføringsevne
  • Strukturert og nøyaktig, også i komplekse og tidskritiske situasjoner
  • Evne til å bevare ro, opprettholde situasjonsforståelse og ta gode beslutninger under press
  • Fleksibel og tilpasningsdyktig, og trives i et operativt, dynamisk og internasjonalt arbeidsmiljø

Enkelte vakter ved ALOMAR vil gjennomføres alene, og stillingen krever derfor høy grad av selvstendighet og ansvarsfølelse.

title: Data Center Technician - 2027 Internship
description:
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cutting-edge data centers in the world. Amazon data centers are large-scale, high-density facilities where you will help change the face of cloud technology in the region — and your work will directly impact millions of customers.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Data Center Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar.

About the Role

As a Data Center Technician Intern, you will work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure. This position involves hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

You will provide our internal teams with infrastructure-related support, resolving tickets related to hardware (motherboards, Random Access Memory, Central Processing Units, Graphics Processing Units, and more) and networking (link-down events, optics replacements, switch replacements, and more).

In addition to hardware and network repair, you will learn how to install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix complex problems within the data center environment.

Your day-to-day duties include:

- Troubleshooting server hardware alongside experienced AWS technicians

- Meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) against assigned trouble tickets

- Shadowing AWS technicians during network troubleshooting to build your diagnostic skills

- Replacing media (Solid State Drives and Hard Disk Drives) in accordance with AWS Data Tech guidance

- Performing regular server hardware repairs (drives, motherboards, and other components) under the guidance of experienced technicians

- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday through Friday.

Please note that a full-time Data Center Technician position could involve day, evening, or weekend shifts and on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will diagnose and repair the servers and networks that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. Every server you repair and every network issue you resolve keeps the cloud running.

Action. You will move fast, learn by doing, and solve real problems from day one. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape.

A day in the life
Watch a day in the life of a Data Center Technician https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AKi0LtjSO4M

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers — in an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them.

Gauss Fusion is aiming to build the first commercial scale fusion power plant based on the stellarator concept and is looking for an experienced systems engineer to lead on implementation of best-in-class systems engineering methodologies across the multidisciplinary development team. The successful candidate will specify the approach to defining systems requirements, managing interfaces, managing technology risk, managing qualification structures and ensuring configuration diligence across the modelling and documentation systems for our fusion power plant development.

The role will report to the Director of Engineering.

  • Leading systems engineering development for the stellarator power plant, including defining system requirements, developing system architectures, risk assessments, validation and verification, and managing system interfaces.
  • Development of the Gauss Fusion systems engineering framework.
  • Coordination with various engineering disciplines to ensure integration and compatibility of subsystems.
  • Development and maintenance of system documentation, including specifications, design documents, interface control documents.
  • Implement system-level testing and verification to ensure compliance with requirements and specifications.
  • Ensure proper QA and data processes are developed to support and streamline the eventual licensing of the fusion power plant.

  • Professional recognition through full membership of a relevant Institution, or completion of a Phd/Dr.-Ing in a relevant engineering area is an asset.

    • Preferably more than 5 years of experience in engineering or related fields, ideally with experience of working in technology development and subsequent experience working as a Systems Engineer on large-scale engineering projects.
    • Experience in system architecture design, integration, and testing.
    • Familiarity with systems engineering tools and methodologies.
  • Strong understanding of systems engineering principles and practices.
  • Proficiency in requirements management and flow-down, configuration management, and risk management.
  • Proficiency in SysML and/or MBSE software tools.
  • Proficiency in Risk Analysis and Failure Mode Analysis.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and coordinate complex engineering projects.
  • Familiarity with magnetic fusion and/or power-plant systems preferred.

title: Game Design Intern
description:
Contract: 6-month Internship

Start Date: Late January 2027

Work Model: Hybrid (3 days onsite minimum)


The Challenge Ahead


Battlefield is a storied franchise renowned for uncompromising combat gameplay and all-out warfare, for over two decades. 100 million players and 5 billion hours played later, Battlefield Studios is defining the future of the first-person shooter with the biggest launch in franchise history with Battlefield 6, and a new era beginning with Battlefield REDSEC.


United under the banner of Battlefield Studios, 4 world-class teams across Criterion, DICE, Motive, and Ripple Effect have come together to focus on the future of the franchise, a connected Battlefield universe filled with immersive experiences built on our unique DNA.DICE is a creative studio with offices in Stockholm and Gothenburg. We believe in the power of inclusion and welcome game creators from all backgrounds to collaborate with us as we unlock the potential for the future of Battlefield!


Responsibilities:


Battlefield’s dynamic worlds are a defining part of the player experience. Destruction is not only a technical system, it shapes combat, changes tactical choices, creates memorable cinematic moments, and connects many parts of the game.


As a Game Design Intern on the Battlefield Destruction Team, you will work with the Principal Game Designer and a multidisciplinary team to help shape connected, dynamic-world features for millions of Battlefield players. You will contribute to both gameplay systems and their application in levels, learning how ideas progress from an initial player-facing goal through documentation, prototyping, implementation, iteration, and production. You will receive daily guidance from the Principal Game Designer while working within the wider direction of the Combat Director and the Battlefield core design team.


  • You will learn to use Frostbite Engine and EA's proprietary tools.

  • You will help design, implement, and iterate on destruction and dynamic-world features emphasizing tactical value, clear player feedback, and immersive Battlefield moments.

  • You will ideate and document feature intent and requirements, then guide collaboration between tech design, engineering, art, audio, production, and level teams to ensure features work cohesively within the broader game.

  • You will participate in prototyping, playtesting, and reviews—using feedback and development constraints to refine features and content towards the Battlefield systemic gameplay vision.


Eligibility:


  • You must be currently enrolled at university or education provider in Sweden with a planned internship period planned (e.g. LiA)

  • You are eligible to work in Stockholm, Sweden, without visa/relocation support

  • You are available to commence a full-time 6 month placement at the end of January 2027. Please check with your school before applying.


Skills:


We are looking for an emerging designer who is curious about the whole player experience, not only the configuration of an isolated system.


Player-focused design thinking

  • You begin with the experience: What value does this create for the player?

  • You think about gameplay loops, player motivation, fantasy, usability, feedback, and readability.

  • You appreciate the immersive, systemic, and cinematic qualities of features.


Holistic and systemic thinking

  • You recognise opportunities for one feature to strengthen another rather than treating each design as an isolated component.


Communication and collaboration

  • You communicate clearly and are interested in the perspectives of different crafts.

  • You structure ideas and explain their intent through written documentation, diagrams, presentations, or prototypes.

  • You advocate for an idea without becoming personally attached to it.

  • You listen to feedback, investigate its underlying concern, and seek additional context where needed.


Curiosity

  • You ask questions and are interested in working with designers and product owners as well as map teams and other implementation partners.

  • You are willing to learn unfamiliar tools, workflows, and technical concepts.


Help us make play happen. Apply now with an up-to-date Portfolio, CV and Cover Letter in English, explaining why you would like to join EA for this internship position.

title: (Ondersteunend) begeleider intensief, Punter 1 Sliedrecht
description:
Wat ga je doen?
Als (ondersteunend) begeleider bij ASVZ begeleid en verzorg je bewoners met een verstandelijke beperking. Tijdens je dienst zorg je ervoor dat zij op jou kunnen vertrouwen. Je bent betrokken bij het ochtendritueel waarbij je ondersteunt bij de zorg of vangt bewoners op wanneer zij terugkomen van de dagbesteding. Je betrekt hen actief bij de dagelijkse gang van zaken en de huishoudelijke taken op de woning. Hierbij hanteren we het samen 100-principe: jij vult de bewoner aan zodat jullie samen op 100% komen.

In deze functie:

  • leer je cliënten begeleiden op een manier die aansluit bij hun individuele behoeften;

  • neem je maandelijks deel aan het teamoverleg en denk je mee over de plannen voor cliënten;

  • werk je onder aansturing van een teamleider en krijg je begeleiding van (persoonlijk) begeleiders.

Wie zoeken we?
Als (ondersteunend) begeleider op Punter 1 heb je een zorgachtergrond of affiniteit met de gehandicaptenzorg die zich graag verder wil ontwikkelen. Je hebt geduld, inlevingsvermogen en doorzettingskracht. Omdat je op een woning werkt, ben je inzetbaar overdag, in de avonduren, in weekenden en op feestdagen. Daarnaast vragen wij:

  • je beschikt over een middelbareschooldiploma of mbo‑2 zorgdiploma. Ook met een achtergrond als MMZ 3 of Verzorgende IG nodigen we je graag uit om te solliciteren

  • het vermogen om bewoners duidelijke structuur te bieden

  • je staat stevig in je schoenen en blijft rustig bij intensieve zorg of complexe situaties

  • dat je je kunt vinden in de visie van ASVZ en deze actief uitdraagt

Wat krijg je?
Bij ASVZ krijg je een veelzijdige baan waarin je samen met collega’s kijkt naar wat cliënten wél kunnen. We vinden het belangrijk dat je met plezier werkt en je verbonden voelt met je team. Daarom bieden we goede voorwaarden en ruimte om te groeien. Je kunt rekenen op:

  • een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast contract

  • een parttimebaan voor 28 uur in de week

  • een bruto salaris van € 2.597,00 tot € 3.635,00 op basis van 36 uur volgens FWG 35. Ga je aan de slag als begeleider? Dan is het tussen de € 2.893,00 en € 3.902,00 in schaal 40.

  • 8% vakantiegeld, 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering en ORT

  • werken in een hecht team met ondersteuning van deskundige collega’s

  • aandacht voor jouw ontwikkeling, met doorgroeimogelijkheden naar begeleider

Werkplek
Punter 1 is een gezellige woning op het terrein van de Merwebolder in Sliedrecht. Hier wonen ouder wordende bewoners met een licht verstandelijke beperking en een intensieve begeleidingsvraag. Zij hebben behoefte aan een stabiele en veilige omgeving, waarin jij als begeleider ook op moeilijke momenten onvoorwaardelijke ondersteuning biedt. Je draagt bij aan het ontwikkelen en behouden van hun vaardigheden en zelfstandigheid.

Een deel van de bewoners neemt deel aan activiteiten buiten de woning; jij zorgt dat zij op tijd en goed voorbereid vertrekken. Andere bewoners ondersteun je bij vaste taken zoals de vaatwasser in- en uitruimen, kleding wassen, opruimen en schoonmaken. Daarnaast is er regelmatig ruimte voor gezamenlijke activiteiten, zoals spelletjes, creatieve momenten of een wandeling. De bewoners zijn grotendeels zelfstandig, maar hebben motivatie en stimulans nodig.

Enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan direct!
Heb je nog vragen? Stel ze gerust door contact op te nemen met Debbie de Vos, meewerkend teamleider via 06-57950844.

title: DevOps Engineer - Junior / Mid
description:
Location: Ljubljana,Ljubljana,Slovenia

We’re looking for an Infrastructure Engineer to help us build, run, and scale the infrastructure behind both our (Creative Automation and Creative Enablement) products.

If you’re curious about how things work under the hood, enjoy solving complex infrastructure challenges, and are always looking for smarter and more reliable ways to build and operate systems, you’ll feel right at home. We’re looking for someone who enjoys learning, experimenting, and working with modern cloud-native technologies - and isn’t afraid to dig deep when something doesn’t behave as expected.

What you’ll do?

You will be part of our DevOps team, which is responsible for our product’s availability, latency, performance, efficiency, monitoring, emergency response and capacity planning. Your responsibility will be:

  • Design, develop and maintain software that handles running, deploying, scaling, and monitoring of our products.
  • Establish design patterns and best practices for enabling new product features in a scalable and reliable way.
  • Verify and help developers apply those patterns and participate in early stages of feature design, when needed.
  • On-call a portion of your time to get your hands dirty and gain experience.
  • Co-owning the production environment and willing to be in the trenches with developers to diagnose issues and hunt down elusive bugs.
  • SLA is your law, uptime objectives are met by participating in controlling the risks and rate of change in collaboration with the whole engineering department.

What are the challenges ahead?

Our platforms are 2 giant machines which are deployed multiple times per week. Even though we want the changes to come into production fast, they still need to be stable.

Besides that we want our developers to be productive and spend more time on quality features and less on hitting infrastructure caused roadblocks. Our DevOps team is responsible for our software to be up and running under provided SLA constraints.

What kind of infrastructure stack do we have?

We are running our infrastructure in the AWS cloud - specifically on the managed Fargate ECS service. Our application is containerized in Docker images then deployed through CloudFormation using the AWS CDK. It mainly consist of:

  • hundreds of services scaled automatically,
  • tens of real-time services handling hundreds of thousands requests every minute,
  • different databases, like MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Postgres, etc.,
  • monitoring services, like Prometheus, Grafana, ...

Who are You?

  • Have at least 1-2 years of experience with developing/managing infrastructure using modern development processes.
  • Have experience with at least one programming language such as, PHP, Typescript (JS), Golang, Scala, etc.
  • Have an understanding and experience with relational databases (e.g., MySQL) and/or No-SQL databases (e.g., Mongo).
  • Experience with debugging and profiling in a production environment.
  • Willingness to learn, and help us learn too.
  • Be fluent in written and spoken English.

We appreciate:

  • Some interest in or having experience with cloud computing (AWS, Google, Azure, …).
  • Experience with containerization in production environments.
  • Be open to collaborating in the tech community.

Why Celtra?

  • Impact: Help shape products used by leading media companies and publishers across the globe.
  • Culture: We’re inventive, collaborative, and proudly a little bit quirky — because doing great work should also be fun.
  • Flexibility: Hybrid with strong hubs in Ljubljana and New York, and team get-togethers that keep us connected.
  • Growth: You’ll learn from experienced product managers, engineers, and designers — and grow into bigger roles as you go.

What do we offer?

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work based on a fixed number of in-office days.
  • A dedicated educational budget to explore new skills and deepen your expertise.
  • Equipment of your choice.
  • Knowledge shares.
  • Additional pension and health insurance.
  • WFH budget. An additional budget of 500 EUR to set up your home space.
  • Employee well-being. Dedicated budget for any kind of wellness activities such as fitness, yoga, etc.

About Celtra

Celtra helps enterprise advertisers, media, and agencies design, approve, and deliver digital creative across the ever-growing number of campaigns, markets, designs, and variants. Celtra’s Creative Automation & Enablement Software for helps brands move faster than ever while dramatically scaling content production. Companies like adidas, TripAdvisor, Spotify, Unilever, NBCU, Lululemon, YETI, Vice, and hundreds more partner with Celtra to cut production costs while increasing efficiencies and output in the cloud.

Empowering Creativity through Diversity & Inclusion

Our mission is to empower creativity - and we cannot fulfill our mission without different perspectives. Diversity drives innovation, and Celtra is committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging.

Every employee is empowered at Celtra - no matter your race, age, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, or ethnicity. We hire the best, and develop our teams through continuous education and mentorship, in a community where everyone can bring their whole selves to work.

title: Data Center Operation Technician, Data Center Operations, AWS Data Center Operation

- You will work as part of the Operations team; whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure.
- Your role and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, server rack installation, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues also responding to emergent situations that affect operational stability.
- You will work and meet SLAs against assigned trouble tickets via a directed workflow, be the first line touch point for hardware troubleshooting and technical issues.

- More experienced technicians may assist in training less experienced members of the team.
- Involves covering 24x7 shift rotation

A day in the life
- You will support DC (Data Center) infrastructure equipment (e.g. racks, servers, networking devices, hardware components, cables, etc.),
- You will follow the instructions ticket-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution and perform routine operation activities on hardware, or spare parts, including rack install, server break/fix, rack decom etc.
- You will perform on-call duties and will participate in Data Center operations, handling scheduled maintenance and change management activities that require monitoring of the data center infrastructure.
- Show a strong aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving
- You will be involved with site management and maintain tidiness in operation areas

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Full Stack Developer - .NET (Intermediate)
description:

Backend

Frontend

  • Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive web design
  • Experience consuming REST APIs and handling client-side state
  • Familiarity with frontend build tools and package managers such as npm

Database

  • Strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server
  • Proficiency in writing complex SQL queries
  • Experience with stored procedures, functions, views, indexes, and query optimization
  • Understanding of database design, normalization, transactions, and performance tuning
  • Experience with Entity Framework Core or another ORM

Cloud & DevOps

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure or another major cloud platform
  • Familiarity with Azure services such as Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Azure Key Vault, and Azure Service Bus
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with Git-based source control and branching strategies
  • Experience with Docker and containerization is a plus
  • Understanding of application monitoring, logging, and observability

Testing & Quality

  • Experience with unit testing using frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest
  • Understanding of integration and API testing
  • Familiarity with mocking frameworks such as Moq
  • Experience with automated testing and continuous integration
  • Strong understanding of secure coding and application performance practices

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with microservices architecture
  • Knowledge of Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of messaging technologies such as Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, or Kafka
  • Experience with Redis or other caching technologies
  • Knowledge of GraphQL is a plus
  • Familiarity with Elasticsearch or similar search technologies
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum development methodologies
  • Understanding of Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
  • Experience with application performance monitoring tools
  • Knowledge of AI/ML integrations or consuming LLM APIs is a plus

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3–7+ years of professional software development experience, depending on level.
  • Strong hands–on experience with the .NET ecosystem and modern frontend development.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering production-grade web applications.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

What We're Looking For

  • A strong problem solver with excellent attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working across both frontend and backend technologies.
  • Able to take ownership of features from requirements through deployment.
  • Passionate about writing clean, maintainable, and scalable code.
  • Comfortable working in a collaborative Agile environment.
  • Able to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Typical Technology Stack

  • Backend: C#, .NET 8/9+, ASP.NET Core, Web API, Entity Framework Core
  • Frontend: React / Angular / Blazor, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3
  • Database: Microsoft SQL Server
  • Cloud: Microsoft Azure
  • DevOps: Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Docker
  • Testing: xUnit / NUnit, Moq, Postman
  • Version Control: Git / GitHub / Azure Repos

title: Business Analyst Intern (6 months) - 2027
description:
Il existe un univers d'opportunités chez Amazon.
Chez Amazon, votre carrière ne suit pas une ligne droite. Elle s'accélère, prend des tournants et vous met au défi de manières que vous n'auriez jamais imaginées. Dès votre arrivée, vous faites partie de quelque chose de grand : créer des produits ou des services qui touchent des millions de personnes et façonner la manière dont les gens vivent, travaillent et se connectent au quotidien. C'est ici que vos idées se transforment en un véritable impact. Vous travaillerez avec des outils de classe mondiale, des plateformes internationales et des systèmes conçus pour fonctionner à une échelle extraordinaire. Vous avancerez rapidement, expérimenterez et lancerez des solutions qui comptent. Avec des opportunités infinies à explorer au sein de différentes équipes et fonctions, vous apprendrez vite, appliquerez vos connaissances et découvrirez des compétences dont vous ignoriez l'existence. C'est un environnement conçu pour les bâtisseurs qui veulent voir l'impact de leur travail dans le monde. Prêt(e) à commencer votre aventure ?

Qu'est-ce que cela vous apporte ?

Un stage chez Amazon signifie de vraies responsabilités dès le premier jour. Vous construirez, testerez et apprendrez aux côtés de personnes qui souhaitent vous voir réussir, tout en ayant un impact qui va bien au-delà du campus.

__

There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.

At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact.
You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

Key job responsibilities
- You will test your analytical and technical skills. This internship is a learning opportunity, where you will put your skills and bias for action to the test, to complete a project that will support your own growth in the Business Analysis function, as well as the team and our customers' success.
- Partner with multiple teams across different geographies, building collaborative relationships while learning from experienced professionals in a global business environment.
- Take ownership of data analysis projects with guidance from mentors, turning data insights into actionable business recommendations.
- Identify and propose process improvement opportunities, working with the team to develop streamlined solutions that enhance business efficiency.
- Lead root cause analyses for assigned projects, collaborating with team members to solve real business challenges and implement solutions.
- Support the development of business cases for new programs, gaining hands-on experience in strategic planning and project development.
- Own the maintenance and improvement of specific performance metrics dashboards, while learning advanced visualization techniques from experienced analysts.
- Develop into a valued team member by bringing fresh perspectives and innovative ideas, while building foundation skills in business analysis.
___

- Vous mettrez à l'épreuve vos compétences analytiques et techniques. Ce stage est une opportunité d'apprentissage, où vous mettrez vos compétences et votre sens de l'initiative à l'épreuve, en menant à bien un projet qui soutiendra votre propre développement dans la fonction Business Analysis, ainsi que la réussite de l'équipe et de nos clients.
- Collaborer avec plusieurs équipes présentes dans différentes zones géographiques, en construisant des relations collaboratives tout en apprenant auprès de professionnels expérimentés dans un environnement commercial mondial.
- Prendre en charge des projets d'analyse de données avec l'accompagnement de mentors, en transformant les données en recommandations commerciales concrètes.
- Identifier et proposer des opportunités d'amélioration des processus, en travaillant avec l'équipe pour développer des solutions optimisées qui améliorent l'efficacité opérationnelle.
- Mener des analyses des causes profondes pour les projets assignés, en collaborant avec les membres de l'équipe pour résoudre de véritables défis commerciaux et mettre en œuvre des solutions.
- Contribuer à l'élaboration de business cases pour de nouveaux programmes, en acquérant une expérience pratique en planification stratégique et en développement de projets.
- Assurer la maintenance et l'amélioration de tableaux de bord de suivi des indicateurs de performance, tout en apprenant des techniques avancées de visualisation auprès d'analystes expérimentés.
- Devenir un membre précieux de l'équipe en apportant des perspectives nouvelles et des idées innovantes, tout en développant des compétences fondamentales en analyse commerciale.

A day in the life
Une journée type Lieu : Clichy
Date de début : Flexible entre mars et juillet 2027. Nous ne proposons pas de dates de début en 2026.
Durée : 12 mois
Il ne s'agit pas d'un stage à distance

Chaque jour est différent en tant que stagiaire Business Analyst. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'analystes expérimentés et d'un mentor dédié sur de véritables projets d'analyse de données ayant un impact direct sur l'efficacité opérationnelle. Vous pourriez passer votre matinée à explorer des jeux de données pour réaliser une analyse des causes profondes d'un défi opérationnel, puis consacrer votre après-midi à la création et à l'amélioration d'un tableau de bord de suivi des indicateurs de performance clés. Vous collaborerez avec des équipes présentes dans différentes zones géographiques, présenterez des recommandations fondées sur les données et apporterez des perspectives nouvelles pour résoudre de véritables problématiques métier.

Amazon est une entreprise guidée par les données, et quel que soit le projet dont vous êtes responsable, une partie de votre rôle consistera à transformer des données brutes en informations exploitables. Vous identifierez des opportunités d'amélioration des processus, contribuerez à l'élaboration de business cases pour de nouveaux programmes et présenterez vos conclusions à des interlocuteurs de haut niveau — développant ainsi vos compétences analytiques, techniques et stratégiques dans un environnement international et dynamique.

Remarque : Vous devez disposer d'une autorisation de travail dans le pays d'emploi à la date de début du stage.

___

A day in the life
Location: Clichy
Start Date: Flexible between March - July 2027. We don't offer 2026 start dates.
Duration: 12 months
This is not a remote internship opportunity

Every day is different as a Business Analyst Intern. You'll work alongside experienced analysts and a dedicated mentor on real data analysis projects that directly impact business efficiency. You might spend your morning diving into datasets to perform a root cause analysis on an operational challenge, then spend your afternoon building and refining a performance metrics dashboard to track key business outcomes. You will partner with teams across different geographies, present data-driven recommendations, and contribute fresh perspectives to solve real business problems.

Amazon is a data-driven business, so no matter which project you own, part of your role will involve turning raw data into actionable insights. You'll identify process improvement opportunities, support the development of business cases for new programs, and present your findings to senior stakeholders — building your analytical, technical, and strategic thinking skills in a fast-paced, global environment.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.

About the team
IÀ propos de l'équipe

Communauté des stagiaires : En tant que stagiaire Amazon, vous ferez partie d'une communauté dynamique et solidaire qui favorise votre croissance et votre développement. Vous collaborerez avec des stagiaires du monde entier, en réseautant et en participant à des événements sociaux pour élargir vos perspectives. Vous pourrez également rejoindre des groupes spécialisés axés sur des domaines tels que le développement durable pour explorer vos centres d'intérêt variés.

Accompagnement : Le programme de stage offre un système de soutien solide, comprenant des permanences hebdomadaires pour les stagiaires, un support informatique et RH dédié, ainsi qu'une équipe de programme engagée dans votre réussite. Cela garantit que vous disposez de l'accompagnement et de l'assistance nécessaires pour vous épanouir.

Sessions de formation : Des sessions de formation exclusives renforceront davantage vos compétences, en vous donnant accès aux plateformes d'apprentissage de pointe d'Amazon et à l'expertise de leaders du secteur. Ces opportunités de développement structurées vous prépareront à la prochaine étape de votre carrière.

Opportunités : À l'issue de votre stage, si celui-ci est réussi, vous pourrez être considéré(e) pour un poste de diplômé(e) ou un second stage, vous permettant de poursuivre votre parcours chez Amazon. De plus, vous bénéficierez d'un salaire mensuel compétitif, d'une aide à la relocalisation et d'un accès à une gamme d'avantages sociaux.
___

Intern Community: As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a dynamic, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.

Support: The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.

Learning Sessions: Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's industry-leading learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.

Opportunities: Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.

This role requires a blend of technical expertise, business acumen, and strong analytical skills to translate business requirements into effective CPQ solutions.

Key Responsibilities

CPQ Configuration & Management

  • Configure and maintain DealHub CPQ functionality including product rules, price rules, discount schedules, approval processes, and quote templates
  • Design and implement complex product bundles, pricing structures, and configuration rules to support diverse business requirements
  • Create and maintain quote templates, proposal documents, and automated workflows

  • Develop and maintain custom fields, validation rules, and workflow automation
  • Implement and maintain integrations between DealHub CPQ, Salesforce and other systems (ERP, billing, etc.)

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Develop test plans and conduct thorough testing of CPQ configurations, including user acceptance testing (UAT)
  • Troubleshoot and resolve CPQ-related issues and system errors

Technical Skills

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with DealHub CPQ platform
  • Strong understanding of Configure, Price, Quote processes and methodologies
  • Proficiency with CRM systems, particularly Salesforce
  • Experience with data management, reporting, and analytics tools
  • Basic understanding of API integrations and data flows
  • Advanced Excel skills for data analysis and reporting

Business Acumen

  • Deep understanding of B2B sales processes and quote-to-cash workflows
  • Knowledge of pricing strategies, discount structures, and approval hierarchies
  • Familiarity with contract management and proposal generation
  • Understanding of revenue recognition principles (preferred)

Soft Skills

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Strong communication skills with ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Collaborative mindset with proven stakeholder management experience
  • Self-motivated with ability to work independently

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, or related field
  • DealHub certification or equivalent CPQ platform certifications
  • Experience with other CPQ platforms (Salesforce CPQ, Oracle CPQ, SAP CPQ)
  • Knowledge of subscription-based pricing models and recurring revenue

title: Juniora Linux-tekniker & Systemadministratörer
description:
Vi är specialister på bemanning och konsulttjänster inom IT och teknik – från lovande talanger och konsulter med bred kompetens till erfarna specialister med djup expertis.

För dig som kandidat innebär vi en trygg partner som erbjuder spännande uppdrag, personlig utveckling och nära kontakt med våra rådgivare. Vi ser till att du får rätt uppdrag för din kompetens och dina ambitioner – alltid med människan i centrum.

För våra kunder betyder det att vi är en pålitlig leverantör som snabbt kan matcha rätt kompetens med rätt behov. Utöver vår egen starka konsultorganisation har vi även ett utökat partnernätverk, vilket gör att vi kan erbjuda ännu större flexibilitet och bredd i leveransen.

Samarbete och kvalitet präglar allt vi gör, och våra kärnvärden sammanfattas i vårt löfte: Empowering the Nordics through people.

Eccera har 300 anställda och kontor i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö och Linköping. Vi är medlem i Almega Kompetensföretagen och följer deras tecknade kollektivavtal med Unionen.

Eccera har just nu ett ökat behov av juniora Linux-tekniker och systemadministratörer till ett flertal kunder i Stockholm. Vi söker dig med akademisk examen i relevant område och som brinner för Linux-serverdrift, nätverk och IT-säkerhet och vill utvecklas inom området.

Som konsult på Eccera får du en trygg anställning och samlar på dig värdefull arbetslivserfarenhet på uppdrag hos våra kunder. Din konsultchef stöttar dig i din utveckling där du hela tiden fyller på med nya erfarenheter och kunskaper. En utmärkt möjlighet att göra karriär.

I rollen får du arbeta med:

Administration och drift av Linux-baserade system
Systeminstallationer, uppsättning och felsökning
Nätverk (routing, switchar, TCP/IP) och säkerhetslösningar
Support och samarbete med interna och externa användare
Möjlighet att växa in i mer avancerade system- och säkerhetsuppgifter

Rollen är bred och ger dig en stabil grund att växa från, både tekniskt och i förståelsen för IT-säkerhet och professionell kundinteraktion.

Vi söker dig som har:

1–3 års arbetslivserfarenhet inom Linux, systemadministration eller nätverk
Akademisk examen i relevant område eller motsvarande erfarenhet
Ett högt säkerhetstänk och intresse för IT-säkerhet
God samarbetsförmåga och vilja att lära tillsammans med andra

Meriterande erfarenheter:

Erfarenhet av serverhårdvara, brandväggar och VPN
Grundläggande kunskap inom kryptering/PKI
Mobiltelefonhantering (Android/iOS)
Erfarenhet från miljöer med högt ställda krav på IT-säkerhet

Dessa typer av uppdrag och tjänster är ofta placerad i säkerhetsklass och säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer därför att genomföras vid anställning i enlighet med 3 kap. säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585).

Vad vi erbjuder

På Eccera får du de verktyg du behöver för att nå dina mål. Vi erbjuder alla våra konsulter kvalificerade utbildningar och certifieringar inom den senaste tekniken. Vi sätter stort värde på att våra medarbetare hela tiden ska fortsätta att utvecklas. Därför erbjuder vi dig möjligheten att lägga upp en individuell utbildningsplan, där vi bekostar såväl studiematerial som själva certifieringarna. Under din utveckling kommer vi matcha din kompetens mot rätt uppdrag i takt med att du avancerar.

title: Medewerker gastenservice De Zeven Bronnen
description:
In onze nieuwe brasserie binnen De Zeven Bronnen draait het om sfeer, aandacht en gastvrijheid. Ben jij die enthousiaste collega die bewoners en bezoekers elke dag een warm welkom geeft?

Wat ga je doen?

Als Medewerker Gastenservice ben jij de spil in onze gloednieuwe brasserie én ondersteun je in de huiskamers van onze afdelingen. Jij zorgt ervoor dat bewoners, medewerkers en gasten genieten van een fijne omgeving, heerlijk eten & drinken en warme gastvrijheid. Jouw taken zijn veelzijdig: van het serveren van maaltijden en drankjes tot het creëren van een gezellige sfeer en het verzorgen van een warm welkom.

  • Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor bewoners, bezoekers en vrijwilligers en zorgt voor een warm welkom.

  • Je zorgt voor de bereiding van sous-vide warme maaltijden voor de bewoners.

  • Je bedient de kassa en zorgt voor een correcte afhandeling.

  • Je bewaakt de voedselveiligheid volgens HACCP-richtlijnen.

  • Je draagt samen met je collega’s zorg voor een schone en veilige werkomgeving.

Wat vragen we van jou?

  • Je bent 16 tot 24 uur per week beschikbaar

  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar en vindt het geen probleem om in het weekend en op feestdagen te werken

  • Je hebt hygiëne hoog in het vaandel; kennis van HACCP is een pré

  • Je bent vriendelijk, toegankelijk en hebt gastvrijheid in je DNA

  • Je werkt graag samen als teamplayer, maar kunt ook zelfstandig goed uit de voeten

  • Je hebt oog voor welzijn en welbevinden: een praatje maken, even extra aandacht geven of een bewoner net dat stapje extra bieden, vind je vanzelfsprekend

Waar ga je werken?

De Zeven Bronnen is een woonzorgcentrum gelegen in de Maastrichtse wijk Amby. Binnen ons woonzorgcentrum wonen bewoners met zowel lichamelijke als cognitieve hulpvragen. In totaal werken er ongeveer 210 mensen bij De Zeven Bronnen, verdeeld over zeven zorgafdelingen, een team gastvrijheid en welzijn en een team dagbehandeling. Ook zijn we in ontwikkeling naar een expertisecentrum voor Parkinsonzorg! Wil jij onderdeel zijn van de gastvrije toekomst van De Zeven Bronnen? Bouw dan nu mee!

Over Envida: Envida biedt hulp en zorg voor ouderen en chronisch zieken in Maastricht en het Heuvelland. Dat doen we bij mensen thuis, in de wijk en in onze huizen. We vinden goede zorg een recht voor iedereen. Om dat te kunnen waarmaken, draait onze zorg vooral om kwaliteit van leven. Die bereiken we door nauw samen te werken met cliënten en bewoners, hun naasten en andere partijen in de samenleving.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een marktconform salaris volgens FWG 25 (CAO VVT), tussen € 2.541,13 en € 3.233,35 bruto per maand op basis van een 36-urige werkweek

  • 8% vakantiegeld en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering

  • Indien van toepassing: onregelmatigheidstoeslag tussen 22% en 60%

Je werkt niet alleen overdag, maar bent ook beschikbaar voor diensten in de avonden, weekenden en op feestdagen. Daarnaast kan het nodig zijn dat je op verschillende locaties of afdelingen werkt, afhankelijk van waar de zorgbehoefte het grootst is.

Binnen die kaders heb je zelf invloed op je planning. Via ons roostersysteem InPlanning zie je de openstaande diensten en schrijf je jezelf in op beschikbare diensten. Je bent zelf verantwoordelijk voor het plannen van voldoende uren binnen je contract.

Zo is jouw dag ‘Elke dag zo fijn mogelijk’:

  • Je werkt op verschillende afdelingen met verschillende doelgroepen;

  • Je ondersteunt, begeleidt en verzorgt cliënten met ‘echte’ aandacht;

  • Je hebt invloed op je eigen planning;

  • Je draagt bij waar jouw inzet het hardst nodig is.

Voor de flexpool werken we met een contract van 0 tot 28 uur per week.

Soms is er een periodieke hulpvraag. Dit houdt in dat je de mogelijkheid krijgt om een periode-opdracht van minimaal vier weken tot maximaal zes maanden uit te voeren op één afdeling en/of locatie. Dit gaat altijd in overleg.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een contract van 0 tot 28 uur per week, waarbij je zelf invloed hebt op het plannen van je uren;

  • Een salaris volgens FWG 25 van de cao VVT;

  • Een goede pensioenregeling bij Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn (PFZW) en collectieve verzekeringen;

  • 8% vakantiegeld en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% (dat is een volledige dertiende maand);

  • Een uitgebreide keuze aan trainingen en opleidingen via de BrabantZorg Academie om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen;

  • En last but not least: fijne collega’s!

Wie ben jij?

Allereerst heb jij hart voor de ouderenzorg. Jij hebt een diploma tot Helpende mbo niveau 2.

Daarnaast:

  • Wil je invloed hebben op het invullen van je eigen diensten en werktijden;

  • Vind je het leuk om op verschillende locaties en met verschillende doelgroepen te werken;

  • Ben je flexibel inzetbaar, ook in de avonden, weekenden en op feestdagen;

  • Heb je voldoende digitale vaardigheden om goed met een computer en smartphone te kunnen werken.

Hebben wij jouw interesse kunnen wekken?

Solliciteer direct op de vacature via de knop ‘reageren’.

Wil je liever eerst even telefonisch contact, neem dan contact op met het flexpunt regio Meierijstad 06-82005167.

title: Salarisadministrateur
description:
Salarisadministrateur

Ben jij een salarisadministrateur die graag zorgt dat de salarisverwerking klopt, afwijkingen signaleert en klanten adviseert bij complexere vraagstukken? Bij Salure krijg je de ruimte om jouw vakkennis in te zetten, mee te denken over verbeteringen en verder te groeien in je vak!

Wat ga je doen?

In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor een nauwkeurige en tijdige salarisverwerking én fungeer je als inhoudelijke sparringpartner voor jouw klanten. Je beheert of bouwt op tot een vaste portefeuille van maximaal 5 klanten, variërend van 100 tot 1500 medewerkers per klant. Dit zijn voornamelijk organisaties in de grootzakelijke markt, maar bijvoorbeeld ook onderwijsinstellingen en non-profitorganisaties (NGO’s).

Je werkt met AFAS software, gecombineerd met onze eigen slimme software en binnen duidelijke proceskaders. Je draagt inhoudelijke verantwoordelijkheid voor correcte verwerking, signalering van afwijkingen. We verwachten dat je actief meedenkt over optimalisatie.

Je werkt vanuit ons kantoor in Gouda gecombineerd met thuiswerken en maakt deel uit van een professioneel team van 30 payroll specialisten in Gouda en 10 in Leusden. Je directe team bestaat uit 6-10 collega’s. Je bent zelfstandig verantwoordelijk voor je eigen klanten, maar werkt nauw samen met je team en kunt bij complexere vraagstukken sparren met ervaren collega’s.

Werk je bij Salure, dan schrijven wij je bij NIRPA in het Register Salarisadministrateur (RSa) of het Register Payroll Professional (RPP). Hiermee laat je jouw vakkennis en vaardigheden zien. Er is een ruim aanbod aan training waaraan je deel kunt nemen.

“Het meeste voldoening haal ik uit het optimaliseren van payrollprocessen. Bij Salure krijg ik daar ook echt de ruimte voor.”

Emanuelle, Salarisadministrateur

Waar heb jij als specialist écht invloed?

Bij Salure krijg je inhoudelijke ruimte binnen duidelijke kaders. Je hebt invloed op:

  • De kwaliteit van het klantadvies rondom wet- en regelgeving en cao-vraagstukken

  • Het aandragen van verbetervoorstellen voor het optimaliseren van het automatiseringsproces.

  • Het signaleren van procesverbeteringen en deze bespreken met je teamleider of operationeel manager

  • Verbeteringen die breder binnen de organisatie worden doorgevoerd

We zoeken geen verwerker, maar een professional die hiernaast zijn of haar expertise inzet als adviseur.

Wat maakt onze payroll-aanpak anders?

Wij geloven dat goede payroll begint bij structuur, duidelijke afspraken en automatisering.

  • We maken heldere afspraken met klanten over aanlevering en verantwoordelijkheden

  • We lopen voorop in het toepassen van automatisering in ons vakgebied

  • We minimaliseren handmatige correcties

Hierdoor ontstaat ruimte voor analyse, advies en optimalisatie. Je besteedt dus minder tijd aan brandjes blussen en meer tijd aan inhoudelijke vraagstukken waar jouw ervaring echt het verschil maakt

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Controleren en verwerken van de salarisadministratie conform wet- en regelgeving

  • Signaleren van afwijkingen en zorgen voor een correcte en tijdige verwerking

  • Fungeren als aanspreekpunt voor HR- en salarisvraagstukken, zoals vragen over cao’s en looncomponenten

  • Initiëren en ondersteunen van verbeterprocessen binnen de salarisadministratie

Wat wij bieden

  • 💶 Salaris tot €4.400,- afhankelijk van ervaring

  • 📜 Jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast contract

  • 🏡 Hybride werken, reiskostenvergoeding en een lease fietsplan

  • 🌴 26 vakantiedagen, met mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen (max. 30)

  • 🎓 Interne en externe opleidingsmogelijkheden, waardoor jij je nog verder kunt ontwikkelen tot expert en voor het behalen van jouw benodigde jaarlijkse permanente educatiepunten voor het NIRPA register

  • 📈 Doorgroeimogelijkheden, bijvoorbeeld naar vakinhoudelijk trainer, specialist in AFAS inrichting of teamleider

  • 🏋️‍♂️ 3% vitaliteitsbudget, pensioenregeling met 80% werkgeversbijdrage

  • 👥 Een veilige werksfeer en een team wat voor elkaar klaar staat en successen met elkaar viert.

Wat wij verwachten:

  • Minimaal 1 jaar werkervaring in salarisadministratie

  • PDL- en/of VPS-diploma (of bereid dit te behalen)

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau

  • Nauwkeurigheid, analytisch inzicht en klantgerichte instelling

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands

Klaar om jouw expertise in te zetten bij een groeiend bedrijf? Solliciteer nu!

FAQ

Hoe groot is het team?
Je werkt in een team van 6-10 collega’s binnen een afdeling van circa 30 payrollspecialisten.

Werk ik vooral zelfstandig of samen?
Je hebt je eigen klanten, maar werkt nauw samen en kunt sparren met ervaren collega’s.

Hoe werken jullie samen tijdens drukke deadlines?
We stemmen de planning af en verdelen het werk, zodat we elkaar helpen waar nodig.

Hoeveel vrijheid heb ik in mijn werk?
Binnen onze afspraken bepaal je grotendeels zelf wanneer je wat doet, zolang klantafspraken worden nagekomen.

Wat gebeurt er met mijn verbetervoorstellen?
Je bespreekt je idee met je teamleider. Samen kijken jullie wie nodig is om het verder op te pakken.

Weten welke stappen jij kunt verwachten na jouw sollicitatie? Kijk hier.

title: Full Stack Developer - .NET (Intermediate)
description:
Role Purpose

Reporting to the VP, Solutions & Delivery, we are looking for a talented and motivated Full Stack Developer – .NET to join our development team. The ideal candidate will have strong experience building scalable, secure, and high-performance web applications using the Microsoft .NET ecosystem, along with modern front-end technologies.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining end-to-end applications while working closely with product managers, business analysts, QA engineers, DevOps teams, and other developers.

Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain full-stack web applications using C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, and Web API.
  • Build responsive and user-friendly front-end applications using React, Angular, Blazor, or similar modern JavaScript/C# frameworks.
  • Develop scalable RESTful APIs and integrate third-party services and enterprise systems.
  • Design and optimize relational databases using SQL Server, including tables, stored procedures, views, functions, and queries.
  • Implement secure authentication and authorization using technologies such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, and ASP.NET Core Identity.
  • Process and transform large fixed-width and delimited (CSV/flat) input files as part of data integration and batch workflows.
  • Generate large, well-structured XML output and associated XSD schemas for downstream systems and partners.
  • Integrate with document/PDF generation platforms such as Quadient, Exstream, or SmartCOMM to support customer communications.
  • Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well-tested code following established coding standards and design patterns.
  • Participate in architecture and technical design discussions and contribute to application modernization initiatives.
  • Develop unit, integration, and automated tests to ensure application quality and reliability.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application defects, performance issues, and production incidents.
  • Work with DevOps teams to support CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, monitoring, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, API documentation, and development standards.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and recommend improvements to development practices and application architecture.

Required Qualifications

Backend

  • Strong proficiency in C#
  • Hands-on experience with .NET / .NET Core
  • Strong experience with ASP.NET Core
  • Experience developing RESTful Web APIs
  • Knowledge of Entity Framework Core
  • Understanding of dependency injection, middleware, configuration, logging, and application lifecycle
  • Good understanding of object-oriented programming and SOLID principles
  • Experience with common design patterns and clean architecture principles
  • Experience processing large fixed-width and delimited input files
  • Experience generating large XML files and XSD schemas
  • Experience integrating with PDF generation software such as Quadient, Exstream, SmartCOMM, or similar

Frontend

  • Strong experience with JavaScript / TypeScript
  • Hands-on experience with at least one modern framework: React, Angular, Vue.js, or Blazor (C#-based)
  • Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive web design
  • Experience consuming REST APIs and handling client-side state
  • Familiarity with frontend build tools and package managers such as npm

Database

  • Strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server
  • Proficiency in writing complex SQL queries
  • Experience with stored procedures, functions, views, indexes, and query optimization
  • Understanding of database design, normalization, transactions, and performance tuning
  • Experience with Entity Framework Core or another ORM

Cloud & DevOps

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure or another major cloud platform
  • Familiarity with Azure services such as Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Azure Key Vault, and Azure Service Bus
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with Git-based source control and branching strategies
  • Experience with Docker and containerization is a plus
  • Understanding of application monitoring, logging, and observability

Testing & Quality

  • Experience with unit testing using frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest
  • Understanding of integration and API testing
  • Familiarity with mocking frameworks such as Moq
  • Experience with automated testing and continuous integration
  • Strong understanding of secure coding and application performance practices

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with microservices architecture
  • Knowledge of Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of messaging technologies such as Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, or Kafka
  • Experience with Redis or other caching technologies
  • Knowledge of GraphQL is a plus
  • Familiarity with Elasticsearch or similar search technologies
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum development methodologies
  • Understanding of Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
  • Experience with application performance monitoring tools
  • Knowledge of AI/ML integrations or consuming LLM APIs is a plus

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3–7+ years of professional software development experience, depending on level.
  • Strong hands–on experience with the .NET ecosystem and modern frontend development.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering production-grade web applications.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

What We're Looking For

  • A strong problem solver with excellent attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working across both frontend and backend technologies.
  • Able to take ownership of features from requirements through deployment.
  • Passionate about writing clean, maintainable, and scalable code.
  • Comfortable working in a collaborative Agile environment.
  • Able to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Typical Technology Stack

  • Backend: C#, .NET 8/9+, ASP.NET Core, Web API, Entity Framework Core
  • Frontend: React / Angular / Blazor, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3
  • Database: Microsoft SQL Server
  • Cloud: Microsoft Azure
  • DevOps: Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Docker
  • Testing: xUnit / NUnit, Moq, Postman
  • Version Control: Git / GitHub / Azure Repos
  • Architecture: REST APIs, Microservices, Clean Architecture, SOLID, Design Patterns
  • Data & Documents: Fixed-width & delimited file processing, XML/XSD generation, PDF/document composition (Quadient, Exstream, SmartCOMM)
