title: Access & Pricing Strategy Lead (Belgium)
description:
Make your mark for patients

We are looking for an Access & Pricing Strategy Lead who is strategic, influential, and collaborative to join our Global Patient Evidence organisation, helping shape integrated payer, pricing, and access strategies that maximize patient access and long-term value across UCB's portfolio based in Slough, UK or Brussels, Belgium.

About the Role
As Access & Pricing Strategy Lead, you will play a critical role in translating payer, policy, evidence, pricing, and access considerations into actionable strategic choices and global deliverables that support asset success throughout the product lifecycle.

Acting as a strategic partner to Asset Payer Heads, you will help shape payer strategies, influence key development and commercialization decisions, and ensure payer perspectives are embedded early and consistently. Working within a complex global environment, you will lead through influence rather than formal authority, aligning diverse stakeholders around shared priorities while driving decision-ready recommendations and high-quality execution.

This role offers a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of payer strategy, market access, evidence generation, pricing, and portfolio decision-making.

Who You’ll Work With
You will collaborate closely with Asset Payer Heads, HEOR, Real-World Evidence, Pricing, Policy, Market Access, Patient Impact, Commercial Planning, regional and local market access teams, and a broad network of cross-functional stakeholders.

You will act as a key connector across the organization, ensuring payer insights and access considerations are integrated into strategic planning and decision-making.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Asset Payer Heads to co-create global payer, access, and pricing strategies and global deliverables.
  • Lead the development and execution of payer strategies, evidence generation plans, pricing approaches, negotiation readiness activities, and key global deliverables.
  • Maximize asset payer potential by shaping clinical development plans and identifying payer risks and mitigation strategies.
  • Develop and oversee competitive evidence generation strategies that support payer and reimbursement objectives.
  • Define global access strategies and provide clarity on strategic trade-offs, dependencies, and decision points.
  • Lead strategic payer engagements and translate external insights into actionable business recommendations.
  • Present payer perspectives and strategic recommendations within leadership and governance forums.
  • Define payer workstreams, budgets, resource requirements, and long-range planning priorities.
  • Coordinate cross-functional activities across Market Access, Pricing, HEOR, RWE, Policy, Commercial, and regional teams.
  • Build alignment across stakeholders and drive decisions through influence, credibility, and strategic leadership.
  • Leverage advanced analytics, AI-enabled insights, and external market intelligence to anticipate future access risks and opportunities.
  • Foster collaboration, continuous learning, and capability building across the Access & Pricing community.

Interested? For this role we’re looking for:

  • Degree in Life Sciences, Health Economics, Public Health, Pharmacy, Business, or a related discipline.
  • Significant experience in market access, payer strategy, pricing, health economics, outcomes research, medical affairs, commercial or related pharmaceutical functions.
  • Strong understanding of payer evidence requirements, reimbursement processes, pricing strategy, and market access planning.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in complex global matrix organizations and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Excellent analytical, strategic thinking, and decision-making skills, with the ability to simplify complexity into actionable recommendations.
  • Experience leveraging analytics, digital tools, and AI-enabled insights to support business strategy and planning.

Are you ready to ‘go beyond’ to create value and make your mark for patients? If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you!

About us
UCB is a global biopharmaceutical company, focusing on neurology and immunology. We are over 9.000 people in all four corners of the globe, inspired by patients and driven by science.

Why work with us?
At UCB, we don’t just complete tasks, we create value. We aren’t afraid to push forward, collaborate, and innovate to make our mark for patients. We have a caring, supportive culture where everyone feels included, respected, and has equal opportunities to do their best work. We ‘go beyond’ to create value for our patients, and always with a human focus, whether that’s on our patients, our employees, or our planet. Working for us, you will discover a place where you can grow, and have the freedom to carve your own career path to achieve your full potential.

At UCB, we’ve embraced a hybrid-first approach to work, bringing teams together in local hubs to foster collaborative curiosity. Unless expressly stated in the description or precluded by the nature of the position, roles are hybrid with 40% of your time spent in the office.

UCB is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions will be made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Should you require any adjustments to our process to assist you in demonstrating your strengths and capabilities contact us on EMEA-Reasonable_Accommodation@ucb.com. Please note should your enquiry not relate to adjustments; we will not be able to support you through this channel.

title: Software Architect
description:
Job Type: Full-time

Workplace Type: On-site

Experience: 10+ years

Industry: Technology, Information and Internet

About the Role

Build the architecture behind the future of digital recruitment.

We are looking for an experienced Software Architect to play a key role in shaping the technical future of Imploy, a growing digital platform connecting talent and employers.

This is more than a traditional architecture role. You will work hands-on with a live production platform, making high-impact decisions across software architecture, data, cloud infrastructure, and AI while helping transform the platform into a scalable, secure, and reliable technology ecosystem.

You will have the opportunity to influence how the platform evolves—from its core data model and cloud architecture to AI capabilities, search, scalability, security, and engineering practices.

What You’ll Own

  • Define the target architecture and technical roadmap for the Imploy platform.
  • Lead architectural decisions across applications, data, cloud infrastructure, and AI services.
  • Design and evolve a Canonical Data Model and lead data migration within a live production environment.
  • Help establish a scalable and standardized job and occupation taxonomy using frameworks such as ESCO, ISCO, O*NET, or SOC.
  • Shape technology standards and design patterns across .NET, Microsoft Azure, web, and mobile applications.
  • Strengthen engineering practices including CI/CD, environment management, versioning, and deployment.
  • Establish architecture documentation, technical standards, and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
  • Build data foundations that support product intelligence, search, automation, and AI capabilities.
  • Champion Security by Design, data privacy, data localization, PDPL compliance, and responsible third-party data governance.
  • Evaluate architectural initiatives based on their technical impact, complexity, cost, and business value.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Cybersecurity teams across Riyadh and Cairo.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor and help engineering teams make sound architectural decisions.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with significant experience in software architecture.
  • Proven experience designing and scaling high-traffic digital platforms, marketplaces, or consumer-facing products.
  • Strong hands-on experience with production systems and large-scale data environments.
  • Deep knowledge of software architecture and data modeling, including data migration and system modernization.
  • Strong experience with .NET and cloud architecture, preferably Microsoft Azure.
  • Practical experience with CI/CD, DevOps, release management, and modern engineering practices.
  • Strong understanding of security, privacy, data governance, and scalable system design.
  • Ability to influence and lead technical initiatives across engineering teams without relying on direct reporting lines.
  • Excellent English communication skills; Arabic is a plus.

It’s a Plus If You Have

  • Experience in HR Tech, Recruitment, Marketplace, or Digital Platforms.
  • Experience working with AI/ML services in production.
  • Familiarity with ESCO, ISCO, O*NET, or SOC classification standards.
  • Knowledge of PDPL or similar data privacy regulations.
  • Experience working with distributed engineering teams across multiple locations.

Why This Role?

You will not simply maintain an existing architecture.

You will help shape what comes next.

From modernizing the platform's core architecture to building data foundations for AI and creating scalable engineering practices, your decisions will directly influence the future of Imploy.

If you are an architect who enjoys solving complex problems, working hands-on with real production systems, and building technology that scales, we would like to hear from you.

Candidate Location

Candidates must currently be based in Riyadh or Cairo.

title: Internship, Robot Learning Research
description:
Here at Humanoid, we believe in a future where robots amplify human potential. That’s why we’ve set out on a mission to build the world’s most capable, commercially-scalable, and safe humanoid robots. We’re bringing that mission to life with HMND‑01 - our rapidly developed humanoid platform being deployed in real industrial environments - and we’re growing the team to take it even further.

Our Mission

We're building software systems that enable robots to operate effectively in the real world, expanding human capability and redefining how work gets done.

The Opportunity

We're looking for interns who are curious, proactive, and excited to work on real-world robotic systems.

Depending on your interests and skills, you will be able to work across our research stack: reinforcement learning, world models, pretraining, and inference & optimisation. That spans everything from training policies in simulation, through building the generative models that let robots predict their world, to squeezing models onto real-time edge compute. You'll collaborate closely with the team to find where you can have the most impact, and we're looking for people who are excited to dive into unfamiliar areas and learn quickly.

This is a full-time internship (5 days per week), based in our London office, where you'll contribute to real systems from early on with guidance and support from experienced researchers and engineers.

Duration: 12 to 24 weeks | Start date: Flexible | Compensation: Competitive pay and perks

What you might work on

Reinforcement Learning

  • Train language-vision conditioned manipulation policies via RL in the real world

  • Construct challenging and diverse suites of manipulation tasks and RL models in simulation (Isaac Sim, MuJoCo)

  • Experiment with ways of bringing policies trained in simulation to the real world

World Models

  • Action-conditioned video prediction and dynamics models that stay physically consistent over long horizons

  • Use world models as learned simulators: score candidate policies offline and generate synthetic rollouts for training

  • Build fidelity metrics that quantify where the world model can be trusted

Pre- and post-training

  • In-context learning

  • Short and long term memory

  • Post-training VLA models on specific production-grade use cases

  • Different data modalities, closing embodiment gap between human and robot data, data diversity and attribution.

Inference & Optimisation

  • Optimise models for real-time edge inference on robot hardware: profiling, quantisation, and latency/throughput trade-offs

  • Improve training and data-loading performance across distributed GPU infrastructure

What We're Looking For

  • Candidates pursuing or holding a master’s or PhD in computer science, machine learning, robotics, or a related field.

  • Strong foundations in machine learning; strong Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch or JAX.

  • Interest in one or more of: reinforcement learning, world models and generative video, VLA/multimodal models, or ML systems and inference optimisation.

  • Experience running experiments and interpreting results with rigour.

  • Ability to take ownership and iterate with guidance.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Fast learner, comfortable in a research-driven, fast-moving environment.

What We Offer

  • Free daily breakfast, catered lunch, and snacks in-office.

  • Work at the frontier - collaborate daily with world-class engineers, researchers, and product experts building the next generation of AI and humanoid robotics.

  • Real ownership - direct access to founding leadership, meaningful input on product direction, and the ability to drive key initiatives from day one.

How to apply

Complete the challenge below and submit your solution as a public GitHub repository. You will be able to include your GitHub repository URL when you fill out the application form, alongside your name and CV. You have two weeks to complete the challenge and submit your solution. The deadline for submission is Friday, 9 October 2026, 23:59 BST.

We're not looking for standard solutions, we're looking for how you think. The strongest submissions are creative, original, and push beyond the obvious.

Intern Challenge:

The goal of the challenge is to use real data collected by an applicant to drive a robotic manipulator in a simple simulation environment (e.g. Libero). The applicant is welcome to use a simple phone to record a small manipulation dataset and use it creatively showcasing their knowledge with VLA and/or World Models.

Here is an example of how it might look like:

Left: a snapshot from an egocentric hand-manipulation video sample; Right: simulation environment where we use that data to drive a Panda arm in Libero simulator with a trained policy based on SmolVLA.

Some suggestions on how you can develop your project:

  • use your recorded egocentric data to post-train a policy on a simple task

  • explore creative retargeting strategies, e.g. adapt your data to challenging embodiments

  • bootstrap a policy and use any form of RL to get better performance

  • use world modelling to showcase video/state prediction, less focusing on policy performance

  • optimise a standard policy to run considerably faster than a baseline

However, we don’t want to limit your imagination: in the age of AI agents, a standard task can now be easily achieved. You are welcome to use any resources at your disposal as long as the main constraint is achieved: you use the data that you personally collected. At the same time, we tried to design the challenge so that it could be hand-coded as well. We also checked that many ideas do not require access to large compute and could be done on Google Colab GPU notebooks.

What to submit

Complete the challenge above and submit your solution as a public GitHub repository by Friday, 9 October 2026, 23:59 BST. Include a README/Presentation with instructions to run your system, example outputs, and a note on your design choices, what worked and what didn’t.

What we care about

  • Creativity in approach, while satisfying the constraint: the data you collected must play a role in the approach

  • Performance of your policy in simulation and/or quality of WM predictions

  • Implementation simplicity and clear presentation of results without AI slop

Make something you’re proud of!

  • Je stelt handleidingen, release notes en functionele documentatie op.
  • Je analyseert incidenten en problemen en werkt hiervoor samen met ontwikkelteams.
  • Je beheert applicatieconfiguraties zoals gebruikersrollen, workflows en parameterinstellingen.
  • Je ondersteunt acceptatietesten en bewaakt de kwaliteit van nieuwe releases.
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat best practices worden gedeeld tussen verschillende ziekenhuizen.
  • Vanaf mediorniveau neem je functionele analyse-opdrachten op en vertaal je gebruikersnoden naar concrete oplossingen.
  • Je gebruikt technische hulpmiddelen zoals SQL, HL7 en andere integratietechnologieën om problemen te analyseren en op te lossen.

Welke collega zoeken we?

We zijn op zoek naar een enthousiaste Medical Application Expert die zichzelf herkent in volgende eigenschappen:
  • Passie voor digitale zorg: je hebt interesse in ziekenhuisprocessen, klinische workflows en innovatieve IT-oplossingen.
  • Relevante expertise: je hebt een achtergrond in gezondheidszorg-IT, biomedische informatica, verpleegkunde of een gelijkaardig domein.
  • Communicatief en klantgericht: je vertaalt complexe informatie helder naar eindgebruikers en vormt de brug tussen IT en zorg.
  • Analytisch, leergierig en oplossingsgericht: je pakt problemen gestructureerd aan en verdiept je graag in nieuwe technologieën.
  • Teamspeler met technische affiniteit: je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, werkt vlot samen en hebt bij voorkeur kennis van SQL. Kennis van HL7/FHIR is een troef.
  • Taalvaardig: Nederlands is de voertaal binnen UZ Brussel en je beheerst deze taal vlot. Kennis van Frans en/of Engels is een bijkomende troef.

title: Data & AI Engineer
description:
Ventós Group is an international company specialized in the distribution and production of Essential Oils & Aroma Chemicals with the Head Quarters located in Barcelona, Spain. The group has 9 subsidiaries around the world.

We are building Ventós’ Data & AI function and are looking for someone who wants to play an active role in its development from the very beginning.

We are looking for a profile with professional experience, a strong technical foundation, analytical skills, curiosity, and a desire to continue growing. You don’t need to be a specialist in a single discipline: the role will work cross-functionally across data, analytics, and artificial intelligence, addressing real business challenges.

You will work directly with the Data & AI Manager, in coordination with IT, business teams, and technology partners.

Responsibilities:

  • Explore and understand data from the ERP and other corporate systems, identify data quality inconsistencies, and help resolve them.
  • Build and maintain data loading, transformation, and validation processes.
  • Contribute to the design of data models and semantic models.
  • Develop and enhance Power BI reports, models, and dashboards, as well as existing Analysis Services cubes, troubleshooting issues and incorporating new business requirements.
  • Participate in prototypes and use cases involving generative AI, LLMs, and AI agents, connecting them with data, APIs, and corporate tools.
  • Create tests and evaluation mechanisms to validate data and AI solutions.
  • Document developments and work with version control.

Requirements

  • A minimum of 2 years of professional experience in data, analytics, or artificial intelligence projects, or in software development strongly related to data. Ideally, we are looking for profiles with between 2 and 4 years of experience.
  • A university degree or master’s degree in a technological, quantitative, or data-related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience working with databases, data transformation, and ETL/ELT processes.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and Python, good software development practices, and experience working with Git.
  • An interest in artificial intelligence and LLMs. If you have worked on any projects using these technologies, even personal ones, we would love to hear about them.

Technology Environment

You will work in an environment that includes, among others, the following technologies:

  • SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and Microsoft Analysis Services.
  • Power BI.
  • Python and FastAPI.
  • Visual Studio Code and Visual Studio.
  • Git.

Nice to Have

You are not expected to have expertise in all of these areas, but experience or exposure to any of the following would be a plus:

  • Dimensional modeling and semantic layers.
  • REST APIs and data service development.
  • Docker and Linux.
  • ERP systems or Dynamics 365 Business Central.
  • LLMs, RAG, embeddings, AI agents, or MCP.
  • Machine Learning, inference, or optimization.

Additional Information

We offer a benefits package which includes:

  • Remote work: 1 full day and 2 afternoons per week.
  • Free language classes and access to other training courses.
  • Health insurance.
  • Shared spaces for after-work activities.
  • Subsidized meals and breakfast service.
  • Corporate paddle tennis court for employees and their families.

title: Roosterplanner - Zuid-Hollandse Eilanden en Drechtsteden
description:
Bij het roosterbureau Zuid-Hollandse Eilanden en Drechtsteden zorgen we ervoor dat de juiste mensen op het juiste moment op de juiste plek staan. Wij maken en beheren de (basis)roosters en regelen de dagelijkse inzet van medewerkers op verschillende locaties in de regio. Zoek jij een afwisselende baan in een betrokken en deskundig team? Dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Over Gemiva

Gemiva ondersteunt mensen met een verstandelijke, lichamelijke of meervoudige beperking en mensen met niet-aangeboren hersenletsel. We helpen cliënten om zo zelfstandig mogelijk te leven, mee te doen in de samenleving en keuzes te maken die bij hen passen.

Dat doen we op woonlocaties, dagactiviteitenlocaties, kinderdienstencentra en binnen ambulante begeleiding. Samen met cliënten, verwanten en collega’s kijken we naar wat iemand nodig heeft om een zo goed mogelijk leven te leiden.

Binnen Gemiva werken we met betrokken collega’s die elkaar helpen, verantwoordelijkheid nemen en samen zoeken naar wat wél kan.

Wat ga je doen?

Als roosterplanner ben je een onmisbare schakel in de zorg. Door slim te plannen zorg jij ervoor dat cliënten elke dag de zorg krijgen die ze nodig hebben.

  • Je maakt de roosters voor verschillende locaties.

  • Je denkt met de locatiemanagers mee over de meest efficiënte inzet van medewerkers.

  • Gaat er onverwacht iets mis, bijvoorbeeld door ziekte of een late afmelding? Dan los je samen met je collega's de roosterverstoring op.

  • Je luistert goed naar de wensen van medewerkers en vertaalt die naar een gezond en prettig rooster.

Wij zoeken jou

Dit breng je mee

  • Ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie, bij voorkeur als planner of roostermaker. Je vindt het een uitdaging om een rooster te laten kloppen.

  • Creativiteit en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel. Je bedenkt oplossingen als een rooster niet sluitend is en neemt je beslissingen serieus.

  • Zin om te blijven leren en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

  • Organisatietalent. Je houdt overzicht en blijft rustig als het druk wordt.

  • Een stevige persoonlijkheid en goede communicatieve vaardigheden. Je durft duidelijk te zijn naar collega's, medewerkers en locatiemanagers en blijft daarbij vriendelijk.

  • ·Een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG).

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een warm welkom in een fijn team, met veel ruimte en verantwoordelijkheid;

  • Een interessante en uitdagende doelgroep om voor te werken;

  • Afwisseling: geen dag is hetzelfde;

  • Een werkplek waar we werken aan hetzelfde doel: een zo goed mogelijk leven van de mensen die wij ondersteunen;

  • Feestdagen omwisselen voor een dag die voor jou betekenisvol is;

  • Een aanstelling voor bepaalde tijd, voor de duur van een jaar, met uitzicht op een vaste aanstelling;

  • 8% vakantietoeslag en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering;

  • Arbeidsvoorwaarden en salariëring conform CAO Gehandicaptenzorg, FG 40, met een maximum van € 3.902,- bruto per maand bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur per week;

  • De mogelijkheid om vakantietoeslag/eindejaarsuitkering uit te ruilen voor extra verlof of reiskosten;

  • Bruto-netto regelingen voor fiets, tablet of sportabonnement;

  • Goed pensioen via PFZW;

Interesse?

Wil jij als roosterplanner bijdragen aan goede zorg in de regio Zuid-Hollandse Eilanden en Drechtsteden? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

title: Remote Full-Stack Engineer (Part-Time, AI-Driven Backend)
description:

Experience building backend-focused web applications. Ability to own tasks and work independently. Familiar with API integration and CMS solutions. Experience with AI-assisted development is a plus.

title: Head of Technical Services
description:
We are Conscious Group! Conscious Group consists of nine hotels, four Hotel V locations and five Conscious Hotels locations, and three restaurants. Here, hospitality, design, and sustainability come together. Conscious Hotels focuses on sustainability down to the smallest detail, without compromising on comfort. While Hotel V is known for its stylish, characterful, and authentically Amsterdam vibe. Within Conscious Group, all locations work together as one team, driven by our FOCAL values: Fun, Open, Connect, Ambition, and Love. And now, Conscious Hotels is looking for a Head of Technical Services.

In our hotels, hospitality is at the heart of everything we do. To deliver a great guest experience, our buildings and technical installations need to be safe, reliable, efficient, and well maintained. As Head of Technical Services, you oversee and support the technical operations of our five Conscious Hotels. Each hotel has its own Technical Services employee, who works under the direct leadership of the Hotel Manager or Rooms Division Manager of that location. Your role is to connect, coach, and support these colleagues and to be their technical sparring partner when challenges become more complex.

You combine technical knowledge with coordination and oversight, while still being hands-on when needed. When a larger or more complex technical issue occurs, you work alongside the Technical Services employee to investigate the problem and find the right solution. You manage our central maintenance contracts with external partners, ensure preventive and corrective maintenance is carried out properly, and help maintain high standards for safety, quality, and sustainability across all our hotels. You report directly to the Head of Operations Conscious Hotels.

In this role, you will report directly to the Head of Operations Conscious Hotels.

What you will do:

  • Coach and support the Technical Services employees across our five Conscious Hotels, helping them develop their technical knowledge and find solutions to more complex technical challenges;

  • Step in when larger or more complex technical breakdowns occur and work together with the local Technical Services employee to diagnose and resolve the issue;

  • Act as the technical sparring partner for Hotel Managers and Rooms Division Managers and advise them on maintenance, installations, repairs, and technical improvements;

  • Manage our central maintenance contracts and relationships with external technical partners;

  • Ensure that planned preventive maintenance is carried out on time and according to the agreed standards, and follow up on corrective maintenance where required;

  • Monitor the quality and execution of work carried out by external contractors and suppliers;

  • Take a coordinating role in smaller projects within the hotels when these have a significant technical component, from planning and alignment with the hotel to coordinating suppliers and overseeing execution;

  • Help ensure our hotels provide a safe environment for guests and colleagues, with particular attention to fire safety and legionella management;

  • Coordinate our in-house painter, who works across all Conscious Hotels. Together with the Hotel Managers, you plan painting and maintenance work in guest rooms and public areas;

  • Support the hotels with larger maintenance projects and technical improvements and help determine when specialist external support is required;

  • Work together with the Head of Operations to identify opportunities to reduce energy consumption. You actively monitor our energy dashboard, analyse consumption and translate the data into practical improvements;

  • Look beyond individual hotels and identify recurring technical issues and opportunities to improve maintenance, efficiency, and reliability across all five locations.

About you:

  • You are an experienced Technical Services professional ready for the next step, or already have experience as a Head of Technical Services in a hotel, hospitality, or multi-site environment;

  • You have several years of experience in technical services, building maintenance, or facilities engineering and have a broad understanding of building-related installations;

  • You enjoy sharing your knowledge and coaching technical colleagues, but you are equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves and working alongside them when a technical challenge requires it;

  • You are comfortable coordinating multiple locations, suppliers, maintenance contracts, and smaller technical projects at the same time;

  • You understand the importance of preventive maintenance and know how to organise and monitor this effectively;

  • You have knowledge of building and guest safety. Experience with fire safety and legionella management is a strong advantage;

  • You have an eye for detail and understand that technical quality, appearance, and guest experience go hand in hand in a hotel;

  • You are interested in sustainability and energy management and enjoy using data to identify opportunities for improvement;

  • You are practical, proactive, organised, and able to communicate easily with Technical Services employees, Hotel Managers, external contractors, and management;

  • Available for 32–40 hours per week and flexible when hotel operations require it;

  • Preferably based in or near Amsterdam.

Join the Fun & Perks:

  • We offer a suitable salary according to the collective labour agreement for hospitality in reference scale 8;

  • Travel allowance based on the distance between home and work (min. 15 km);

title: Huishoudelijke hulp Oisterwijk
description:
Word jij het zonnetje in huis? Kom werken als Huishoudelijke Hulp!

Werkgebied: Oisterwijk
Contract: 2-24 uur per week, flexibele werktijden

Bij Miep Huishoudservice en Begeleiding draait alles om het creëren van een écht thuisgevoel – niet alleen voor onze cliënten, maar ook voor jou als medewerker. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je je gewaardeerd voelt, je werk met plezier doet en altijd de steun krijgt die je nodig hebt. Flexibiliteit, persoonlijke aandacht en een fijne werksfeer staan bij ons centraal!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Huishoudelijke Hulp bij Miep Huishoudservice zorg je ervoor dat onze cliënten zich thuis blijven voelen in hun eigen woning, ook als zij zelf niet meer volledig voor het huishouden kunnen zorgen. Jouw taken bestaan uit:

  • Schoonmaken, stofzuigen en andere huishoudelijke werkzaamheden.

  • Cliënten zoveel mogelijk betrekken bij het huishouden.

  • Persoonlijke aandacht en een luisterend oor bieden.

Jij maakt elke dag het verschil! Dankzij jouw hulp blijft het huis van onze cliënten schoon en fijn, waardoor zij langer zelfstandig kunnen blijven wonen. Een sociaal en dankbaar beroep waarin jij elke dag iets moois betekent voor een ander!

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij ons bepaal jij je eigen werktijden en -dagen! Extra werken in de vakantie? Geen probleem! Je krijgt een salaris volgens de cao VVT, vanaf € 15,07 bruto per uur afhankelijk van ervaring, met jaarlijkse verhogingen tot € 18,27. Daarnaast ontvang je vakantiegeld (8%) en een eindejaarsuitkering (8,33%), die je ook maandelijks kunt laten uitbetalen. Ook bouw je pensioen op en kun je gebruikmaken van een collectieve zorgverzekering. Reiskosten (zoals auto, fiets, brommer of scooter) en reistijd tussen cliënten worden vergoed.

We investeren in jouw groei met een digitaal onboardingsprogramma via de MiepApp vol e-learnings. Wil je alvast een kijkje nemen? Klik dan hier. Je krijgt een contract voor bepaalde tijd met de intentie tot een vaste aanstelling. Twee keer per jaar organiseren we een medewerkersbijeenkomst om je collega’s beter te leren kennen. Miep is een warme, betrokken werkgever die naar je luistert. Jouw werk is niet alleen belangrijk, maar maakt ook écht een verschil voor onze cliënten!

Wie ben jij?

  • Jij bent het zonnetje in huis, zorgzaam en hebt een groot inlevingsvermogen.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor je taken.

  • Je spreekt en begrijpt Nederlands.

  • Je bent minimaal 2 uur per week beschikbaar tussen 9:00 en 18:00 uur (ma-vr).

  • Ervaring is mooi meegenomen, maar enthousiasme en een passie voor schoonmaken zijn minstens zo belangrijk!

  • Je hebt eigen vervoer (auto, scooter of fiets) om naar cliënten te reizen.

Enthousiast geworden?

Wil jij het verschil maken en onze cliënten laten stralen? Solliciteer vandaag nog!
Stuur je CV en motivatie naar ons op en wie weet verwelkomen wij jou binnenkort als onze nieuwe collega. Na je sollicitatie laten we je zo snel mogelijk weten hoe het verder gaat. Bij indiensttreding vragen wij een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) aan.

Meer informatie

title: Moderators - Music Technology
description:
Overview

Flexible Worker Contract

Location: Remote

About the role

We're looking for Moderators to join our External Quality Assurance team on a flexible worker contract for the following qualification:

Level 1/2 Technical Award in Music Technology

As a Moderator, you'll play a key role in ensuring that centres assess learners fairly, accurately and consistently. You'll review centre-marked work, apply quality assurance principles, and provide clear, constructive feedback to ensure national standards are maintained.

We’re keen to hear from individuals with a strong background in music technology, with experience of teaching and/or assessing learners in this subject area. You may currently work, or have previously worked, as a Music Technology Teacher, Music Production Lecturer, Audio Production Lecturer or Music and Sound Teacher.

Whilst this is a flexible worker role, we require a reasonable level of commitment throughout the moderation window. Moderation activities begin in March 2027 where you will be expected to attend one of our Annual Training sessions. The primary moderation period will be between April and August 2027, during which your engagement will be most critical.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Conducting moderation activities in line with awarding organisation and regulatory requirements
  • Attending standardisation and team meetings as required
  • Reviewing centre marking to ensure assessment decisions are accurate, consistent and meet required standards
  • Producing clear, accurate and timely moderation reports within agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Planning and managing moderation activity for allocated centres in line with sampling strategies and quality assurance requirements
  • Supporting continuous improvement by identifying areas for development and sharing best practice
  • Maintaining up-to-date knowledge of the qualification, assessment requirements and your subject-specialist area

We'd love to hear from you if you offer the following:

  • A relevant qualification at Level 3 or above in music technology or a closely related subject area
  • Current or recent occupational experience working within the music technology sector
  • Experience of teaching, assessing, internal quality assuring and/or moderating vocational or academic qualifications
  • Strong knowledge of assessment and quality assurance processes
  • Excellent written communication and report-writing skills
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to work independently and meet deadlines
  • A commitment to maintaining high standards and delivering a positive experience for centres

Feeling inspired? Read the full Job Description

Why work as a flexible worker for NCFE?

Our flexible workforce provides supportive quality assurance to ensure that learners taking NCFE qualifications are getting the best education possible. If you become a flexible worker with us, you’ll choose how to fit your work around your other personal and professional commitments – making this a great opportunity to make a difference in a way that suits you.

You’ll receive full training and the materials, tools or equipment needed to ensure you’re able to complete your duties in line with NCFE requirements, with the ability to take on flexible worker contract alongside other work, without the need to be registered as self-employed.

All applicants will be expected to adhere to NCFE’s behavioural framework and to uphold our core values.

You can find out more about how our flexible arrangements work, the flexible worker roles we recruit, and frequently asked questions around the application, induction and training process, and your rights and protections by visiting our Flexible worker opportunities page.

Shape real change with an NCFE career

Imagine a career where your contributions affect not only what people learn, but the way that learning is developed and delivered.

With over 170 years of education experience our core purpose remains at the heart of the organisation – to promote and advance learning to create a fairer, more inclusive society, making sure no learner is left behind.

Want to know more? Take a look at our website https://www.ncfe.org.uk/

How to apply

Before applying, please note that we require all candidates to be able to demonstrate proof of Right to Work in the UK.

Ready to join us and shape real change? Apply with your CV and answer the associated application questions.

Closing Date: Wednesday 2 December 2026

Interview Date: Ongoing

Interview Details: Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. If your application is shortlisted, we’ll contact you to complete a short task.

Equality, Diversity and Inclusion (EDI) statement

We're committed to building rich diversity into our workforce at all levels, to ensure that we understand and are representative of the communities and customers we serve.

We do not discriminate against anyone due to their gender, sexuality, race, age, religion, beliefs, identity, social background, visible or hidden disability, or neurodiversity. Instead, we pride ourselves on our collaborative, vibrant and high-performance culture which embraces everyone, celebrates uniqueness, and enables everyone's voice to be heard.

title: Senior Integrity Engineer
description:
Senior Integrity Engineer

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity.

Your team

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department of 52 colleagues.

Together the team delivers 100+ integrity reports a year for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

· Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it.

· Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards.

· Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities.

· Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions.

· Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data.

· Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards.

· Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early.

What you bring

Must-haves

· A degree in Mechanical and/or Materials (or Metallurgical) Engineering, ideally a combination of both. A Master's degree is a strong plus.

· At least 5 years of relevant experience in the structural integrity of pressurised equipment, preferably pipelines, including independently performing and reviewing FFS assessments and remaining life calculations.

· Strong working knowledge of fracture mechanics and corrosion and fatigue damage mechanisms.

· Working knowledge of API 579 / ASME FFS-1, API 530, ASME B31G, DNV-RP-F101, API 1183, ASME VIII Div. 2 and ASME PCC-2, and of the international regulations for pipeline and pressure equipment integrity.

· Experience with risk assessments and turning results into clear, actionable recommendations.

· Strong mathematics and statistics, including probabilistic methods.

· Programming skills to solve engineering problems, preferably in Python, VBA or MATLAB.

· Mid to advanced-level training in integrity assessment methods.

· You write clear, professional technical reports and explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

· You work independently with minimal supervision, keep your agreements, and are flexible with working hours to collaborate with colleagues in Canada and Mexico.

· You are curious, proactive and a team player who suggests improvements to help the team work better and avoid rework.

Nice-to-haves

· Hands-on experience with finite element analysis (FEA), preferably ABAQUS.

· Experience with creep assessment of boilers and heaters.

· Exposure to Level 3 FFS assessments.

title: Persoonlijk begeleider intensief, Maria van Oranjestraat 6 Leerdam
description:
Wat ga je doen?
Als persoonlijk begeleider ben jij hét vertrouwde aanspreekpunt voor 3 tot 4 bewoners met een verstandelijke beperking. Jij coördineert hun behandeling en begeleiding en staat zelf midden in de dagelijkse praktijk. Daardoor zie je precies wat iemand nodig heeft om te groeien en hoe jij, samen met collega's en verwanten, het verschil maakt.

Tijdens je dienst ben je degene op wie bewoners kunnen rekenen. Je start de dag samen op, of verwelkomt hen na de dagbesteding. Je betrekt hen actief bij het dagelijkse leven op de woning. We werken vanuit het samen 100-principe: jij vult aan waar nodig, zodat jullie samen tot 100% komen.

Samen met de orthopedagoog en teamleider zorg je voor een goede afstemming van behandeling en werkoverleg. Jij zet de lijnen uit en neemt collega’s hierin mee.

  • Je ontwikkelt en evalueert dag-, ontwikkelings- en trainingsprogramma’s.

  • Je neemt deel aan maandelijkse multidisciplinaire overleggen.

  • Je krijgt sturing van de teamleider en geeft zelf richting aan begeleiders en ondersteunend begeleiders.

  • Samen staan jullie voor menswaardige zorg.

Wie zoeken we?
Je voelt goed aan welke behoeften schuilgaan achter gedrag en weet hier sensitief op te reageren. Je hebt vertrouwen in jezelf, durft verantwoorde risico’s te nemen en kijkt eerlijk naar je eigen handelen. Wat niet meteen lukt, onderzoek je. Juist bij complex gedraag blijf je kijken naar mogelijkheden. Zo help je bewoners een zo normaal mogelijk leven te ervaren.
Omdat je op een woning werkt, draai je onregelmatige diensten.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • Een afgeronde mbo-4 opleiding (zoals MMZ of Verpleegkunde) of hbo SPH/AD Social Work (met leerarrangement).

  • De bereidheid om te werken volgens de uitgangspunten van Triple-C.

  • Het vermogen om voorbij probleemgedrag te kijken en te focussen op de menselijke behoeften

Wat krijg je?
Een veelzijdige baan waarbij je samen met je collega’s kijkt naar mogelijkheden van cliënten en niet naar beperkingen. ASVZ wil niet alleen een goede zorgverlener zijn, maar ook een goede werkgever. Een organisatie waar je met plezier werkt en waar je je verbonden voelt met je collega’s.

Verder kun je rekenen op:

  • Mogelijkheid tot een vast contract, afhankelijk van je kwalificaties;

  • Een parttime baan voor 28 tot 32 uur per week;

  • Een salaris volgens de CAO Gehandicaptenzorg, van € 3.052,00 tot € 4.262,00 o.b.v. 36 uur afgestemd op jouw ervaring in salarisschaal FWG 40;

  • 8% vakantiegeld, 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering en uiteraard onregelmatigheidstoeslag (ORT);

  • Aandacht voor jouw ontwikkeling en doorgroeimogelijkheden, naar b.v. Meewerkend Teamleider;

Werkplek

Je komt te werken op een intensieve woonlocatie met jongvolwassen cliënten. Samen met jouw collega’s ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het draaien van een dagprogramma en het zorgen voor een fijne woonomgeving. Denk hierbij aan samen koken, activiteiten ondernemen en het huishouden doen.

Is een stevige wandeling, op pad gaan of fietsen jouw ding? Dan zoeken wij jou! De bewoners van Maria van Oranjestraat 6 zijn 2 dames en vier heren, met een matig verstandelijke beperking, bijkomende hechtingsproblematiek en / of autismespectrumstoornis. Door een actief en gevuld dagprogramma ervaren zij houvast, geborgenheid en veiligheid.

Enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan direct!
Heb je nog vragen? Stel ze gerust door contact op te nemen met Tina Blom, meewerkend teamleider via 0616089498

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Liever niet.
Ben je zzp'er? Solliciteer dan alleen als je bij ASVZ in loondienst wil komen.

title: Senior Engineer - Endpoint Security

description:
Role Purpose

The Senior Engineer for Endpoint Security is the senior technical owner of the endpoint protection estate — endpoint detection and response, anti-malware, application and device control, and host hardening across workstations and servers. The role sets the technical direction for how endpoint controls are configured, tuned, and measured, and acts as the escalation point for the most complex endpoint issues the operations teams cannot resolve. It carries no direct reports but is expected to lead engineers through design reviews, technical mentoring, and platform standards.


What we offer:

  • Hybrid working model (2 days in the office and 3 days working remotely)
  • Stable employment with an employment contract, private medical care, and a benefits package including MultiSport and a benefits platform

  • Clear career development paths and access to learning and certification programs
  • Access to training platforms and tools that support professional growth
  • An inclusive workplace that welcomes people with disabilities
  • A modern office in Poznań, located in Malta Office Park
  • Fluency in Polish and English

Why join Grant Thornton Capability Center Poland?

At Grant Thornton Capability Center Poland (GTCC), employees contribute to meaningful work that moves businesses forward. From day one, team members help deliver value for clients while helping shape the future of a growing delivery center in Poland.

Through supporting operations of our growing multinational platform, employees have opportunities to tackle complex projects, work with advanced technologies and develop the skills needed for what's next. Team members collaborate across countries, markets and time zones, learning from different perspectives and building experience beyond their roles.

At GTCC Poland, teammates succeed together. Knowledge is shared, diverse perspectives are valued, and employees support one another in doing their best work.

Clear career paths, learning opportunities and international exposure help employees continue building skills, expanding capabilities and growing rewarding careers.


About Global Delivery Centers (enterprise description)

Grant Thornton Capability Center (GTCC) support the operations of the Grant Thornton Advisors multinational platform.

We bring together people, technology and delivery capabilities that help teams work across markets and time zones. By supporting shared standards, technology and delivery expectations GTCC help keep work moving, connect teams across the platform and create consistency across the way work is delivered.

We are part of a multinational platform that brings together more than 25,000 professionals across 20+ firms. As organizations grow, enter new markets and face increasing complexity, our centers help provide the scale, coordination and operational support needed to keep work moving forward.

For our people, that means working with colleagues across markets, contributing to work with international reach and helping teams deliver consistently in an environment built on collaboration, accountability and quality.

Required Qualifications

  • Seven or more years in information technology with at least four years dedicated to endpoint security engineering in an enterprise of comparable scale.
  • Deep hands-on experience administering a major endpoint detection and response platform, such as CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne, or an equivalent, including policy design and detection tuning.
  • Strong working knowledge of Windows, macOS, and Linux internals, together with attacker techniques mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Scripting and automation proficiency in PowerShell, Python, or both, and practical experience integrating security platforms through their APIs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Industry certification such as GCFA, GCED, OSCP, CISSP, or a vendor certification on the deployed endpoint platform.
  • Experience with threat hunting, digital forensics, and endpoint telemetry pipelines feeding a SIEM or data lake.

Working Arrangements and Team Expectations

This role sits within the Information Security Platform Engineering function and shares a common operating model with the wider team. Engineers own the security platforms they build end to end: design, deployment, day-to-day operation, tuning, and lifecycle management. Work is delivered against agreed service levels and measured on control coverage, platform availability, and the quality of detection and prevention outcomes. Because the teams are distributed across LATAM, EMEA, and North America, all roles require reliable overlap with United States business hours and fluent written and spoken English.

  • Operate assigned security platforms as a service, including capacity planning, patching, upgrades, health monitoring, and vendor case management.
  • Automate repetitive configuration and operational tasks, and treat platform configuration as code wherever the tooling supports it.
  • Support incident response and forensic investigations with platform expertise, evidence, and rapid containment actions.
  • Maintain runbooks, architecture diagrams, and control documentation to a standard that satisfies internal audit and external assessment.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and in scheduled change windows, including occasional work outside standard business hours.

title: HR & Resourcing Co-ordinator
description:
Priory Hospital Solihull
£28,417
Full Time – 37.5 Hours

Priory Hospital Solihull has an opportunity for a HR & Resourcing Co-ordinator to join our team.

Priory Hospital Solihull, Meriden, Warwickshire is a 31-bedded level 2 rehabilitation service for males supporting the NHS. It is accessible by public transport, with local bus services and nearby train stations providing links into Coventry and Birmingham. The hospital is also well connected by road, with the M6 and M42 approximately 10 minutes away and wider access to the M40 and M1 motorways.
You’ll be part of a dedicated and compassionate team, all working together to ensure the smooth running of the hospital and to support the wellbeing of our patients. While your role doesn’t involve providing direct care, your contribution is vital in helping to maintain a safe, comfortable, and welcoming environment for everyone. Whether you're assisting with day-to-day operations, keeping things organised, or ensuring our spaces are well looked after, your support plays an important part in creating a positive experience for those who live and work here.
  • Work closely with hiring managers, Central Talent Acquisition team, and external resourcing partners, to coordinate recruitment activities.
  • Support the site lead to work closely with the Central Talent Acquisition team to agree recruitment methods where there are resourcing challenges across site or within specific teams
  • Work in conjunction with Central Onboarding team to ensure new hires are offered, processed and onboarded in line with the sites “Time To Hire” targets or KPI’s
  • Coordinate and arrange mandatory or required training in a timely manner to support the site to remain compliant
You can find additional information in the attached job description.
Essential for the role
The successful candidate will ideally hold a CIPD Level 5 qualification with relevant working knowledge, or have a minimum of three years’ practical HR experience. You will have demonstrable experience in managing employee relations cases and a strong understanding of current UK employment legislation, with the ability to keep up to date with relevant changes and best practice. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills are essential, alongside a high level of attention to detail. Previous experience working as an HR Administrator or HR Assistant within a commercial environment, in either a generalist or specialist capacity, is required. Experience within the healthcare sector would be advantageous but is not essential.
We want you to succeed at Priory and thrive in your role. You will be well supported with regular career conversations. We also offer full training and numerous pathways into leadership and qualified clinical positions to help you shape your career with us.
  • Birthday Holiday - your birthday as an extra days annual leave

title: Full-Stack Developer
description:
Being part of Air Canada is to become part of an iconic Canadian symbol, recently ranked the best Airline in North America. Let your career take flight by joining our diverse and vibrant team at the leading edge of passenger aviation.

Being part of Air Canada means joining an iconic Canadian brand, recently recognized as the best airline in North America. Let your career take flight by becoming part of a diverse and forward-thinking team that's shaping the future of passenger aviation through digital innovation.

We're looking for a talented individual to join our team of Full-stack developers to develop high-quality software across the entire tech stack, designing backend systems, business logic, and responsive front-end interfaces. The successful candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration, write comprehensive tests, optimize performance, and contribute to system documentation for scalability and maintainability.

You are proactive and innovative, challenge ideas, support technical design decisions, and stay updated on emerging technologies to deliver efficient, future-ready solutions. With a focus on product success, you are able to adapt to evolving responsibilities, including involvement in product support and QA.

These are exciting times for IT at Air Canada, with many major projects underway that will transform the IT landscape. Air Canada is also massively investing in new technologies that will facilitate its digital transformation. This is a unique opportunity to learn state of the art technologies at an industry leader, as well as to contribute to the creation of the Air Canada of tomorrow.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and manage full-stack applications using modern frameworks and cloud-native architectures.
  • Design and implement scalable backend services, APIs, and business logic using Java, Node.js, or similar technologies.
  • Build responsive, accessible, and high-performance front-end interfaces using React, Angular, or equivalent.
  • Ensure seamless integration between front-end and back-end systems using Air Canada's Enterprise Integration Platform.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code that supports long-term scalability.
  • Develop and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code reliability.
  • Optimize performance across the stack-front-end responsiveness, backend efficiency, and database tuning.
  • Apply modern design principles such as microservices, serverless architecture, and modular components.
  • Collaborate with product owners, designers, QA, and DevOps to align on goals and deliverables.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to sprint planning, retrospectives, and continuous improvement.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to enhance productivity and encourage adoption across the team.
  • Contribute to system documentation and onboarding materials to support team knowledge sharing.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and recommend innovative solutions to improve product performance and user experience.
  • Lead product lifecycle activities including debugging, performance tuning, and post-release support.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in full-stack software development.
  • Strong proficiency in Java and Node.js (2+ years).
  • Experience building and integrating with mission-critical APIs.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Front-end frameworks: React, Angular, or Vue.js
    • Backend frameworks: Express.js, NestJS, Spring Boot
    • Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Couchbase
    • API protocols and specifications: REST, SOAP, OpenAPI, Swagger
    • Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, or GCP
    • CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation
  • Strong understanding of application security, performance optimization, and data protection.
  • Familiarity with AI integration and emerging technologies.
  • Demonstrate punctuality and dependability to support overall team success in a fast-paced environment.

Assets

  • Experience with Mulesoft or other Java-based ESBs (IBM IIB, Tibco).
  • Exposure to API management platforms (Apigee, IBM API Connect, Mulesoft).
  • Experience with content management systems (e.g., Adobe Experience Manager).
  • Background in airline or travel industry.
  • Agile development experience in cross-functional teams.
  • Understanding of team dynamics between Product Owner, Scrum Master, and development team.

Conditions Of Employment

Candidates must be eligible to work in the country of interest at the time any offer of employment is made and are responsible for obtaining any required work permits, visas, or other authorizations necessary for employment. Prior to their start date, candidates will also need to provide proof of their eligibility to work in the country of interest.

Linguistic Requirements

Based on equal qualifications, preference will be given to bilingual candidates.

Diversity and Inclusion

Air Canada is strongly committed to Diversity and Inclusion and aims to create a healthy, accessible and rewarding work environment which highlights employees' unique contributions to our company’s success.

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from all to help us build a diverse workforce which reflects the diversity of our customers, and communities, in which we live and serve.

Air Canada thanks all candidates for their interest; however only those selected to continue in the process will be contacted.

title: Senior Editor, HarperNonFiction
description:
Are you a creative, commercially minded editor ready to take the next step up in your publishing career? HarperNonFiction is looking for a dynamic, detail-driven individual to join our Thorsons, Lifestyle, Gift & IP Editorial team.

HarperNonFiction is home to a wide range of bestselling authors and is one of the UK’s leading commercial non-fiction publishing divisions. Notable Thorsons, Lifestyle, Gift & IP successes include titles by Ben Lippett, Jay Shetty, Sarah Rossi, Becky Kennedy, the Royal Shakespeare Company and Freja.

As a successful candidate, you will possess strong desk editorial skills and have a proven track record of overseeing books from first manuscript, through copy-editing and proofreading all the way to final PDF. You will also possess excellent commercial instincts and be able to demonstrate strong market knowledge of lifestyle, cookery and gifts. A genuine passion for cookery and lifestyle as well as experience of working on illustrated cookery would be a distinct advantage. You will also be highly organised, proactive and confident juggling competing priorities, whilst delivering exceptional publishing and author care. In addition, you will be an excellent communicator and enjoy working co-operatively within our collaborative and supportive team. As your confidence grows in the role, you will have the opportunity to commission a small number of your own titles, making this an exciting opportunity for an ambitious editorial professional.

Your first six months

By the end of six months you would be managing projects confidently – including copywriting, structural edits, cover briefs and proofreading. You’ll also be encouraged to contribute book ideas and to share feedback on proposals with a longer-term view to commissioning 2–3 titles a year in the areas of Cookery and Lifestyle.


Editorial
  • Support the Thorsons, Lifestyle, Gift & IP Editorial commissioning team across a range of titles from manuscript to finished copies, maintaining the highest standards of quality, accuracy and editorial integrity – on budget and on schedule
  • Take project management and desk editorial responsibility for the Publisher's titles, including structural editing, overseeing copy-edits, checking proofs, copywriting and writing design briefs
  • Manage budgets, schedules and critical paths with precision and foresight
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with authors, agents and freelancers, including editors, indexers and photographers
  • Prepare cover briefs, write compelling cover copy and information sheets, and check proofs to a high standard
  • Copywrite and review sales and marketing materials, including catalogues and presenter documents
  • Manage editorial listings (TIs, BIC, Acquisitions, P&Ls) to ensure title and list information is accurate and up to date, both internally and externally
  • Research and prepare pitch presentations for new business opportunities, collaborating with internal and external designers as needed
  • Stay ahead of publishing trends and market developments, with an instinct for identifying what's coming next
  • Take ownership of your own stable of authors, seeing their titles through to publication across physical, digital and audio editions

  • Demonstrable editorial experience across commercial non-fiction books, including both black-and-white and illustrated titles
  • Proven copy-editing and proof-reading skills
  • A keen eye for detail and strong visual awareness
  • Exceptional organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise effectively and manage a varied workload across both short and long-term demands
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience writing catalogue and cover copy
  • Financial awareness, with confidence in budgeting and cost-control processes across specific projects and lists
  • A self-motivated, proactive approach – able to take initiative and see projects through independently
  • The ability to remain calm and focused under pressure
  • A collaborative team player with the drive to work autonomously when needed
  • A passion for innovative publishing, meaningful content and beautifully produced books
  • An active interest in trends, talent, social media and digital developments within the industry
  • An excellent command of the English language
  • A customer-focused mindset, with a commitment to delivering the highest standard of author care
  • Advanced proficiency in MS Word; intermediate knowledge of Excel and Outlook


HarperCollins operates a hybrid working policy where employees are expected to work from our London office three days per week.

If you wish to discuss anything regarding this position, please contact recruitment@harpercollins.co.uk with the subject line 'Vacancy Query' followed by the job title. We aim to respond within 5 working days.

title: Senior Privacy & Data Security Engineer, AI Cloud Infrastructure
description:
A fast-growing organisation in the AI Cloud Infrastructure space is looking for a Senior Security Engineer specialising in Privacy & Data Security to strengthen its global security and privacy capabilities. This role will support the delivery of cloud infrastructure across international markets, with a strong focus on data protection, privacy compliance, and the technical safeguards required for enterprise customers and regulatory obligations.

Role

You will work at the intersection of cybersecurity, privacy engineering, cloud infrastructure, and compliance. The role involves designing practical security controls for data throughout its lifecycle, including encryption, key management, data discovery, access controls, data protection, retention and deletion, and cross-border data transfers. You will also partner with Legal, Risk & Compliance, DPO, infrastructure security teams, auditors, and customers to translate regulatory requirements into implementable controls, maintain technical and organisational measures, and provide clear evidence for audits and customer due diligence.

Requirements

  • 5-8 years of hands-on experience in security, data security, or a related engineering function, with practical expertise in encryption, KMS/HSM, and cloud security.
  • Strong understanding of privacy engineering concepts, including data-flow mapping, personal-data discovery, DSAR implementation, data minimisation, de-identification, and Privacy by Design.
  • Ability to interpret GDPR requirements and translate them into technical controls, TOMs, and security measures, with familiarity in SCC Annex II and DPA security documentation.
  • Solid understanding of cloud and Kubernetes environments, including multi-tenant isolation, data flows, and integration with security tooling; with demonstrated ownership of at least one end-to-end privacy or GDPR/DPA compliance implementation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, legal, compliance, audit, and customer-facing stakeholders; experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001/27701, compliance automation, or relevant privacy/security certifications would be advantageous.

title: Senior RWE (Real World Evidence) Expert
description:
Make your mark for patients

We are looking for a Senior Real-World Evidence (RWE) Expert who is scientifically rigorous, strategically minded, and passionate about generating impactful evidence. You will join our Global Real-World Evidence team working both with US and non-US colleagues. This is a hybrid position and could be either based out of our offices in Cambridge, MA or Raleigh, NC or Atlanta, GA.

About the role

As a Senior Real-World Evidence Expert, you will independently design, lead, and deliver global evidence studies. Your work will inform internal decisions, support regulatory and payer interactions, and advance scientific understanding of disease areas. You will also help shape asset-level evidence strategies and propose innovative approaches in partnership with the Real-World Evidence Strategy Lead.

Who you’ll work with

You will collaborate with statisticians, analysts, epidemiologists, clinical teams, market access and health economics colleagues, safety and pharmacovigilance partners, medical experts, external vendors, and cross-functional asset teams. As an influential scientific contributor, you will align diverse stakeholders and ensure outputs meet strategic, regulatory, payer, and scientific needs.

What you’ll do

  • Lead complex global evidence studies using diverse methodologies, data sources, and study designs.
  • Develop study concepts, protocols, analysis plans, governance processes, and quality-control standards.
  • Deliver epidemiology, disease-burden, safety, regulatory, and comparative-effectiveness studies.
  • Lead primary data-collection partnerships and high-visibility secondary data-use initiatives.
  • Interpret and communicate findings across scientific, regulatory, payer, and strategic forums.
  • Shape asset evidence strategies through innovative methods, data sources, and functional thought leadership.

Interested? For this role we’re looking for the following education, experience and skills

  • Master's, PhD, PharmD or MD in a relevant scientific or quantitative field.
  • 8+ years of experience designing and delivering real-world evidence studies in industry, or consulting. (Experience from academia may also be considered).
  • Strong expertise in RWE methodology including epidemiology, pharmacoepidemiology, outcomes research, and quantitative methods.
  • Experience using a variety of real-world data sources, ideally including both primary and secondary data sources, with an ability to critically evaluate fitness for purpose.
  • Ability to create high-quality abstracts, manuscripts, posters, presentations, and scientific communications.
  • Excellent communication and influence skills with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.
  • Independent project leadership, strategic thinking, innovation, and adaptability in changing environments.

Salary

The reasonably anticipated base salary range for this position is $164,000 to $215,300 per year. The actual salary offered will take into account related knowledge, skills, experience and location among other factors and may fall outside the expected range.

Are you ready to ‘go beyond’ to create value and make your mark for patients? If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you!

About us
UCB is a global biopharmaceutical company, focusing on neurology and immunology. We are over 9.000 people in all four corners of the globe, inspired by patients and driven by science.

Why work with us?
At UCB, we don’t just complete tasks, we create value. We aren’t afraid to push forward, collaborate, and innovate to make our mark for patients. We have a caring, supportive culture where everyone feels included, respected, and has equal opportunities to do their best work. We ‘go beyond’ to create value for our patients, and always with a human focus, whether that’s on our patients, our employees, or our planet. Working for us, you will discover a place where you can grow, and have the freedom to carve your own career path to achieve your full potential.

At UCB, we’ve embraced a hybrid-first approach to work, bringing teams together in local hubs to foster collaborative curiosity. Unless explicitly stated in the description or precluded by the nature of the position, roles are hybrid with 40% of your time spent in the office.

UCB is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions will be made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. UCB invites you to voluntarily self-identify during the application process. Provision of self-identification information is entirely voluntary and a decision to provide or not provide such information will not have any effect on your application for employment, your employment with UCB, or otherwise subject you to any adverse treatment. Any information you provide will be considered confidential and will be kept separate from your application and/or personnel file and will only be used in accordance with applicable laws, orders, and regulations.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Full Stack Software Developer

What We Need

Corpay is currently looking to hire a Full Stack Software Developer within our Cross-Border division. This position falls under our Corporate Payments line of business and is located in Toronto, ON.

In this role, you will work in an agile team environment and play an integral part in driving our core international payment processing systems forward. You will help bring our foreign exchange and eCommerce software platforms to the forefront of both technical innovation and the financial industry.

In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, and delivery of scalable software solutions, collaborating with Product, Engineering, and QA teams to build and enhance business-critical applications.

This is an excellent opportunity to participate in cutting-edge software development within the financial technology industry.

How We Work

  • Assigned workspace in the Toronto office

Role Responsibilities

  • Working with business stakeholders to understand requirements and resolve technical questions.

  • Building and maintaining robust, scalable, and high-performance applications.

  • Following software development best practices, including Agile methodologies, clean code principles, unit testing, and continuous integration.

  • Collaborating effectively with Product Owners, Developers, Scrum Masters, QA teams, and other stakeholders.

  • Developing and maintaining both front-end and back-end components of the platform.

  • Participating in architecture discussions and contributing to technical design decisions.

  • Supporting and enhancing existing systems while helping drive new product development initiatives.

  • Troubleshooting and resolving production issues when required.

  • Contributing to performance optimization and scalability improvements across the platform.

  • Working effectively both independently and within a collaborative team environment.

  • Helping reduce ambiguity by refining requirements, estimating work, and providing technical guidance.

  • Continuously learning and applying new technologies and industry best practices where appropriate.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Mandatory experience in the financial services industry, payments, foreign exchange (FX), or fintech sectors.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering or software development roles.

  • Strong experience designing and developing .NET desktop and web applications.

  • Strong proficiency with C#, JavaScript, and/or TypeScript.

  • Expert knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server and relational database design principles.

  • Experience with unit testing frameworks and software testing methodologies.

  • Experience designing, consuming, and maintaining HTTP-based web APIs.

  • Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and scalable application development.

  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum environments.

  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Product-oriented mindset with a desire to understand the business problems being solved.

  • Commitment to quality, performance, and continuous improvement.

  • Experience working with external vendors and third-party integrations is considered an asset.

  • Strong understanding of payment processing systems, financial platforms, and transaction-based applications.

  • Motivated to stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends.

Benefits & Perks

  • Comprehensive Benefits Package including Medical, Dental, Vision and Paramedical benefits, as of day one

  • Optional company match RRSP program

  • Virtual fitness classes offered company-wide

  • Time-off including major holidays, vacation, sick, personal, & volunteer time

  • Discounted gym membership rate

  • Philanthropic support with both local and national organizations

  • Fun culture with company-wide contests and prizes

Pay Transparency

The expected salary range for this position isCAD $110,000 - $130,000 based on the candidate’s work location. This range reflects a good faith estimate of the expected compensation for this role at the time of posting. The final offer will be determined based on job-related factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and applicable market conditions. Compensation may vary based on geographic location and will be confirmed during the hiring process.

Additional compensation and benefits, including incentive programs, health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, and other benefits (where applicable), may also be provided.
