Enjoy Gaming is a software provider focused on creating high-quality digital entertainment experiences, including Slots and Live Games. Our team brings together experienced professionals in game development, product, and design, driven by a passion for innovation and quality.

At Enjoy Gaming, we value ownership, excellence, and drive. These principles shape the way we work, collaborate, and build products.

Join us and be part of our innovative journey in the gaming world!

We’re looking for a sharp Application Security Engineer to join our team and act as the technical guardian for our games and platforms. If you have an attacker's mindset but know how to build and defend alongside engineering teams, this role is for you. In this position, you won’t just be sending reports to the teams or management. You’ll be diving deep into web and desktop applications, hunting down game-level vulnerabilities, and collaborating closely with our Architects, Studio, Slots, and Platform Developers to engineer more resilient systems.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of Application Security Engineer experience

  • Background in red teaming, penetration testing, application security, and software development

  • Able to independently find vulnerabilities in web and desktop applications, triage them, and, where needed, fix them

  • Solid grounding in data structures, algorithms, and systems architecture designs

  • Previous security testing experience with Kafka/Redis/BullMQ/PubSub as message/streaming tools

  • Codes independently, can navigate unfamiliar web application frameworks

  • Experience using AI tools to aid with vulnerability hunting

  • Comfortable talking to developers and turning findings into practical, actionable advice

Nice to have:

  • CRTO, OSCP, or OSWE certifications or similar

  • Knowledge of Cloud Platforms (GCP/AWS)

  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines

  • Hands-on experience with Trivy, Nessus, Acunetix, or Wiz

  • Experience in iGaming or another regulated industry

What You Will Do:

  • Own and maintain our application security pipelines: SCA (Github/Trivy), DAST (Nessus, Acunetix, Wiz), and SAST

  • Triage findings from these tools and drive them to remediation

  • Perform penetration tests on new platform features, new internal applications, and new slots and live games

  • Run basic red team activities, including leaked credential reviews and external attack surface audits

  • Review complex auth flows with various third parties for cryptographic and security issues

  • Review/Triage application code for security issues ( 85% NestJS / 15% .NET )

  • Own security risk in existing code and applications

  • Act as the application-level security expert during incident response and be ready to deliver hotfixes yourself when needed

  • Prepare our quarterly SAST/DAST vulnerability scan reports for stakeholders/regulators and take part in audit meetings

  • Own the Secure Coding and Application Security areas of our ISMS

  • Meet regularly with development teams, learn about upcoming features early, and advise on secure design

What We Offer:

  • Competitive Salary in EUR: with annual performance reviews to recognize your growth

  • Flexible Remote Work: balance productivity and comfort

  • Comprehensive Benefits: including medical insurance, psychologist support, and Polish, Slovak-speaking clubs

  • Generous Paid Time Off: 20 working days of paid vacation, plus 10 additional paid days off, 10 paid sick days, and all national holidays in your country

  • Professional Development Support: reimbursement for courses, trainings, and certifications

  • Well-being Perks: support for language classes, sports, massages, or life coaching

As Access & Pricing Strategy Lead, you will play a critical role in translating payer, policy, evidence, pricing, and access considerations into actionable strategic choices and global deliverables that support asset success throughout the product lifecycle.

Acting as a strategic partner to Asset Payer Heads, you will help shape payer strategies, influence key development and commercialization decisions, and ensure payer perspectives are embedded early and consistently. This role offers a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of payer strategy, market access, evidence generation, pricing, and portfolio decision-making.

You will act as a key connector across the organization, ensuring payer insights and access considerations are integrated into strategic planning and decision-making.

title: Huishoudelijke hulp Budel
description:
Word jij het zonnetje in huis? Kom werken als Huishoudelijke Hulp!

Werkgebied: Budel
Contract: 2-24 uur per week, flexibele werktijden

Bij Miep Huishoudservice en Begeleiding draait alles om het creëren van een écht thuisgevoel – niet alleen voor onze cliënten, maar ook voor jou als medewerker. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je je gewaardeerd voelt, je werk met plezier doet en altijd de steun krijgt die je nodig hebt. Flexibiliteit, persoonlijke aandacht en een fijne werksfeer staan bij ons centraal!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Huishoudelijke Hulp bij Miep Huishoudservice zorg je ervoor dat onze cliënten zich thuis blijven voelen in hun eigen woning, ook als zij zelf niet meer volledig voor het huishouden kunnen zorgen. Jouw taken bestaan uit:

  • Schoonmaken, stofzuigen en andere huishoudelijke werkzaamheden.

  • Cliënten zoveel mogelijk betrekken bij het huishouden.

  • Persoonlijke aandacht en een luisterend oor bieden.

Jij maakt elke dag het verschil! Dankzij jouw hulp blijft het huis van onze cliënten schoon en fijn, waardoor zij langer zelfstandig kunnen blijven wonen. Een sociaal en dankbaar beroep waarin jij elke dag iets moois betekent voor een ander!

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij ons bepaal jij je eigen werktijden en -dagen! Extra werken in de vakantie? Geen probleem! Je krijgt een salaris volgens de cao VVT, vanaf € 15,07 bruto per uur afhankelijk van ervaring, met jaarlijkse verhogingen tot € 18,27. Daarnaast ontvang je vakantiegeld (8%) en een eindejaarsuitkering (8,33%), die je ook maandelijks kunt laten uitbetalen. Ook bouw je pensioen op en kun je gebruikmaken van een collectieve zorgverzekering. Reiskosten (zoals auto, fiets, brommer of scooter) en reistijd tussen cliënten worden vergoed.

We investeren in jouw groei met een digitaal onboardingsprogramma via de MiepApp vol e-learnings. Wil je alvast een kijkje nemen? Klik dan hier. Je krijgt een contract voor bepaalde tijd met de intentie tot een vaste aanstelling. Twee keer per jaar organiseren we een medewerkersbijeenkomst om je collega’s beter te leren kennen. Miep is een warme, betrokken werkgever die naar je luistert. Jouw werk is niet alleen belangrijk, maar maakt ook écht een verschil voor onze cliënten!

Wie ben jij?

  • Jij bent het zonnetje in huis, zorgzaam en hebt een groot inlevingsvermogen.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor je taken.

  • Je spreekt en begrijpt Nederlands.

  • Je bent minimaal 2 uur per week beschikbaar tussen 9:00 en 18:00 uur (ma-vr).

  • Ervaring is mooi meegenomen, maar enthousiasme en een passie voor schoonmaken zijn minstens zo belangrijk!

  • Je hebt eigen vervoer (auto, scooter of fiets) om naar cliënten te reizen.

Enthousiast geworden?

Wil jij het verschil maken en onze cliënten laten stralen? Solliciteer vandaag nog!
Stuur je CV en motivatie naar ons op en wie weet verwelkomen wij jou binnenkort als onze nieuwe collega. Na je sollicitatie laten we je zo snel mogelijk weten hoe het verder gaat. Bij indiensttreding vragen wij een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) aan.

title: Governance Lead
description:
A little bit about us

East West Rail is an infrastructure programme connecting communities between Oxford and Cambridge, a region currently underserved by transport. We have a once in a generation opportunity to change that, improving prosperity for people and places along the way.

East West Railway Company (EWR Co) was created by the Department for Transport (DfT) to oversee delivery of East West Rail, from design and construction through to services running, making sure the railway comes together in the right way. The programme is projected to deliver a £6.7 billion annual boost to the regional economy by 2050.

Role Summary

As Governance Lead, you will own the operation and continued development of EWR Co's corporate governance framework. Working directly with the Chair, Board, Executive Committee and senior leaders, you will help shape governance at a defining stage in EWR Co's development. You will connect Board governance, delegated authority and organisational decision-making, creating arrangements that support delivery today and remain clear and defensible under future scrutiny.

You will provide independent, practical advice on governance, decision-making and accountability with autonomy, exercise sound judgement, constructively challenge at the most senior levels and lead the governance team.

Function

The Governance Lead reports to the Director of Legal and is accountable for the day-to-day operation of governance within EWR Co. The role leads and develops the governance team, which includes a Governance Manager as a direct report, and sets its priorities, standards and ways of working.

The role operates across organisational boundaries, with direct access to the Chair, Non-Executive Directors, Executive Directors and senior leadership. It builds working relationships with committee chairs, paper owners and decision-makers across EWR Co, as well as governance and sponsorship counterparts within the DfT.

In this role, you will:
  • Lead the day-to-day operation and development of the governance function, setting clear priorities, service standards, controls and ways of working.
  • Maintain a clear view of EWR Co's governance architecture, including the relationship between the Articles of Association, Framework Document, Development Agreement, delegated authorities, remit and delegation letters, matters reserved, terms of reference and internal governance arrangements.
  • Build a governance service that combines reliable secretariat delivery with sound governance advice, keeping a coherent map of governance forums, decision rights, assurance routes and escalation paths and identifying duplication, gaps or unclear accountabilities.
  • Operate the conflicts of interest and business interests regime for Board and Executive members, alongside the gifts and hospitality registers, ensuring records are live and auditable.
  • Develop and support the governance team, establishing clear accountabilities and building professional capability and resilience.
  • Advise the Chair, Board, Executive Committee and senior leaders on governance, authority, accountability and effective decision-making, planning forward agendas with the Chair, committee chairs and executives around the company's strategic, delivery, risk and assurance priorities.
  • Provide independent and practical advice on where and how decisions should be taken, constructively challenging where proposals do not meet the required governance or evidential standard.
  • Anticipate governance requirements and identify emerging gaps, ambiguities or conflicts before they affect programme delivery or expose the company to challenge.
  • Promote a culture in which governance is understood as an enabler of sound and timely delivery, rather than an administrative process.
  • Produce proportionate guidance, training and communications that help colleagues understand decision rights, delegated authority and governance requirements.
  • Contribute to corporate governance reporting to the DfT and, where required, HM Treasury.
  • Embed Equality, Diversity and Inclusion in all your work, and support organisational EDI initiatives, policies and procedures.
  • Undertake other duties reasonably required by the Director of Legal to support the function.

Essential Criteria

You will bring:
  • A background in delivering corporate governance and company secretarial services within a complex, regulated, publicly accountable or similarly scrutinised organisation.
  • Experience of advising and influencing at Board and executive level, including forward planning and maintaining accurate, auditable records of decisions.
  • Working knowledge of UK corporate governance and company secretarial requirements.
  • A background in managing or developing others, whether through formal line management, professional supervision or leadership of a specialist service.
  • Sound independent judgement and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential matters.
  • A continuous-improvement mindset, with the ability to challenge unnecessary process while strengthening accountability and control.
  • The ability to manage a demanding forward pipeline and deliver within agreed timescales.

Desirable Criteria

It would also be great if you have:
  • Chartered, graduate or advanced-stage professional status with the Chartered Governance Institute UK & Ireland, or equivalent experience.
  • A Qualification as a solicitor or barrister, supported by relevant corporate governance or company secretarial experience, or equivalent experience.


  • Competitive salary that reflects your skills and experience
  • Up to 12% employer pension contribution to support your future
  • 36 days annual leave (including bank holidays) plus the option to buy up to 2 extra days
  • 2 volunteering days, a chance for you to give back to the community
  • Enhanced family-friendly policies to support you and your loved ones
  • Life assurance (4x your annual salary) for peace of mind
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support when you need it
  • Access to Perkbox for a wide range of discounts and wellbeing benefits
  • Recognition programme, including on-the-spot and annual awards
  • Advanced learning and development opportunities to help you grow.

At East West Railway Company, we’re committed to building an inclusive railway for all. We believe that to do that, we must nurture a diverse team that represents the UK communities that we impact. title: Senior Software Engineer, Team Lead
description:
Our mission and why it matters

We are on a mission to make humans the strongest security layer.

Human risk remains one of the biggest vulnerabilities and traditional awareness training is not enough. We take a different approach by combining AI-driven personalization, real threat detection, and behavioral science to actively protect people and organizations.

We don't just simulate risks. We build the tools that detect and stop them.

Why this role matters

You will lead engineering for our data-intensive reporting and integration products, building the core capabilities that enable our Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) partners to scale efficiently to serve millions of users.

What you’ll own and drive

  • Delivery leadership and product partnership: Turn product strategy into delivery plans and shipped outcomes by keeping scope sharp, quality high, and momentum constant. Work closely with Product Management every day to solve real customer problems and deliver value.

  • Technical direction and engineering maturity: Make pragmatic architecture decisions that help our partners operate efficiently at scale, and raise the bar for operational excellence. Build alongside your team in our production stack (Node.js, TypeScript, React, GraphQL, MongoDB, K8s and GCP), maintaining sharp technical judgement without becoming a bottleneck.

  • People leadership: Own team development, performance management, and hiring for a growing team of 8+ talented engineers.

What success looks like

In your first 3 months you'll build deep context of our people, product, delivery, operations, and establish strong trust with your team and product partners, and take active ownership of the team management.

By month 6 you'll be confidently shaping roadmaps, driving technical solutions, and demonstrably elevating the technical and operational maturity of your team.

What makes you thrive here

You have:

  • Proven hands-on Tech Lead or Engineering Manager experience with a product team. You lead by example and by building, not from a distance.

  • A strong track record of shipping and running large-scale, data-intensive SaaS systems with high standards for availability, latency and data quality.

  • Full-stack competence in our tech stack (Node.js, TypeScript, React, GraphQL, MongoDB, K8s, GCP) and experience operating production systems (observability, incident response, performance optimization).

  • Strong product and engineering judgment: you can balance speed with sustainability and know exactly when to simplify.

  • Demonstrated ability to raise the bar: mentoring engineers, setting high standards, and driving a delivery system that scales with the team.

  • The backbone to push back: you comfortably challenge product, peers, and your own manager when the customer or business is being shortchanged.

  • Practical, production-grade AI/LLM engineering experience (or strong proof you can ramp fast). You know how to ship AI-driven capabilities safely, and you actively use AI tools to multiply your own hands-on contributions: designing and optimizing the harnesses that allow agents to work optimally, thinking in terms feedback loops and continuous improvement.

Who you’ll work with

You will report to VP of Engineering and work closely with Product Management, Design, and lead your own dedicated team of eight engineers. This is a highly collaborative, team-focused environment where we value candid feedback and extreme ownership. You will act as the critical link between engineering execution and business strategy, ensuring your team has the clarity and support to build world-class products.

What you can expect from us

Compensation: Monthly salary of €7,000 - €8,500 depending on your experience. You may notice varying salary ranges for roles with similar titles across Hoxhunt; this is because each range is grounded in our role leveling and reflects the seniority, scope, and impact expectations required for that specific role and team, and we operate with a low hierarchy.

Working ways: We work in a flexible, but hybrid work setting. You are expected to work from the Helsinki office 2-3 days a week.

High performance meets high humanity: We bring an incredibly driven, high-impact energy to our work, but we leave our egos at the door. You will be surrounded by wildly talented, dedicated colleagues in an environment built on extreme kindness, support, and psychological safety.

Authentic trust & autonomy: We hire great people and trust them to do great work. You will find a culture free of micromanagement, giving you the autonomy to take real ownership, drive impact, and shape things early on.

A product you can be proud of: It is incredibly rare in cybersecurity to build a product that end-users genuinely love. You will join a team making a real, measurable impact against cybercrime.

The perks that matter: Alongside this amazing community, you will enjoy extensive healthcare with other benefits and our beautiful new office in Helsinki (complete with a gym and swimming pool!).

Recruitment process

  1. TA Screening Call (30 min)

  2. Meeting VP of Engineering (60 min, remote)

  3. Take-home Assignment (max 6 hours, independently)

  4. Panel Interview (60-90 min, onsite)

  5. Final Alignment Call (30 min, remote)

  6. Reference Checks

About Hoxhunt

Hoxhunt was founded in 2016 by four visionaries. Today we are a global team of +270 amazing Hoxhunters advancing a truly AI-native category leader in human risk management, with key hubs in the United States, the United Kingdom, Singapore, and Finland. We are proud to be an award-winning, fast-growing software company, recognized by G2 and Gartner, named to TIME Magazine's list of the World's Top EdTech Companies, and featured for our innovation in major publications like Fast Company, TechCrunch, Forbes, and Inc.

As a multi-product company, Hoxhunt goes beyond traditional security awareness. We don't just educate employees through frequent, personalized, and behavior-changing cybersecurity training - we also actively build real threat intelligence and response tools that protect organizations against malicious cyberattacks every single day.

Be among the first to know about our open positions. Drop your details in our Talent Community, and we will reach out when there is a match!

title: Examiners - Interactive Media
description:
Overview

Flexible Worker Contract

Location: Remote

About the role

We’re looking for Examiners to join our Assessment Delivery team on a flexible worker contract for the following qualification:

Level 1/2 Technical Award in Interactive Media

As an Examiner, you’ll use your subject knowledge to mark external assessments and submit results throughout the summer 2027 marking window, helping to ensure learners receive fair, consistent and accurate results.

If you’re an Interactive Media, Creative Media, Digital Media, Games Design, Animation or Multimedia teacher, lecturer, trainer or assessor, this is a great opportunity to put your expertise to use and make a valuable contribution to the assessment of learners.

Marking window dates are subject to change and will be communicated throughout the process should you be successful.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Following and maintaining the standard set by the Chief Examiner, applying the mark scheme consistently and accurately
  • Reporting suspected malpractice or safeguarding concerns to the Assessment Delivery team
  • Attending examiner standardisation and other meetings as required – standardisation events will be run remotely and scheduled for weekdays between the hours of 9.00am-5.00pm prior to the start of the marking window
  • Maintaining the confidentiality of NCFE assessment materials, learner evidence and learner details, and report any breaches to the Assessment Delivery team

We'd love to hear from you if you offer the following:

  • A relevant qualification at Level 3 or above in interactive media or a closely related subject area
  • Current or recent teaching experience at Level 3 or above in an interactive media related subject, or significant recent occupational experience within the sector
  • An understanding of effective quality assurance and assessment processes
  • The ability to work consistently within tight deadlines
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

Feeling inspired? Read the full Job Description to find out more.

Why work as a flexible worker for NCFE?

Our flexible workforce provides supportive quality assurance to ensure that learners taking NCFE qualifications are getting the best education possible. If you become a flexible worker with us, you’ll choose how to fit your work around your other personal and professional commitments – making this a great opportunity to make a difference in a way that suits you.

You’ll receive full training and the materials, tools or equipment needed to ensure you’re able to complete your duties in line with NCFE requirements, with the ability to take on flexible worker contract alongside other work, without the need to be registered as self-employed.

All applicants will be expected to adhere to NCFE’s behavioural framework and to uphold our core values.

You can find out more about how our flexible arrangements work, the flexible worker roles we recruit, and frequently asked questions around the application, induction and training process, and your rights and protections by visiting our Flexible worker opportunities page.

Shape real change with an NCFE career

Imagine a career where your contributions affect not only what people learn, but the way that learning is developed and delivered.

With over 170 years of education experience our core purpose remains at the heart of the organisation – to promote and advance learning to create a fairer, more inclusive society, making sure no learner is left behind.

Want to know more? Take a look at our website https://www.ncfe.org.uk/

How to apply

Before applying, please note that we require all candidates to be able to demonstrate proof of Right to Work in the UK.

Ready to join us and shape real change? Apply with your CV and answer the associated application questions.

Closing Date: Wednesday 2 December 2026

Interview Date: Ongoing

Interview Details: Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. If your application is shortlisted, we’ll contact you to complete a short task.

Equality, Diversity and Inclusion (EDI) statement

We're committed to building rich diversity into our workforce at all levels, to ensure that we understand and are representative of the communities and customers we serve.

We do not discriminate against anyone due to their gender, sexuality, race, age, religion, beliefs, identity, social background, visible or hidden disability, or neurodiversity. Instead, we pride ourselves on our collaborative, vibrant and high-performance culture which embraces everyone, celebrates uniqueness, and enables everyone's voice to be heard.

title: Senior salarisadministrateur
description:
Senior Salarisadministrateur

Ben jij een ervaren salarisadministrateur die complexe cao’s moeiteloos doorgrondt, afwijkingen signaleert voordat anderen ze zien en naast het verwerken ook graag adviseert? Bij Salure krijg je de ruimte om jouw expertise echt in te zetten én krijg je daarvoor de waardering die jij verdient.

In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor een nauwkeurige en tijdige salarisverwerking én fungeer je als inhoudelijke sparringpartner voor jouw klanten. Je beheert een vaste portefeuille van zo’n 10 klanten, variërend van ongeveer 50 tot 200 medewerkers per klant. Dit zijn bijvoorbeeld organisaties in de zakelijke dienstverlening, maar ook onderwijsinstellingen en non-profitorganisaties (NGO’s).

Je werkt met AFAS software, gecombineerd met onze eigen slimme software en binnen duidelijke proceskaders. Je draagt inhoudelijke verantwoordelijkheid voor correcte verwerking en signalering van afwijkingen. We verwachten dat je actief meedenkt over optimalisatie.

Je werkt vanuit ons kantoor in Gouda of Leusden gecombineerd met thuiswerken en maakt deel uit van een professioneel team van ongeveer 35 payroll specialisten verdeeld over de diverse locaties.

Wij werken in teams, collega’s ondersteunen elkaar en voelen zich samen verantwoordelijk voor onze klanten. Dit, samen met de duidelijke afspraken over de processen, zorgt ervoor dat we de workload goed weten te spreiden.

Werk je bij Salure, dan schrijven wij je bij NIRPA in in het Register Salarisadministrateur (RSa) of het Register Payroll Professional (RPP). Hiermee laat je jouw vakkennis en vaardigheden zien. Er is een ruim aanbod aan trainingen waaraan je deel kunt nemen.

Waar heb jij als specialist écht invloed?

Bij Salure krijg je inhoudelijke ruimte binnen duidelijke kaders. Je hebt invloed op:

  • De kwaliteit van het klantadvies rondom wet- en regelgeving en cao-vraagstukken

  • Het aandragen van verbetervoorstellen voor het optimaliseren van het automatiseringsproces

  • Het signaleren van procesverbeteringen en deze bespreken met je teamleider

  • Verbeteringen die breder binnen de organisatie worden doorgevoerd

We zoeken geen verwerker, maar een professional die hiernaast zijn of haar expertise inzet als adviseur.

Wat maakt onze payroll-aanpak anders?

Wij geloven dat goede payroll begint bij structuur, duidelijke afspraken en automatisering

  • We maken heldere afspraken met klanten over aanlevering en verantwoordelijkheden

  • We lopen voorop in het toepassen van automatisering in ons vakgebied

  • We minimaliseren handmatige correcties

  • Door ISO en ISAE zijn processen strak ingericht, met heldere afspraken en vaste werkwijzen. Dat geeft rust en overzicht.

Daardoor ontstaat ruimte voor analyse, advies en optimalisatie. Je besteedt dus minder tijd aan brandjes blussen en meer tijd aan inhoudelijke vraagstukken waar jouw ervaring echt het verschil maakt

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Controleren en verwerken van de salarisadministratie conform wet- en regelgeving

  • Signaleren van afwijkingen en zorgen voor een correcte en tijdige verwerking

  • Fungeren als aanspreekpunt voor HR- en salarisvraagstukken, zoals vragen over cao’s en looncomponenten

  • Initiëren en ondersteunen van verbeterprocessen binnen de salarisadministratie

  • De onboarding van nieuwe klanten

Wat wij bieden

  • 💶 Salaris tot €5.500,- afhankelijk van ervaring

  • 📜 Jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast contract

  • 🏡 Hybride werken, reiskostenvergoeding en een lease fietsplan

  • 🌴 26 vakantiedagen, met mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen (max. 30)

  • 🎓 Interne en externe opleidingsmogelijkheden, waardoor jij je nog verder kunt ontwikkelen tot expert en voor het behalen van jouw benodigde jaarlijkse permanente educatiepunten voor het NIRPA register

  • 📈 Doorgroeimogelijkheden, bijvoorbeeld naar vakinhoudelijk trainer, specialist in AFAS inrichting of teamleider

  • 🏋️‍♂️ 3% vitaliteitsbudget, pensioenregeling

  • 👥 Een veilige werksfeer en een team wat voor elkaar klaar staat en successen met elkaar viert.

Wat wij verwachten:

  • Minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring in salarisadministratie

  • PDL- en/of VPS-diploma (of bereid dit te behalen)

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau

  • Nauwkeurigheid, analytisch inzicht en klantgerichte instelling

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands

Weten welke stappen jij kunt verwachten na jouw sollicitatie? Kijk hier.

title: Business Process Analist
description:
Voor een logistiek bedrijf met 1000 medewerkers regio Menen zijn we op zoek naar een Business Process Analist.

Wij zijn op zoek naar een ervaren én ambitieuze Business Process Analist die geen genoegen neemt met “zo doen we het al jaren”, maar energie krijgt van verbeteringen die echt zichtbaar zijn. Iemand die processen niet alleen in kaart brengt, maar ze ook durft uit te dagen en op die manier een sleutelrol speelt in onze digitale en organisatorische transformatie. Binnen deze transformatie zullen onze Business Process Analisten een belangrijke rol spelen in verschillende domeinen zoals supply chain, commercial, HR, en Finance.

De firma heeft recent hun procesarchitectuur hertekend, op basis van capabilities en end-to-end processen. Dat biedt jou de kans om mee te bouwen aan een moderne, procesgedreven organisatie. Naast het analyseren en verbeteren van processen, krijg je ook de kans om richting te geven aan onze procesarchitectuur en governance, en zo écht impact te hebben.

Functie

  • Je analyseert bestaande bedrijfsprocessen, identificeert optimalisatiekansen en vertaalt deze naar gedragen verbetervoorstellen. Daarbij adviseer je ook over de inzet van nieuwe technologieën en tools.
  • In nauwe samenwerking met zowel de business als IT werk je mee aan de uitwerking en implementatie van verbeterinitiatieven binnen de solution scope: je verzamelt informatie, leidt workshops en stemt af met de betrokken collega’s.
  • Je definieert samen met de betrokken stakeholders relevante KPI’s om verbeteringen meetbaar te maken, en volgt deze op om duurzame resultaten te borgen.
  • Je ondersteunt change management door teams te begeleiden en te motiveren tijdens (digitale) verandertrajecten.
  • Je neemt een trekkersrol op in het uitbouwen en bewaken van onze procesarchitectuur: je zorgt voor samenhang tussen processen, capabilities, systemen en strategische doelstellingen, en helpt mee aan een duidelijke procesgovernance.
  • Je bent sterk in het analyseren van processen en het begeleiden van workshops en presentaties.
  • Je hebt ervaring met processen in kaart brengen, kennis van BPMN is een troef.
  • Je hebt ervaring binnen een logistiek bedrijf of een productiebedrijf.
  • Ervaring met Lean Six Sigma-methodologie is een meerwaarde.
  • Ervaring in het begeleiden van digitale projecten (vb. ERP-implementaties) is een pluspunt.
  • Je hebt inzicht in procesarchitectuur en weet hoe je processen, capabilities en strategie met elkaar verbindt. Je denkt mee over kaders en standaarden die organisatiebreed toepasbaar zijn.
  • Je communiceert vlot met verschillende stakeholders: je durft het gesprek aan te gaan, luistert actief, stelt kritische vragen en weet anderen mee te nemen in verandering.
  • Je drukt je vlot uit in het Nederland, Engels en je kan je ook verwoorden in het Frans.

title: 22947 - JEDIT Policy Lead

description:
Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

If you are a current NPS employee, this vacancy may be available on a Loan basis for up to 2 years. Applications are invited from suitable qualified staff.

The Loan/Secondment is subject to the approval of the selected candidate's Business Unit, which should be obtained before confirmation of appointment.

Benefits

Annual Leave

-The holiday year runs from 1 March. If you work a non standard work pattern your leave entitlement may be expressed in either hours or days as appropriate. Leave entitlement is calculated on a pro-rata basis and you will be advised of your actual entitlement on appointment. If you were appointed internally and your leave was previously calculated in days, this will continue to be the case.

Bank, Public and Privilege Holidays

-You are entitled to 9 days (66 hours 36 minutes) in recognition of bank, public and privilege holidays.

Pension

-The Civil Service offers a choice of two pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Work Life Balance

HM Prison & Probation Service (HMPPS) is keen to encourage alternative working arrangements. Work life balance provides greater opportunities for staff to work more flexibly wherever managers and establishments can accommodate requests to do so. HMPPS offers flexible working subject to completion of a satisfactory probationary period and NVQ

Season Ticket Advance

-After two months’ service, you’ll be eligible to apply for a season ticket advance to purchase a quarterly or longer-period season ticket for travel between home and your place of work

Childcare Vouchers

For any moves across the Civil Service may have implications on your ability to carry on claiming childcare vouchers

Training

HMPPS is committed to staff development and offers a range of training and development opportunities, including areas such as Equality and Diversity, Dealing with Challenging Behaviour, Suicide Prevention and Anti Bullying Programmes

-There are opportunities to access promotion programmes and HMPPS provides a variety of training appropriate to individual posts

-All staff receive security and diversity training and an individual induction programme into their new roles

Eligibility

-All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

-All external candidates are subject to 6 months probation. Internal candidates are subject to probation if they have not already served a probationary period within HMPPS

-All staff are required to declare whether they are a member of a group or organisation which the HMPPS considers to be racist

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: M07 - Low-Code Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Digital Workplace Engineer with 2–3 years of experience to support SharePoint migration and develop practical solutions using SharePoint Online, Power Apps, and Power Automate.

The role focuses on migrating content, sites, and workflows from SG-DCS, SharePoint 2013, and other legacy environments to SharePoint Online. You will work with business users, product owners, and technical stakeholders to support migration activities, develop solutions, troubleshoot issues, and provide documentation and user support.

This is a hands-on delivery role and does not require broad ownership of Azure architecture or enterprise DevOps.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the migration of sites, documents, metadata, permissions, and workflows from SG-DCS, SharePoint 2013, and other legacy environments to SharePoint Online.
  • Assess existing content and environments to support migration planning, mapping, remediation, and execution.
  • Use migration tools such as ShareGate or Microsoft Migration Manager to execute migration jobs, review results, resolve errors, and validate migrated content.
  • Configure and maintain SharePoint Online sites, document libraries, lists, metadata, views, navigation, and permissions.
  • Build and enhance Power Apps and Power Automate workflows to support business processes and productivity requirements.
  • Develop or modify lightweight SharePoint components and integrations using SPFx, JavaScript, or TypeScript where required.
  • Support discovery workshops, content inventories, migration mapping, testing, cutover activities, and post-migration support.
  • Troubleshoot migration, access, workflow, and application issues, escalating complex issues where necessary.
  • Prepare technical documentation, test scripts, user guides, and migration status updates.
  • Work with users to validate migrated content, gather feedback, and implement improvements.
  • Apply relevant Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and development practices with guidance from senior team members.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 2–3 years of hands-on experience developing or supporting SharePoint, Microsoft 365, or Power Platform solutions.
  • Practical experience with SharePoint Online, including sites, document libraries, lists, metadata, permissions, and basic administration.
  • Hands-on exposure to SharePoint migration, including content assessment, migration execution, validation, or issue remediation.
  • Experience with ShareGate, Microsoft Migration Manager, or similar migration tools is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience building or maintaining Power Apps and Power Automate workflows.
  • Basic development experience with JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Exposure to SPFx, React, Microsoft Graph, or REST APIs is advantageous.
  • Strong troubleshooting and testing skills with the ability to resolve technical issues systematically.
  • Ability to prepare clear technical documentation and user guides.
  • Ability to work with business users and technical stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver practical solutions.
  • Familiarity with source control and basic software development practices.
  • Proactive and hands-on attitude with a willingness to learn and take ownership of assigned tasks.

Preferred Skills

  • Exposure to SharePoint 2013, SharePoint Server, SG-DCS, or other legacy collaboration platforms.
  • Experience supporting user acceptance testing (UAT), migration cutovers, or post-migration hypercare.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Lists, Forms, Dataverse, Power BI, or Microsoft 365 Copilot.
  • Basic understanding of records management, retention, access control, and information governance.
  • Experience working in government, regulated, or security-conscious environments.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer with 2–3 years of relevant experience and a strong interest in SharePoint migration and Power Platform development.
  • You should be comfortable executing migration activities, building straightforward applications and workflows, troubleshooting technical issues, engaging with users, and learning new tools and technologies.
  • Deep expertise in Azure architecture, enterprise integration, or CI/CD is not required for this role.

title: Access & Pricing Strategy Team Lead (United Kingdom)
description:
Make your mark for patients

We are looking for an Access & Pricing Strategy Team Lead who is strategic, influential, and collaborative to join our Global Patient Evidence organisation, helping shape payer, access, and pricing strategies that maximize patient access and long-term value across UCB's portfolio based in Slough, UK or Brussels, Belgium.

About the Role
As Access & Pricing Strategy Team Lead, you will combine strategic asset leadership with people leadership. Acting as a member of the Global Access and Pricing Strategy Leadership Team, and a key partner to Asset Payer Heads, you will help translate payer evidence, policy, pricing, and market access insights into actionable strategic choices that inform critical business decisions throughout the asset lifecycle.

This role sits at the heart of global access strategy, ensuring that payer perspectives are integrated early and consistently into development, evidence generation, pricing, and commercialization planning. In addition to leading strategy for designated asset indications, you will lead and develop a team of Access & Pricing Strategy Leads, strengthening capabilities, ways of working, and strategic excellence across the organization.

Who You’ll Work With
You will work closely with the Head of Global Access and Pricing Strategy, Asset Payer Heads, Patient Evidence, Patient Impact, HEOR, Real-World Evidence, Policy, Pricing, Commercial, Regional and Market Access teams, as well as a broad network of cross-functional stakeholders across the business.

You will act as a connector between functions, ensuring effective collaboration and alignment on payer evidence generation, pricing strategy, reimbursement planning, and launch readiness.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and develop a team of Access & Pricing Strategy Leads, providing coaching, capability building, and strategic guidance.
  • Act as a strategic partner to Asset Payer Heads, developing global payer access and pricing strategy, and global deliverables.
  • Lead payer strategy planning, evidence generation priorities, pricing strategy development, negotiation readiness activities and key global deliverables.
  • Define and operationalize global access and pricing strategies for assigned indications across the asset lifecycle.
  • Shape strategic options, risk assessments, and trade-off discussions to support governance and investment decisions.
  • Ensure alignment between Patient Evidence and Patient Impact teams to drive integrated access strategies.
  • Bring payer insights and recommendations into key decision-making forums and leadership discussions.
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration across HEOR, RWE, policy, pricing, commercial, and regional access functions.
  • Champion the use of advanced analytics, AI-enabled insights, and external market intelligence to strengthen payer planning.
  • Drive access and pricing excellence through governance, best practices, scalable processes, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Strengthen enterprise connectivity and create efficient ways of working that improve decision quality and organizational effectiveness.

Interested? For this role we’re looking for:

  • Degree in life sciences, health economics, public health, pharmacy, business, or a related discipline.
  • Significant experience in payer strategy, market access, pricing, health economics, commercial or related pharmaceutical functions.
  • Proven experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives and teams within global matrix organizations.
  • Strong understanding of payer evidence requirements, reimbursement processes, pricing strategy, and access planning.
  • Demonstrated people leadership experience, including coaching, capability development, and team management.
  • Strong strategic thinking, stakeholder engagement, influencing, and decision-making skills.
  • Experience leveraging analytics, digital tools, and AI-enabled insights to support strategic planning.

Are you ready to ‘go beyond’ to create value and make your mark for patients? If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you!

UCB is a global biopharmaceutical company, focusing on neurology and immunology. We are over 9.000 people in all four corners of the globe, inspired by patients and driven by science.

Why work with us?
At UCB, we don’t just complete tasks, we create value. We aren’t afraid to push forward, collaborate, and innovate to make our mark for patients. title: Moderators - Interactive Media
description:
Overview

Flexible Worker Contract

Location: Remote

About the role

We're looking for Moderators to join our External Quality Assurance team on a flexible worker contract for the following qualification:

Level 1/2 Technical Award in Interactive Media

As a Moderator, you'll play a key role in ensuring that centres assess learners fairly, accurately and consistently. You'll review centre-marked work, apply quality assurance principles, and provide clear, constructive feedback to ensure national standards are maintained.

We’re keen to hear from individuals with a strong background in interactive media, with experience of teaching and/or assessing learners in this subject area. You may currently work, or have previously worked, as an Interactive Media, Creative Media, Digital Media, Games Design, Animation or Multimedia teacher, lecturer, trainer or assessor.

Whilst this is a flexible worker role, we require a reasonable level of commitment throughout the moderation window. Moderation activities begin in March 2027 where you will be expected to attend one of our Annual Training sessions. The primary moderation period will be between April and August 2027, during which your engagement will be most critical.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Conducting moderation activities in line with awarding organisation and regulatory requirements
  • Attending standardisation and team meetings as required
  • Reviewing centre marking to ensure assessment decisions are accurate, consistent and meet required standards
  • Producing clear, accurate and timely moderation reports within agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Planning and managing moderation activity for allocated centres in line with sampling strategies and quality assurance requirements
  • Supporting continuous improvement by identifying areas for development and sharing best practice
  • Maintaining up-to-date knowledge of the qualification, assessment requirements and your subject-specialist area

We'd love to hear from you if you offer the following:

  • A relevant qualification at Level 3 or above in interactive media or a closely related subject area
  • Current or recent occupational experience working within the interactive media sector
  • Experience of teaching, assessing, internal quality assuring and/or moderating vocational or academic qualifications
  • Strong knowledge of assessment and quality assurance processes
  • Excellent written communication and report-writing skills
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to work independently and meet deadlines
  • A commitment to maintaining high standards and delivering a positive experience for centres

Feeling inspired? Read the full Job Description

Why work as a flexible worker for NCFE?

Our flexible workforce provides supportive quality assurance to ensure that learners taking NCFE qualifications are getting the best education possible. If you become a flexible worker with us, you’ll choose how to fit your work around your other personal and professional commitments – making this a great opportunity to make a difference in a way that suits you.

You’ll receive full training and the materials, tools or equipment needed to ensure you’re able to complete your duties in line with NCFE requirements, with the ability to take on flexible worker contract alongside other work, without the need to be registered as self-employed.

All applicants will be expected to adhere to NCFE’s behavioural framework and to uphold our core values.

You can find out more about how our flexible arrangements work, the flexible worker roles we recruit, and frequently asked questions around the application, induction and training process, and your rights and protections by visiting our Flexible worker opportunities page.

Shape real change with an NCFE career

Imagine a career where your contributions affect not only what people learn, but the way that learning is developed and delivered.

With over 170 years of education experience our core purpose remains at the heart of the organisation – to promote and advance learning to create a fairer, more inclusive society, making sure no learner is left behind.

Want to know more? Take a look at our website https://www.ncfe.org.uk/

How to apply

Before applying, please note that we require all candidates to be able to demonstrate proof of Right to Work in the UK.

Ready to join us and shape real change? Apply with your CV and answer the associated application questions.

Closing Date: Wednesday 2 December 2026

Interview Date: Ongoing

Interview Details: Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. If your application is shortlisted, we’ll contact you to complete a short task.

Equality, Diversity and Inclusion (EDI) statement

We're committed to building rich diversity into our workforce at all levels, to ensure that we understand and are representative of the communities and customers we serve.

We do not discriminate against anyone due to their gender, sexuality, race, age, religion, beliefs, identity, social background, visible or hidden disability, or neurodiversity. Instead, we pride ourselves on our collaborative, vibrant and high-performance culture which embraces everyone, celebrates uniqueness, and enables everyone's voice to be heard.

title: Cloud Operations-tekniker inom Linux och teknisk support till Elastx
description:
Vill du arbeta i ett operationscenter med Linux, teknisk felsökning och kundsupport? Hos Elastx blir du en viktig del av teamet som hanterar larm, löser tekniska problem och hjälper kunder i en svensk cloudplattform.

Om tjänsten

Elastx söker en tekniskt intresserad person till sitt operationscenter. Du blir en del av teamet som tar emot tekniska ärenden och fungerar som första kontakt när kunder behöver hjälp eller när något i plattformen behöver undersökas.

Rollen kombinerar Linux, teknisk support och cloud operations. Du arbetar med inkommande ärenden, initial felsökning och standardiserade åtgärder enligt etablerade playbooks. När ett problem kräver djupare teknisk kompetens eskalerar du det vidare till rätt team.

Du får arbeta nära kunder och erfarna engineers i en miljö där du successivt utvecklar dina kunskaper inom Linux, incidenthantering och cloud operations.

Arbetsuppgifter

Hantera inkommande supportärenden och larm.
Hjälpa kunder med tekniska frågor och återkoppla kring pågående ärenden.
Utföra initial felsökning i Linux- och cloudmiljöer.
Följa playbooks och genomföra definierade åtgärder.
Bedöma incidenter och eskalera mer komplexa ärenden till rätt tekniskt team.
Dokumentera felsökning, åtgärder och incidenter.
Bidra till förbättringar av rutiner, verktyg och interna arbetssätt.

Vi söker dig som

Har en relevant utbildning inom IT, nätverk eller systemadministration, eller har byggt motsvarande kunskaper genom praktisk erfarenhet. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början, men du ska ha ett genuint intresse för IT och teknik och vilja utvecklas inom Linux, teknisk support och cloud operations.

För rollen behöver du ha:

Grundläggande kunskaper i Linux och förståelse för teknisk drift.
Förmåga att felsöka problem metodiskt och hitta nästa steg.
Förmåga att följa playbooks, rutiner och teknisk dokumentation.
Förmåga att prioritera och hantera flera ärenden på ett strukturerat sätt.
Förmåga att kommunicera tydligt med både kunder och tekniska team.
Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift.

Erfarenhet av teknisk support, operationscenter, incidenthantering, IT-drift eller cloud operations är meriterande. Kunskaper inom nätverk, programmering eller scripting är också en fördel, liksom intresse för AI och teknisk utveckling.

För att trivas i denna roll tror vi att du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och strukturerad. Du tycker om att förstå hur tekniska system fungerar, tar ansvar för dina uppgifter och behåller lugnet när problem behöver lösas snabbt.

Om företaget

Elastx är en svensk molnleverantör som bygger och driver sin egen plattform för affärskritiska tjänster och känslig data. Bolaget arbetar med öppen källkod, Linux och Cloud Native-teknik och erbjuder bland annat OpenStack, Kubernetes och managerade plattformstjänster.

Elastx Cloud Platform är byggd för hög tillgänglighet och omfattar geografiskt separerade datacenter i Sverige. Här arbetar du nära både den fysiska infrastrukturen och den teknik som möjliggör säkra, skalbara och robusta molntjänster.

Övrig information

Omfattning: Heltid
Start: Så snart som möjligt med hänsyn till eventuell uppsägningstid
Placering: Flexibel. Du behöver inte vara bosatt i Stockholm.
Rekryteringsansvarig: Maja Dahlin
Lön: Fast månadslön

Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan. Kom ihåg att vara snabb med din ansökan då vi gör löpande urval och annonsen kan stängas innan tjänsten är tillsatt.

Om Friday

På Friday brinner vi för att ge dig som Tech-talang en riktigt bra start på karriären. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet.

Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering, där alla ges samma chans att lyckas.

Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.

title: Senior Director EMEA South
description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

What You’ll Do:

The Southern Europe Sales organization is responsible for establishing CoreWeave as the preferred AI cloud platform for enterprises, AI labs, digital-native companies, and emerging AI builders across France, Italy, Iberia, and the wider Mediterranean region. The team creates new markets, develops strategic customer relationships, and helps customers use CoreWeave’s infrastructure and software platform to build, deploy, and scale the next generation of AI.

About the role: The Senior Director of Sales, Southern Europe reports to the VP and Managing Director of EMEA. As the senior sales leader for the region, you will own CoreWeave’s commercial strategy and execution across all customer segments, with responsibility for both new-logo acquisition and the growth of existing customers. You will inherit an established customer base and a team spanning Account Executives, Account Managers, and Account Solutions Architects, while carrying a significant mandate to design and build the broader regional coverage model. This is a hands-on, first-on-the-ground leadership role for someone who can build the business, recruit and develop exceptional talent, and support market growth in coordination with EMEA leadership, and personally lead the region’s most strategic customer opportunities.

  • Own the Southern Europe business, including regional strategy, revenue performance, consumption growth, pipeline creation, customer acquisition, retention, and expansion.
  • Develop and execute a multi-year market-capture plan across France, Italy, Iberia, and the wider Mediterranean region, aligned to CoreWeave’s EMEA and global priorities.
  • Design the regional segmentation, territory, account, and coverage model across Enterprise, AI Labs, Digital Natives, and Startup customers.
  • Build and scale the regional sales organization, recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing leaders and individual contributors as the business grows.
  • Lead, coach, and develop Account Executives and Account Managers, establishing clear expectations, strong inspection disciplines, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Partner closely with Account Solutions Architects to connect customer business objectives with CoreWeave’s infrastructure, platform, and developer capabilities.

  • Represent regional customer requirements and market dynamics within CoreWeave, ensuring that global product, capacity, investment, and go-to-market decisions reflect the opportunities and needs of Southern Europe.
  • Establish CoreWeave’s reputation in the region through active participation in the AI, technology, business, research, and investment communities.
  • Build a regional culture that reflects CoreWeave’s values, rewards ownership, develops talent, encourages collaboration, and delivers best-in-class customer experiences.

Who You Are:

  • 15+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, including significant experience selling cloud infrastructure, AI platforms, data platforms, enterprise software, or similarly complex technology solutions.
  • 8+ years of sales leadership experience, including responsibility for senior sellers, managers, or multi-country commercial teams.
  • Demonstrated success building or materially scaling a country, regional, or multi-market sales organization.
  • A consistent record of meeting or exceeding significant revenue, bookings, consumption, pipeline, and customer-growth objectives.
  • Experience leading both new-logo acquisition and the expansion of complex, strategic customer relationships.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and close high-value, multi-year agreements involving senior executives, technical stakeholders, procurement teams, legal teams, and other complex buying groups.
  • Experience selling into multiple customer segments, ideally including large enterprises, high-growth technology companies, AI-native businesses, research organizations, and startups.
  • Experience designing segmentation, account allocation, territory, coverage, hiring, and resource-investment models.
  • Strong command of enterprise sales methodologies, account planning, opportunity management, pipeline inspection, forecasting, and performance management.
  • Proven ability to recruit, coach, and develop high-performing sales talent, including leaders and senior individual contributors.
  • The ability to engage credibly with both commercial and deeply technical audiences, translating customer objectives into infrastructure and platform strategies.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience structuring complex agreements and balancing customer requirements with capacity, risk, margin, and long-term strategic value.
  • A hands-on leadership style and willingness to remain personally involved in strategic selling, executive engagement, and critical negotiations.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively within a fast-growing, globally matrixed organization and align regional execution with global priorities.

Preferred:

  • You think beyond an individual transaction and seek to establish CoreWeave as a long-term strategic partner to the customers and markets you serve.Why CoreWeave?

Come join us!

title: ML Engineering Lead (LLM Ops)
description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

This role owns the operational lifecycle of Neko's LLM, GenAI and RAG based systems: deployment, monitoring, evaluation and iteration. It builds the production grade platform that lets clinical ML and GenAI workflows run reliably on proprietary sensor and device data, inside a regulated medical device QMS, across Skin, Cardio and other use cases. The role sits within the ML Engineering Area and integrates tightly with the existing MLOps team rather than as a silo, reflecting Neko's Tech-Enabled, Human-Centred vital in practice.

What You'll Deliver in the First 6-12 Months

● Stand up MLflow Tracing observability, prompts, tool calls, retrievals, latency and cost, live across production LLM and agent pipelines.

● Build an evaluation suite combining built-in and custom LLM judges and scorers, with a human-feedback loop via review apps, replacing today's ad hoc review.

● Ship at least one RAG or agentic pipeline to production with prompt and application versioning through the MLflow Prompt Registry and Unity Catalog, enabling safe rollout, A/B testing and rollback.

● Produce a documented cost, latency and GPU capacity framework for choosing serving strategy: third party API versus Databricks External Models versus self-hosted.

● Integrate LLM Ops tightly with the existing MLOps team so it operates as a natural extension of the platform rather than a separate track, protecting reliability on clinical workflows.

Minimum Qualifications

● Solid MLOps fundamentals across the full lifecycle, experiment tracking, training and monitoring, demonstrated through independent ownership of complex, production grade work.

● Fluent in Python and core ML concepts, with a track record of shipping end-to-end production ML systems and platformisation initiatives.

● Practical, hands-on experience building LLM or GenAI applications: prompt engineering, RAG, agents or chains, using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or comparable orchestration tools.

● Working knowledge of PyTorch, distributed systems and ML orchestration.

● Conceptual understanding of LLM-specific MLOps trade-offs: fine-tuning versus prompting versus RAG, vector databases, embedding models, and human-feedback loops for non-deterministic outputs. Hands-on fine-tuning ownership is not required, as execution sits with a separate track.

● Genuine, demonstrable motivation for LLM, GenAI and RAG work specifically, not generic MLOps, and the ability to navigate complex systems spanning the medical domain, regulation, firmware and hardware.

Preferred Qualifications

● Experience with agentic or AI-assisted coding workflows, provided the candidate retains full ownership and understanding of the resulting output.

● Kubernetes and Terraform, useful for infrastructure as code or self-hosting fine-tuned or open-source models outside managed serving.

● Exposure to LLM evaluation and observability practices: tracing, LLM-as-judge, guardrails and safety scorers. Databricks MLflow 3 for GenAI experience is a strong plus.

● Comfort navigating a fast-moving tools and platform ecosystem, and distilling recommendations relevant to Neko's specific context.

title: DevOps Manager bij WoodWing Xtendis
description:
Over WoodWing Xtendis

WoodWing helpt al meer dan 25 jaar organisaties in onder meer zorg, overheid, woningcorporaties en de financiële sector om grip te krijgen op hun content en documenten. Xtendis is ons enterprise information & document management systeem: veilig, gecertificeerd en gebouwd voor organisaties waarbij compliance en zorgvuldigheid van het grootste belang zijn. Met onze internationale organisatie en ons uitgebreide partner netwerk en door het benutten van up-/cross-sell en integratiemogelijkheden tussen de producten van onze groep bouwen we onze klantenbasis uit, zowel in Nederland als internationaal. Om de nationale en internationale ambities waar te maken draait Xtendis op twee platforms: lokale hosting om te voldoen aan de hoogste compliance-eisen en op AWS voor onze internationale groei. Eén product, twee platforms en dat vraagt om een team en een manier van werken die daarop is ingericht.

Waar je aan werkt

Je stapt in bij een team van 14 collega's, verdeeld over Development en Operations. Twee disciplines, één missie: Xtendis verder moderniseren en klaarmaken voor schaal. Als DevOps Manager geef je richting aan zowel de mensen als de technologie. Jij bent degene die het team, de tools, de technische keuzes en de manier van werken naar de toekomst begeleidt. Concreet betekent dat: Dev en Ops niet langer als twee gescheiden werelden, maar als één DevOps-praktijk. Jij zet die beweging in gang, jaagt de modernisering van onze software en infrastructuur aan, en zorgt dat schaalbaarheid en snelheid hand in hand gaan met stabiliteit en compliance.

Wat ga je doen

• Leidinggeven aan het team van 14 (Dev en Ops), hun ontwikkeling en onderlinge samenwerking.

• De DevOps-transitie vormgeven en uitvoeren: van twee gescheiden disciplines naar één geïntegreerde manier van werken.

• Verantwoordelijk dragen voor modernisering en schaalbaarheid van het Xtendis-platform, over zowel AWS als onze Nederlandse hostingomgeving heen.

• De commerciële en technische groeiambities, in Nederland én internationaal, vertalen naar een concrete technische roadmap.

• Stabiliteit, security en compliance bewaken – essentieel gezien de sectoren (zorg, overheid, finance) waarin Xtendis wordt ingezet.

• Nauw samenwerken met Product Management, Professional Services, Support en andere WoodWing-teams, zodat Xtendis stevig verankerd blijft in het bredere WoodWingecosysteem.

• Moderne DevOps-practices invoeren en verankeren: CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containerization en observability.

Wie ben jij

• Aantoonbare ervaring als (DevOps) manager of teamlead in een software- of SaaSomgeving, met leidinggevende ervaring aan een team van vergelijkbare omvang.

• Een sterke technische achtergrond in cloud- en hostinginfrastructuur (AWS en/of vergelijkbare platformen) • Ervaring met het samenbrengen van Development en Operations tot één DevOpscultuur. Je hebt dit eerder gedaan, of weet precies hoe je zo'n verandering aanpakt.

• Kennis van moderne DevOps-practices: CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containerization en observability/monitoring.

• Gevoel voor de balans tussen snelheid en innovatie enerzijds, en de stabiliteit, security en compliance die onze klanten in zorg, overheid en finance verwachten anderzijds.

• Sterke people skills: je coacht, verbindt en geeft richting, ook wanneer teams en manieren van werken veranderen. • Goede beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels, in woord en geschrift.

Wat werken bij ons aantrekkelijk maakt

  • Internationale en samenwerkende teams, waarin je werkt met collega’s uit verschillende landen

  • Een cultuur waarin eigenaarschap, vertrouwen en autonomie centraal staan

  • De kans om impact te maken binnen een groeiende organisatie

  • Teamevenementen en mogelijkheden om in contact te komen met collega’s wereldwijd

Wat wij bieden

• Een sleutelrol met echte impact, op een product dat al bewezen succesvol is én internationaal doorgroeit.

• De ruimte en het mandaat om Dev en Ops daadwerkelijk samen te smeden tot één DevOps-praktijk. Geen adviesrol, maar eigenaarschap.

• Een marktconform salaris en arbeidsvoorwaarden, passend bij deze verantwoordelijke rol. (6000-€7500 per maand op basis van fulltime)

• 26 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om er 5 bij te kopen.

• Een flexibel budget van 12% van je jaarsalaris, vrij te besteden.

• Pensioenregeling vanaf dag één en volledige reiskostenvergoeding.

• Een budget voor je thuiswerkplek.

• Collega's uit meer dan 20 nationaliteiten, gezamenlijke lunches en teamactiviteiten, en de flexibiliteit om je werk en privé goed te combineren.

Solliciteren

Herken jij jezelf in deze uitdaging en wil jij Xtendis en het team erachter naar het volgende niveau tillen? We horen graag van je!

  • Operate assigned security platforms as a service, including capacity planning, patching, upgrades, health monitoring, and vendor case management.

  • Support incident response and forensic investigations with platform expertise, evidence, and rapid containment actions.

title: Helpende Plus flexpool
description:
Wat ga je doen?
Als helpende plus in de flexpool werk je op verschillende locaties, afdelingen en met verschillende doelgroepen binnen BrabantZorg. Je helpt daar waar jouw inzet nodig is en draagt bij aan goede zorg voor onze cliënten.

De zorg gaat 24/7 door en de behoefte aan medewerkers verschilt per locatie en moment. Daarom verwachten we van jou dat je flexibel inzetbaar bent. Je werkt niet alleen overdag, maar bent ook beschikbaar voor diensten in de avonden, weekenden en op feestdagen. Daarnaast kan het nodig zijn dat je op verschillende locaties of afdelingen werkt, afhankelijk van waar de zorgbehoefte het grootst is.

Binnen die kaders heb je zelf invloed op je planning. Via ons roostersysteem InPlanning zie je de openstaande diensten en schrijf je jezelf in op beschikbare diensten. Je bent zelf verantwoordelijk voor het plannen van voldoende uren binnen je contract.

Zo is jouw dag ‘Elke dag zo fijn mogelijk’:

  • Je werkt op verschillende afdelingen met verschillende doelgroepen;

  • Je ondersteunt, begeleidt en verzorgt cliënten met ‘echte’ aandacht;

  • Je hebt invloed op je eigen planning;

  • Je draagt bij waar jouw inzet het hardst nodig is.

Voor de flexpool werken we met een contract van 0 tot 28 uur per week.

Soms is er een periodieke hulpvraag. Dit houdt in dat je de mogelijkheid krijgt om een periode-opdracht van minimaal vier weken tot maximaal zes maanden uit te voeren op één afdeling en/of locatie. Dit gaat altijd in overleg.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een contract van 0 tot 28 uur per week, waarbij je zelf invloed hebt op het plannen van je uren;

  • Een salaris volgens FWG 30 van de cao VVT;

  • Een goede pensioenregeling bij Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn (PFZW) en collectieve verzekeringen;

  • 8% vakantiegeld en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% (dat is een volledige dertiende maand);

  • Een uitgebreide keuze aan trainingen en opleidingen via de BrabantZorg Academie om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen;

  • En last but not least: fijne collega’s!

Wie ben jij?

Allereerst heb jij hart voor de ouderenzorg. Jij hebt een diploma tot Helpende mbo niveau 2, bij voorkeur aangevuld met een certificaat Helpende Plus.

Daarnaast:

  • Wil je invloed hebben op het invullen van je eigen diensten en werktijden;

  • Vind je het leuk om op verschillende locaties en met verschillende doelgroepen te werken;

  • Ben je flexibel inzetbaar, ook in de avonden, weekenden en op feestdagen;

  • Heb je voldoende digitale vaardigheden om goed met een computer en smartphone te kunnen werken.

Hebben wij jouw interesse kunnen wekken?

Solliciteer direct op de vacature via de knop ‘reageren’.

Wil je liever eerst even telefonisch contact, neem dan contact op met het flexpunt regio Den Bosch 06-53138100.

Overview

About the role

We’re looking for Examiners to join our Assessment Delivery team on a flexible worker contract for the following qualification:

  • An understanding of effective quality assurance and assessment processes
  • The ability to work consistently within tight deadlines
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

Feeling inspired? Read the full Job Description to find out more.

Why work as a flexible worker for NCFE?

Our flexible workforce provides supportive quality assurance to ensure that learners taking NCFE qualifications are getting the best education possible. If you become a flexible worker with us, you’ll choose how to fit your work around your other personal and professional commitments – making this a great opportunity to make a difference in a way that suits you.

You can find out more about how our flexible arrangements work, the flexible worker roles we recruit, and frequently asked questions around the application, induction and training process, and your rights and protections by visiting our Flexible worker opportunities page.
