title: Begeleider Niet Aangeboren Hersenletsel Amstelveen
description:
Echt bijdragen aan een goed leven voor onze cliënten met niet-aangeboren hersenletsel (NAH), daar gaat het om. Wil jij je verder ontwikkelen in dit vakgebied? Ons Tweede Thuis is op zoek naar een ervaren begeleiders voor deze doelgroep. Bij Ons Tweede Thuis werk je in hechte teams waarin jij zelf de regie hebt en écht gezien wordt.

Draag bij aan een toekomst waarin samenleving en zorg samenkomen

Frisse ideeën en nieuwe inzichten geven. Dat kenmerkt jou. En je zet het in om samen te werken aan een betekenisvol ervaring. Voor cliënten en voor jezelf. Samen met een team toegewijde collega’s zorg je als begeleider voor een positieve impact op het dagelijks leven van onze cliënten met NAH. Je biedt een veilige en betrouwbare omgeving waar iedereen zich gezien en gehoord voelt. Jij maakt het mogelijk als begeleider. Verder ben jij bezig met:

  • persoonlijke verzorging en begeleiding voor onze cliënten in hun dagelijks leven;

  • jij helpt hen als begeleider hen met het ontdekken van hun beperkingen én hun kwaliteiten;

  • verder in je werk zie je toe op de uitvoering van het zorgplan van cliënten en de dossiervoering.

Geen dag is hetzelfde, geen cliënt met NAH is hetzelfde. Door die veelzijdigheid blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen en raak je nooit uitgeleerd. Meer informatie over de NAH doelgroep kan je hier vinden: NAH - Werkenbij Ons Tweede Thuis

Concreet openstaande vacature(s)

Wij zoeken een begeleider op de volgende locatie:

Mozaïek is een mooie en levendige locatie in Amstelveen, waar 36 mensen met niet-aangeboren hersenletsel (NAH), een lichamelijke beperking (LG) of een autismespectrumstoornis (ASS) wonen, werken en leven in hun eigen tempo. Het biedt ruime, moderne appartementen die bewoners echt als hun thuis ervaren. Bij Mozaïek is er oog en plek voor iedereen. Hier wordt het leven omarmd, van kerst tot Keti Koti – elk feestje wordt gevierd zoals het hoort: samen, met aandacht en plezier. Je komt terecht in een enthousiast en betrokken team dat hecht samenwerkt en waar humor en hart voor de zorg hand in hand gaan. Dankzij de kleinschaligheid leer je bewoners en collega’s goed kennen, en bouw je écht iets op met elkaar. We werken met het Rooster BLIJ-project, wat maakt dat het mogelijk is om veel inspraak te hebben in je eigen rooster.

Jij krijgt

Als begeleider werk je 24-32 uur, afhankelijk van de openstaande vacatures op de locatie en jouw wensen. En je mag rekenen op:

  • een goed salaris: Als begeleider betekent dit tussen €2.951,- en € 3.980,- (schaal 40 van de CAO Gehandicaptenzorg).

  • extra’s die tellen: 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%.

  • tijdelijke bonus: Op sommige locaties een maandelijkse toelage van 7,5% bovenop je salaris.

  • eigen regie op extra arbeidsvoorwaarden via Epassi: Kies zelf hoe je jouw extra arbeidsvoorwaarden inzet via het digitale platform Alleo. Voor vitaliteit, ontwikkeling of gewoon extra vrije tijd.

  • vrije dagen: 18 verlofdagen + ruim 7 balansverlofdagen per jaar (naar rato). Dit laatste kun je opnemen, opsparen of investeren in jezelf.

  • pensioen bij Zorg en Welzijn: Goed geregeld voor later.

  • eigen ontwikkeling: Trainingen en cursussen om te groeien in je vak.

  • reiskostenvergoeding: Zodat je zorgeloos naar je werk reist.

Hierin herken jij jezelf

Net als jouw collega’s ben je nieuwsgierig, toegankelijk en praktisch ingesteld. Je staat sterk in je schoenen en laat je niet snel uit het veld slaan. Je blijft kalm en professioneel, ook wanneer emoties hoog oplopen. Je biedt duidelijke grenzen en structuur, zodat cliënten weten waar ze aan toe zijn. Ook heb je als begeleider niet aangeboren hersenletsel:

  • een (afgeronde) zorg opleiding op mbo4-niveau (MMZ/SPW).

  • je bent bereid onregelmatig te werken.

  • jij wilt je door ontwikkelen als expert op het gebied van NAH en/of NAH+, vooral het gedrag van de cliënten wil je beter begrijpen.

  • jij schrikt er niet voor terug om ook intensieve ADL zorg te geven.

Direct solliciteren of liever eerst meer informatie?

Ben je nieuwsgierig en wil je een goed leven geven aan cliënten met niet aangeboren hersenletsel? Houd jij wel van pionieren? Onderneem dan nu actie en solliciteer als begeleider niet aangeboren hersenletsel. Je krijgt binnen 2 werkdagen een reactie. Tijdens onze kennismaking horen we van jou graag wat jij wil. Jouw mening en wensen zijn belangrijk voor ons.

Wil je eerst meer weten over de functie, onze organisatie of de sollicitatieprocedure? Neem dan contact op met Martijn Smit via m.smit1@onstweedethuis.nl of 06-50192848.

Overige informatie

  • Deze vacature sluit zodra wij een collega gevonden hebben. Wacht dus niet te lang met solliciteren.

  • Het opvragen van een VOG (Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag) maakt deel uit van onze procedure.

title: Legal Lead Access & External Engagement Europe (UK)
description:
Make your mark for patients

We are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel (Legal Lead Access & External Engagement EU) who is collaborative, pragmatic and strategic to join our European Legal team, based in Europe within our hybrid working model. This role can be based in Brussels (Belgium), Slough (UK) or Madrid (Spain).

About the role

You will provide strategic, practical legal advice for market access, European medicines and patient-focused priorities across the product lifecycle. Acting as a trusted business partner, you will help teams make compliant, ethical and commercially sound decisions supporting launches, commercialization, access and portfolio management in epilepsy, rare diseases and immunology. You will assess risk, recommend clear options and support consistent legal approaches across Europe while contributing to selected cross-border and global initiatives.

Who you'll work with

You will be working in a team that brings together legal colleagues supporting European markets, medicines and patient impact. You will collaborate with senior business leaders and colleagues in Market Access, Medical Affairs, Business Development, regulatory, ethics, compliance, data privacy and global teams. You will also work with country legal leads and external counsel to align advice, manage risk and share knowledge across markets.

What you'll do

  • Provide independent, strategic legal advice across market access, commercialization and portfolio activities, clearly explaining risks, options and recommendations.
  • Support medicine launches, pricing, reimbursement, access initiatives, lifecycle planning and end-of-life strategies across Europe.
  • Advise on promotional materials, public communications, patient engagement, digital initiatives, medical education, scientific exchange and interactions with healthcare communities.
  • Guide teams on competition law, advertising rules, anti-bribery requirements, data privacy and other relevant European legal and compliance matters.
  • Draft, review and negotiate commercial and strategic agreements, and coordinate disputes, investigations, litigation and external counsel when required.
  • Contribute legal insight to European rare disease leadership discussions and advise on the positioning of medicines across key therapeutic portfolios.
  • Review market access business plans, identify legal and compliance considerations, and raise questions or material risks with clear recommended next steps.
  • Build market access knowledge, monitor legal and enforcement developments, and contribute to training and knowledge sharing across the legal community.

Interested? For this role we're looking for the following education, experience and skills

  • Qualified lawyer with commercial legal experience in the pharmaceutical sector in Europe.
  • Experience supporting medicine launches, market access, business operations, patient experience programs and product lifecycle strategies.
  • Experience advising medical and regulatory teams, including support for global medical and regulatory strategies in healthcare.
  • Knowledge of digital health or data privacy is an advantage; German language skills are preferred.
  • Ability to analyse complex legal issues, exercise sound judgement and manage several demanding projects in a matrix organisation.
  • Strategic and collaborative approach, with the ability to influence stakeholders and negotiate effectively.
  • Clear, adaptable communication skills and the ability to build constructive partnerships across functions and geographies.
  • High integrity, curiosity and awareness of the external legal environment, with the ability to turn developments into practical business guidance.

Are you ready to ‘go beyond’ to create value and make your mark for patients? If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you!

About us
UCB is a global biopharmaceutical company, focusing on neurology and immunology. We are over 9.000 people in all four corners of the globe, inspired by patients and driven by science.

Why work with us?
At UCB, we don’t just complete tasks, we create value. We aren’t afraid to push forward, collaborate, and innovate to make our mark for patients. We have a caring, supportive culture where everyone feels included, respected, and has equal opportunities to do their best work. We ‘go beyond’ to create value for our patients, and always with a human focus, whether that’s on our patients, our employees, or our planet. Working for us, you will discover a place where you can grow, and have the freedom to carve your own career path to achieve your full potential.

At UCB, we’ve embraced a hybrid-first approach to work, bringing teams together in local hubs to foster collaborative curiosity. Unless expressly stated in the description or precluded by the nature of the position, roles are hybrid with 40% of your time spent in the office.

UCB is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions will be made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Should you require any adjustments to our process to assist you in demonstrating your strengths and capabilities contact us on EMEA-Reasonable_Accommodation@ucb.com. Please note should your enquiry not relate to adjustments; we will not be able to support you through this channel.

title: Security Analyst - Miller Electric Company
description:
About Us

We design, install, and maintain advanced electrical systems. Our expertise spans traditional electrical contracting, security solutions, audio-visual integration, wireless networking, and building management systems.

Job Summary

Are you looking for a rewarding career as a Security Analyst?

Do you thrive in a team-focused environment where serving others is at the heart of what you do? If so, you may have just found your ideal opportunity.

For nearly 90 years, Miller Electric Company has been a proud signatory contractor with the IBEW, employing the most experienced and highly trained workforce in the industry. Our success is rooted in our core values—trust, collaboration, safety, quality, community, and stewardship—and in how we bring these values to life every day.

The Security Analyst is responsible for protecting the organization's systems, endpoints, networks, identities, and data through proactive monitoring, vulnerability management, incident response, security governance, and compliance oversight. The Security Analyst serves as the primary owner of the organization's Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) program and works closely with EMCOR Security Operations (SecOps) to ensure alignment with enterprise security standards, regulatory requirements, and cybersecurity best practices.

This role acts as the local security lead for Miller Electric, partnering with IT Operations, Infrastructure, Network Operations, and EMCOR SecOps to strengthen the organization's security posture while maintaining compliance with CMMC, NIST 800-171, and other applicable security frameworks.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Security Operations & Incident Response

  • Monitor, investigate, and respond to cybersecurity alerts, suspicious activity, and security incidents.
  • Coordinate incident response and remediation activities with EMCOR Security Operations (SecOps).
  • Perform threat analysis, root cause investigations, and security event documentation.
  • Escalate critical security risks and vulnerabilities as required.
  • Support organizational threat detection and response initiatives.

CMMC Compliance Program Management

  • Serve as the primary owner and coordinator of the organization's CMMC compliance program.
  • Lead efforts to maintain compliance with CMMC, NIST 800-171, and other applicable cybersecurity requirements.
  • Manage and maintain System Security Plans (SSPs), Plans of Action & Milestones, policies, procedures, and supporting compliance documentation.
  • Coordinate internal assessments, audit preparation, evidence collection, and external compliance reviews.
  • Track remediation efforts and ensure compliance gaps are addressed within established timelines.
  • Provide compliance status reporting and audit readiness updates to IT leadership.
  • Collaborate with EMCOR SecOps and business stakeholders to ensure required controls remain documented, implemented, and effective.

Vulnerability & Risk Management

  • Manage vulnerability identification, prioritization, tracking, and remediation activities.
  • Utilize vulnerability management solutions to identify and reduce organizational risk.
  • Partner with IT teams to remediate vulnerabilities and validate corrective actions.
  • Participate in risk assessments and security reviews of systems, applications, and infrastructure.

Security Platform Administration

  • Partner closely with EMCOR SecOps in the administration and monitoring of enterprise security tools.
  • Utilize and support platforms including:
    • Tanium
    • Tenable
    • Cortex XDR
    • Microsoft Azure / Entra ID
    • Microsoft Defender
    • Microsoft Intune
    • ScreenMeet
  • Monitor security dashboards and reports to identify emerging threats and compliance concerns.
  • Assist with security tool implementation, configuration, and ongoing improvements.

Endpoint Security Management

  • Monitor endpoint security posture and compliance across all managed devices.
  • Support endpoint hardening, encryption, and security baseline initiatives.
  • Investigate non-compliant devices and coordinate remediation activities.
  • Ensure endpoint protection technologies remain effective and properly configured.

Identity & Access Management

  • Support identity security initiatives within Microsoft Azure and Entra ID.
  • Assist with MFA, Conditional Access, privileged access management, and identity governance activities.
  • Participate in user access reviews and security audits.
  • Ensure access controls follow least-privilege and security best practices.

Security Awareness & Training

  • Develop cybersecurity awareness content and employee security communications.
  • Coordinate phishing simulations and user awareness campaigns.
  • Create and maintain security-related knowledge base documentation.
  • Promote security best practices across the organization.

Governance & Documentation

  • Maintain security policies, standards, procedures, and operational documentation.
  • Prepare security metrics, compliance reports, and executive summaries.
  • Support internal and external audit activities.
  • Maintain accurate records related to incidents, vulnerabilities, remediation efforts, and compliance initiatives.

Collaboration & Project Support

  • Collaborate with EMCOR Security Operations, Infrastructure, Network Operations, Service Desk, and Project Teams.
  • Participate in technology deployments, mergers, acquisitions, and business integrations from a security perspective.
  • Review new technologies, vendors, and applications for security and compliance considerations.
  • Ensure security requirements are incorporated into project planning and execution.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience managing security technologies and vulnerability remediation efforts.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, cloud technologies, networking, and risk management.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Strong communication skills and business acumen.

Preferred:

  • Security+, CySA+, CISSP, SSCP, ISC2 CC, or equivalent cybersecurity certifications.
  • Experience with:
    • Tanium
    • Tenable
    • Cortex XDR
    • Microsoft Defender
    • Microsoft Intune
    • Microsoft Azure / Entra ID
    • ScreenMeet
  • Experience supporting CMMC and NIST 800-171 compliance initiatives.
  • Experience working with audit preparation and regulatory compliance programs.

Core Competencies

  • Security Operations
  • Incident Response
  • Vulnerability Management
  • CMMC Program Administration
  • NIST 800-171 Compliance
  • Risk Management
  • Endpoint Security
  • Identity & Access Management
  • Security Awareness
  • Audit Readiness
  • Technical Documentation
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

Success Measures

  • Successful ownership and administration of the organization's CMMC compliance program.
  • Continuous readiness for CMMC assessments and compliance reviews.
  • Timely response and remediation of security incidents.
  • Reduction of organizational vulnerabilities and security risks.
  • Improvement in endpoint compliance and overall security posture.
  • Positive audit and compliance outcomes.
  • Strong partnership and coordination with EMCOR Security Operations.
  • Accurate maintenance of SSPs, POA&Ms, security documentation, and audit evidence.

title: Masters Thesis Software Engineer Intern
description:
Contract: 6-month internship

Start Date: Late January 2027

Work Model: Hybrid (3 days minimum onsite)


The Challenge Ahead


Frostbite is EA’s proprietary game engine, powering many of our leading titles across EA SPORTS, Battlefield, and more. We develop shared tools and technologies that connect and empower creators throughout EA. On Frostbite, you’ll collaborate with accomplished teams and contribute to the foundation that enables the creation of immersive, high-quality games for players worldwide.


As a Master's Thesis Intern, you will develop a project around real-time rendering in the context of videogames. You will also gain an understanding of what it's like to work at EA. An open application means that you can provide ideas for what you want to work on, but we can also explore this together, based on your experiences and interests


Tentative Topic Suggestions:

  • Tiny neural nets for rendering heuristics

    • Specular occlusion, TAA history update or rejection, micro shadowing. We have many smaller heuristics that are hand crafted or that are using some approximations to get a decent result. Can tiny neural nets be a way to further enhance them and can the NNs be made fast and small enough?

  • Cloth BSDF from first principles

    • Simulate behaviour of single cloth fiber, accumulate to strand, accumulate to cloth patch?

    • Scattering within the cloth?

  • Updating acceleration structures in dynamic scenes

    • Crowd ray tracing: number of instances, updating vertex positions etc challenging for 2-level raytracing hierarchies. Investigate alternative strategies for tracing rays against crowds

  • Ocean rendering

    • Have good motion vectors with ocean’s mesh - investigate how to represent movement of the waves to feed blur / up samplers. The challenge resides in the proximity to camera but also the decimation of the mesh that may cause a noisy interpretation of the ocean’s movement.

    • Foam BRDF - only a few papers about this and the challenge in real-time resides currently in low lighting situations where our current foam solution gets beige when sun is low when in real life foam/whitecaps remain white. Foam is considered as a porous heterogeneous material.


Responsibilities:


  • Research area around the chosen topic, to understand the current state of the art.

  • Develop new rendering ideas and write prototypes to test them.

  • You will report to an engineering manager, attend meetings, present progress information and write a final report.


Eligibility:


  • You are pursuing a MsC. in Computer Science (or a related field).

  • You are associated with a university education or any other type of education in Sweden that has an internship period planned into the education plan.


Skills:


  • You have experience with C++ and GLSL or HLSL.

  • You understand software development processes.

  • You have an interest in real-time rendering.

  • You have knowledge of rendering concepts like shader programming, lighting, shadows, materials


Help us make play happen. Apply now with an up-to-date CV and Cover Letter in English, explaining what project you would like to work on and explain your pick based on your interests and skills.

title: Finance and Administration Coordinator – Pacific Partnerships for Aviation (P4A)
description:
Job Description

Position: Finance and Administration Coordinator

Program: Australia – Pacific Partnerships for Aviation (P4A)
Location: Nadi, Fiji
Duration: Up to 30 June 2027 with extension options up to two years
Remuneration: FJ$35k to FJ$45k per annum plus local benefits

Reports To: P4A Operations Lead

About the Program

The Australia-Pacific Partnerships for Aviation (P4A) program is a 5-year regional aviation program jointly delivered by Adam Smith International (ASI) and the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade, headquartered in Nadi, Fiji. P4A has three key outcomes:

  1. A stronger enabling environment for aviation

  2. Improved safety, quality and reliability

  3. Greater coordination, cooperation, and connectivity

P4A will also mainstream cross-cutting sectors to ensure outcomes strengthen child protection and safeguarding, climate change resilience and adaptation, support locally led leadership and improve Gender Equality, Disability and Social Inclusion (GEDSI) outcomes.

Position Summary

The Finance and Administration Coordinator will support the Operations Team by managing field-office finance processes and coordinating office administration, events and broader program support required to deliver P4A activities. The role will help ensure that the P4A office operates efficiently and that financial and administrative processes are completed accurately, promptly and in accordance with program requirements.

The Finance and Administration Coordinator will report to the Operations Lead and support the wider Operations Team..

Duties and Responsibilities

The responsibilities of the Finance and Administration Coordinator (the Coordinator) include three main areas of support:

Finance

  • Manage all payments through the FJD account, including payroll and operational expenses, and prepare monthly FNPF, PAYE and other applicable social security remittances for national and international staff.

  • Prepare monthly cash flow projections to support funds requests from the Head Office (HO)

  • Issue and collect project advances made to staff, and reconcile bank accounts and field advance accounts each month;

  • Record all financial transactions in ASI - OS financial management system and submit monthly Field Office Expense Reports;

  • Maintain complete, accurate and auditable records of all field-office financial transactions and supporting documentation.

  • With the approval of the Senior Program Accountant, execute approved payments to local vendors, subcontractors and consultants for goods and services received, in accordance with ASI and DFAT policies.

  • Liaise and maintain cordial working relationships with all local/overseas vendors;

  • Liaise with the bank on foreign currency rates, bank charges, fund transfers and payments;

  • Monitor field-office bank accounts, liaise with the bank on account matters and complete monthly bank reconciliations.

  • Maintain the field-office asset register and supplier list, ensuring both records remain accurate and current.

  • Oversee field office petty cash accounts for Fiji office;

  • Provide the required assistance to teams conducting internal and external reviews/audits;

  • Ensure all project accounting functions are performed within the procedures set in the Operations Manual and within DFAT guidelines;

  • Other financial management tasks consistent with this Scope of Work and as requested by the Senior Program Accountant.

Office and Event Coordination & Administration

  • Manage day-to-day office requests and ensure timely resolution of administrative needs.

  • Assist with general office maintenance, coordinating with building management and service providers.

  • Maintain office supplies and equipment, ensuring availability and functionality.

  • Assist in the setup and upkeep of office systems, including filing, scheduling, and development / refinement of program documentation such as templates, tools etc.

  • Manage the reception area, ensuring it is tidy, welcoming, and well-stocked with necessary materials.

  • Handle visitor sign-ins, direct guests appropriately, and manage meeting room bookings.

  • Coordinate office errands and runs, including deliveries, pickups, and other logistical tasks.

  • Assist in planning and executing office functions, meetings, and staff events.

  • Liaise with vendors for catering, venue setup, and other event-related services.

  • Work closely with the Operations Team and other team members to ensure seamless office operations.

  • Provide administrative support to staff, including printing, scanning, and document preparation including formatting, development of templates etc.

  • Support onboarding of new staff by preparing workstations and coordinating introductory briefings.

  • Maintain effective communication between the P4A Operations Team and broader program teams, particularly on procurement and financial management matters.

  • Ensure smooth execution of internal and external office functions, maintaining professionalism and efficiency.

  • If required, assist the Communications Team in relation to (i) taking of photographs or videos of program functions or meetings to support development of media products. On the job training related to these tasks will be provided.

Monitoring & Evaluation (MEL) Administrative Support

Working with the Monitoring and Evaluation Senior Specialist, to:

  • Support data collection, entry and updating of MEL trackers, databases and activity records.

  • Transcribe interviews, focus group discussions and stakeholder consultations and organise transcripts for analysis.

  • Under the guidance of the MEL Team, create and set up online survey forms.

  • Support accurate filing and organisation of MEL data, reports and supporting evidence, including attendance records, survey responses, reports and other means of verification in SharePoint.

  • Support the collection and tracking of relevant social media posts from P4A, partners and aviation agencies in a central tracking document.

Qualifications and Experience

  • A tertiary qualification in administration, business administration, finance or a related field.

  • Minimum of two years of relevant professional experience.

  • Prior experience in a similar role or organisational environment is an advantage.

  • Knowledge and experience of NGO and donor- funded programs is preferred;

  • Strong organisational skills and excellent interpersonal communication skills;

  • Proficiency in MS Office and financial management software.

How to Apply

Interested applicants should submit:

• A current CV
• A cover letter addressing the selection criteria and demonstrating their suitability for the role

Applications should include a current CV and a brief cover letter outlining relevant experience against the responsibilities and selection criteria for the role. Applications must be submitted by 11:59pm AEDT on 25 October 2026.

Please note that applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Adam Smith International is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applications from people of all backgrounds, including women, people with disabilities and candidates from Pacific Island countries.

title: Senior Data Architect - Knowledge Engineering
description:
Accenture, recognized as a Great Place To Work®, is a leading global professional services company that helps major businesses, public administrations, and other organizations around the world develop their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth, and improve services for citizens, creating tangible value at speed and scale.

We are looking for experienced Knowledge Graph Engineers to join our Data & AI practice in Spain.

This role is available in Seville, Málaga, Alicante, or Gijón and follows a hybrid working model, combining remote work with in-office collaboration to foster innovation, knowledge sharing, and close teamwork.

Candidates must reside in Spain and hold a valid permit to work in Spain.

YOU ARE

Technical expert in graph data architecture and ontology engineering, capable of designing and delivering semantic data solutions across industries and technology stacks. Works as the lead architect in delivery engagements, owning the technical design from domain modelling through to production deployment. Operates across AWS and Azure environments and across a broad range of graph and semantic tooling. You lead a significant knowledge engineering scope and function within a large program; actively contribute to thought leadership. You shape how a substantial body of work formulates real‑world problems into scalable AI and KG solutions, and set the technical direction for that scope. You lead a team and guide exploration and implementation of new methodologies, model building techniques, and cutting‑edge algorithms. You remain at the forefront and drive innovation by applying these techniques to new business problems, use cases, and scenarios. You design, evaluate, and maintain ontologies, and establish the standards others follow. You justify the value to business and technology stakeholders, and construct the methodologies and data architectures that demonstrate it. You publish or present perspective beyond the immediate project. You work across business and technical teams to drive end‑to‑end delivery for their scope.

THE WORK

  • Leads the build of Knowledge Graph solutions that transform a client's data architecture within program scope.
  • Directs the design, development, and implementation of AI and semantic solutions, ensuring all the pieces work together seamlessly.
  • Works with project leaders, delivery leads, and client stakeholders to create stand‑out, graph-powered Data & AI offerings.
  • Develops strong client relationships and earns the trust of key advisors.
  • Makes the business case for the semantic layer solution recommended to the client.
  • Contributes meaningfully to Accenture sales and pre‑sales efforts.
  • Provides thought leadership on technology trends, new opportunities, innovations, and foreseeable limitations, risks, and concerns.

EDUCATION

  • MSc or BSc in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a related field.

Basic (required) Qualification

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent, plus at least 3 of the following:
  • Proven experience in data engineering, software engineering, or AI engineering, with solutions deployed in production.
  • Experience with strong knowledge of relational databases, object stores, graph databases (Stardog, Neo4J, Amazon Neptune, Azure Cosmos DB, Allegro Graph), and vector databases.
  • Strong proficiency in graph query languages: SPARQL and/or Gremlin / Cypher
  • Hands‑on experience with at least two graph database platforms across different paradigms (RDF triple store + property graph)
  • Experience integrating graph layers with enterprise metadata and governance platforms (Collibra, Informatica, Apache Atlas, Alation or similar)
  • Cloud data architecture competence on AWS and/or Azure: storage, processing, and orchestration layers
  • Strong Python skills with experience in frameworks like Tensorflow, PyTorch, with tools for building ETL pipelines (e.g. Apache NiFi, Airflow) and advanced SQL as everyday working tools.
  • Experience in schema design, ontology management, and KG curation
  • Having worked in designing and developing Knowledge Graph solutions and graph‑based ML models (functional + technical)
  • Experience with end‑to‑end data pipeline implementation for AI applications (esp. LLMs), with hands‑on design and configuration
  • Fluency Spanish and a high level of understanding and communicating in English

Preferred Qualification

  • Proven hands‑on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Practical experience with NLP and/or Search techniques
  • Prompt engineering, and LLMs for enterprise-scale applications.
  • You have team lead experience
  • Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work across engineering, research, and product teams across multiple time zones.
  • You have external client-facing consulting experience
  • Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Broad experience in diverse ML techniques and agentic systems.

At Accenture, recognized as a Great Place To Work®, we are committed to a hybrid work model that, supported by technology and our office spaces, enables us to maintain the essential human connection needed to collaborate effectively with our teams and clients. This connection helps us foster our culture of inclusion and diversity and has contributed to being recognized by Refinitiv as one of the world's most diverse companies.

title: Helpende flexpool
description:
Wat ga je doen?
Als helpende in de flexpool werk je op verschillende locaties, afdelingen en met verschillende doelgroepen binnen BrabantZorg. Je helpt daar waar jouw inzet nodig is en draagt bij aan goede zorg voor onze cliënten.

De zorg gaat 24/7 door en de behoefte aan medewerkers verschilt per locatie en moment. Daarom verwachten we van jou dat je flexibel inzetbaar bent. Je werkt niet alleen overdag, maar bent ook beschikbaar voor diensten in de avonden, weekenden en op feestdagen. Daarnaast kan het nodig zijn dat je op verschillende locaties of afdelingen werkt, afhankelijk van waar de zorgbehoefte het grootst is.

Binnen die kaders heb je zelf invloed op je planning. Via ons roostersysteem InPlanning zie je de openstaande diensten en schrijf je jezelf in op beschikbare diensten. Je bent zelf verantwoordelijk voor het plannen van voldoende uren binnen je contract.

Zo is jouw dag ‘Elke dag zo fijn mogelijk’:

  • Je werkt op verschillende afdelingen met verschillende doelgroepen;

  • Je ondersteunt, begeleidt en verzorgt cliënten met ‘echte’ aandacht;

  • Je hebt invloed op je eigen planning;

  • Je draagt bij waar jouw inzet het hardst nodig is.

Voor de flexpool werken we met een contract van 0 tot 28 uur per week.

Soms is er een periodieke hulpvraag. Dit houdt in dat je de mogelijkheid krijgt om een periode-opdracht van minimaal vier weken tot maximaal zes maanden uit te voeren op één afdeling en/of locatie. Dit gaat altijd in overleg.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een contract van 0 tot 28 uur per week, waarbij je zelf invloed hebt op het plannen van je uren;

  • Een salaris volgens FWG 25 van de cao VVT;

  • Een goede pensioenregeling bij Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn (PFZW) en collectieve verzekeringen;

  • 8% vakantiegeld en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% (dat is een volledige dertiende maand);

  • Een uitgebreide keuze aan trainingen en opleidingen via de BrabantZorg Academie om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen;

  • En last but not least: fijne collega’s!

Wie ben jij?

Allereerst heb jij hart voor de ouderenzorg. Jij hebt een diploma tot Helpende mbo niveau 2.

Daarnaast:

  • Wil je invloed hebben op het invullen van je eigen diensten en werktijden;

  • Vind je het leuk om op verschillende locaties en met verschillende doelgroepen te werken;

  • Ben je flexibel inzetbaar, ook in de avonden, weekenden en op feestdagen;

  • Heb je voldoende digitale vaardigheden om goed met een computer en smartphone te kunnen werken.

Hebben wij jouw interesse kunnen wekken?

Solliciteer direct op de vacature via de knop ‘reageren’.

Wil je liever eerst even telefonisch contact, neem dan contact op met het flexpunt regio Uden 06-16830415.

title: Digital Technology Lead - Omnichannel
description:
Make your mark for patients

We are looking for a Digital Technology Lead - Omnichannel who is strategic, innovative, and business-focused to join our Digital Technology Patient Impact U.S. team, based in Atlanta, Georgia. This hybrid role requires a minimum of 40% on-site presence and up to 10% domestic travel.

About the Role

You will play a key role in advancing UCB's omnichannel capabilities by transforming customer engagement data into actionable business insights. Working at the intersection of Commercial, Marketing, Omnichannel Strategy & Operations (OSO), and Insights to Impact (I2I), you will drive the analytics, data products, and AI-enabled capabilities that support more personalized and effective engagement with healthcare professionals (HCPs). You will lead the evolution of UCB's omnichannel data and analytics ecosystem, connecting CRM, media, digital, agency, field force, and third-party data to improve measurement, optimization, and decision making across commercial teams. This is a highly visible role that combines approximately 50% strategy and 50% execution, providing leadership on omnichannel analytics, orchestration, and next-best-action capabilities while delivering solutions that create measurable business impact.


Who You'll Work With

You'll partner closely with Omnichannel Strategy & Operations, Insights to Impact (I2I), Commercial Brand Teams, Marketing, Commercial Operations, Data Engineering, Data Governance, AI, and Digital Technology teams to advance UCB's omnichannel capabilities. You'll collaborate with senior business and technology leaders to define priorities, shape investment decisions, and evolve analytics and data product strategies. Externally, you'll work with media agencies, commercial data providers, consulting partners, and technology vendors to integrate data sources and deliver analytics solutions that support commercial objectives. This role requires someone who can confidently engage both business and technical stakeholders, translating commercial needs into scalable data and analytics capabilities.


What You'll Do

  • Omnichannel Strategy & Measurement: Develop analytics frameworks that measure customer engagement, channel effectiveness, customer journeys, and business impact across omnichannel programs.
  • Data Product Leadership: Lead the evolution of omnichannel data products by integrating CRM, media, digital, agency, field force, and third-party data into a unified customer view.
  • Customer Journey Analytics: Develop analyses and predictive models that improve understanding of HCP engagement patterns, channel preferences, and customer behavior.
  • Omnichannel Orchestration & AI: Support personalization, next-best-action initiatives, and omnichannel orchestration programs through analytics and AI-driven insights.
  • Performance Optimization: Establish and harmonize KPIs to measure and optimize omnichannel performance across channels and campaigns.
  • Data Governance & Integration: Ensure trusted, high-quality data is available to support commercial decision making and analytics.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Commercial, Marketing, I2I, Digital Technology, Data Engineering, and external partners to deliver scalable analytics solutions.
  • Innovation & Roadmap Development: Help shape the future direction of omnichannel analytics, data products, customer engagement technologies, and AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Compliance & Privacy: Ensure data is managed in accordance with privacy regulations, governance standards, and ethical data practices.


Interested? For this role we're looking for the following education, experience and skills

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Marketing Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 8-10+ years of experience in analytics, marketing analytics, commercial insights, or related disciplines.
  • 5+ years leading analytics initiatives within complex organizations.
  • Pharmaceutical or life sciences commercial analytics experience, including at least 2 years supporting HCP omnichannel engagement across CRM, media, digital, agency, field force, and third-party data sources.
  • Experience leading analytics or data product initiatives.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure, Databricks, or similar cloud-based analytics platforms.
  • Strong understanding of campaign measurement, KPI development, customer journey analytics, and data governance.
  • Ability to effectively engage business and technical stakeholders across Commercial, Digital Technology, and Insights to Impact organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Marketing Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Experience with commercial healthcare datasets such as IQVIA.
  • Experience with Salesforce, Veeva, Power BI, Qlik, or similar commercial technology platforms.
  • Experience supporting omnichannel orchestration and next-best-action capabilities.
  • Experience managing vendor-delivered analytics or technology solutions.
  • Knowledge of AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics methodologies.
  • Experience establishing and evolving enterprise analytics platforms and operating models.
  • Knowledge of pharmaceutical compliance requirements.
  • Strong change management and stakeholder influence experience.

The reasonably anticipated salary range for this position is $ 148,000-194,300 per year. The actual salary offered will take into account related knowledge, skills, experience and location among other factors and may fall outside the expected range.

Are you ready to ‘go beyond’ to create value and make your mark for patients? If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you!

About us

Working for us, you will discover a place where you can grow, and have the freedom to carve your own career path to achieve your full potential.

At UCB, we’ve embraced a hybrid-first approach to work, bringing teams together in local hubs to foster collaborative curiosity. Unless explicitly stated in the description or precluded by the nature of the position, roles are hybrid with 40% of your time spent in the office.

UCB is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions will be made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. title: Examiners - Education and Early Years
description:
Overview

Flexible Worker Contract

Location: Remote

About the role

We’re looking for Examiners to join our Assessment Delivery team on a flexible worker contract for the following qualification:

T Level Technical Qualification in Education and Early Years

As an Examiner, you’ll use your subject knowledge to mark external assessments and submit results throughout the summer 2027 marking window, helping to ensure learners receive fair, consistent and accurate results.

If you’re an Early Years or Childcare teacher, lecturer, trainer or assessor, this is a great opportunity to put your expertise to use and make a valuable contribution to the assessment of learners.

Marking window dates are subject to change and will be communicated throughout the process should you be successful.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Following and maintaining the standard set by the Chief Examiner, applying the mark scheme consistently and accurately
  • Reporting suspected malpractice or safeguarding concerns to the Assessment Delivery team
  • Attending examiner standardisation and other meetings as required – standardisation events will be run remotely and scheduled for weekdays between the hours of 9.00am-5.00pm prior to the start of the marking window
  • Maintaining the confidentiality of NCFE assessment materials, learner evidence and learner details, and report any breaches to the Assessment Delivery team

We'd love to hear from you if you offer the following:

  • A relevant qualification at Level 3 or above in education and early years or a closely related subject area
  • Current or recent teaching experience at Level 3 or above in an education and early years related subject, or significant recent occupational experience within the sector
  • An understanding of effective quality assurance and assessment processes
  • The ability to work consistently within tight deadlines
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

Feeling inspired? Read the full Job Description to find out more.

Why work as a flexible worker for NCFE?

Our flexible workforce provides supportive quality assurance to ensure that learners taking NCFE qualifications are getting the best education possible. If you become a flexible worker with us, you’ll choose how to fit your work around your other personal and professional commitments – making this a great opportunity to make a difference in a way that suits you.

You’ll receive full training and the materials, tools or equipment needed to ensure you’re able to complete your duties in line with NCFE requirements, with the ability to take on flexible worker contract alongside other work, without the need to be registered as self-employed.

All applicants will be expected to adhere to NCFE’s behavioural framework and to uphold our core values.

You can find out more about how our flexible arrangements work, the flexible worker roles we recruit, and frequently asked questions around the application, induction and training process, and your rights and protections by visiting our Flexible worker opportunities page.

Shape real change with an NCFE career

Imagine a career where your contributions affect not only what people learn, but the way that learning is developed and delivered.

With over 170 years of education experience our core purpose remains at the heart of the organisation – to promote and advance learning to create a fairer, more inclusive society, making sure no learner is left behind.

Want to know more? Take a look at our website https://www.ncfe.org.uk/

How to apply

Before applying, please note that we require all candidates to be able to demonstrate proof of Right to Work in the UK.

Ready to join us and shape real change? Apply with your CV and answer the associated application questions.

Closing Date: Wednesday 2 December 2026

Interview Date: Ongoing

Interview Details: Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. If your application is shortlisted, we’ll contact you to complete a short task.

Equality, Diversity and Inclusion (EDI) statement

We're committed to building rich diversity into our workforce at all levels, to ensure that we understand and are representative of the communities and customers we serve.

We do not discriminate against anyone due to their gender, sexuality, race, age, religion, beliefs, identity, social background, visible or hidden disability, or neurodiversity. Instead, we pride ourselves on our collaborative, vibrant and high-performance culture which embraces everyone, celebrates uniqueness, and enables everyone's voice to be heard.

title: Senior GCP Platform Engineer
description:
Vi söker en Senior GCP Platform Engineer till Data & Analytics-funktionen inom en större organisation med en komplex och datadriven IT-miljö. Du blir en del av ett Platform & Enablement-team som ansvarar för att utveckla säkra, skalbara och tillförlitliga molnplattformar som används av flera Data & Analytics-team.

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag på heltid med placering i Solna, med start 2 november 2026 och planerat slutdatum 30 april 2027, med möjlighet till förlängning.

Om rollen

Som Senior GCP Platform Engineer kommer du att arbeta med design, utveckling och kontinuerlig förbättring av molnbaserade plattformsförmågor med Google Cloud Platform (GCP) som central plattform.

Uppdraget kombinerar hands-on engineering med plattformsdesign, automation, säkerhet, tillförlitlighet och developer enablement. Du arbetar i en komplex enterprise-miljö och samarbetar nära plattformsutvecklare, data engineers, arkitekter, säkerhetsspecialister och andra tekniska intressenter.

Rollen passar dig som kan arbeta självständigt, ta ett tydligt tekniskt ägarskap och bidra både operativt och strategiskt till den fortsatta utvecklingen av en modern GCP-baserad plattform.

Arbetsuppgifter:

Designa, bygga och kontinuerligt förbättra plattformsförmågor på Google Cloud Platform.
Arbeta hands-on med GKE, Kubernetes och containerbaserade workloads.
Utveckla och underhålla Infrastructure as Code, primärt med Terraform.
Bidra till CI/CD och GitOps-baserade leveransflöden.
Arbeta med nätverk, IAM, säkerhet och accesshantering inom GCP.
Utveckla återanvändbara plattformskomponenter och möjliggöra self-service för utvecklingsteam.
Arbeta med monitoring, logging, observability och plattformens operativa tillförlitlighet.
Stötta engineering-team vid onboarding av workloads till plattformen.
Samarbeta nära med arkitekter, säkerhetsspecialister och utvecklingsteam för att säkerställa skalbara och säkra plattformslösningar.
Bidra till tekniska standarder, gemensamma patterns och långsiktig vidareutveckling av plattformen.

Vi söker dig som

Har erfarenhet på senior nivå inom Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering eller DevOps.
Har flera års aktuell och praktisk produktionserfarenhet av Google Cloud Platform.
Har stark praktisk erfarenhet av GKE och Kubernetes.
Har gedigen hands-on erfarenhet av Terraform och Infrastructure as Code.
Har erfarenhet av att designa eller utveckla cloud platform foundations och landing zones.
Har erfarenhet av IAM, Workload Identity, nätverk och cloud security.
Har gedigen erfarenhet av CI/CD och automatiserade leveransflöden för mjukvara och infrastruktur.
Har erfarenhet av monitoring, logging och observability i molnmiljöer.
Har erfarenhet av att stötta flera utvecklings- eller engineering-team genom gemensamma plattformsförmågor.
Kan arbeta självständigt och ta ett tydligt tekniskt ägarskap i en komplex enterprise-miljö.
Har mycket goda kunskaper i engelska.

Meriterande

Det är starkt meriterande om du har erfarenhet av ett eller flera av följande områden:

GCP Data Services, exempelvis BigQuery, Dataflow och Pub/Sub.
Apache Beam.
Data ingestion och/eller streamingplattformar.
GitOps.
Helm.
Backstage eller Internal Developer Platforms.
Python och Bash.
Nätverks- och säkerhetstjänster inom Google Cloud.
Multi-cloud-miljöer där GCP kombineras med Azure och/eller AWS.
Platform Engineering inom reglerade eller säkerhetskritiska enterprise-miljöer.
Developer self-service och platform enablement.
Goda kunskaper i svenska.

Personliga egenskaper

Vi söker dig som är en senior och självgående engineer med förmåga att ta tekniskt ägarskap och lösa komplexa plattformsutmaningar. Du kombinerar stark hands-on teknisk kompetens med förståelse för långsiktig plattformsutveckling, säkerhet, stabilitet och skalbarhet.

Du trivs med att samarbeta över flera tekniska områden och med att skapa lösningar, automation och self-service som gör det enklare för andra utvecklingsteam att arbeta effektivt.

Din ansökan

Låter rollen intressant och passande? Ansök i så fall omgående för vi intervjuar löpande och rollen kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum. Vi kan enbart ta emot och bearbeta din ansökan genom att du registrerar ditt CV i vår portal. Med avseende på GDPR kan vi ej ta emot ansökningar via e-post. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! Uppdraget är en del av Quest Consulting personaluthyrning.

Om oss

Quest Consulting är ett auktoriserat konsultbolag med kollektivavtal, försäkringar, friskvård och tjänstepension. Vi är specialiserade inom IT, Teknik, HR, Administration och Ekonomi. Vår målsättning är att vara din personliga samarbetspartner och just därför är det så viktigt för oss att arbeta efter våra kärnvärden där våra ledord är att vara Personliga, Nyskapande och Professionella.

title: 22914 - Team Leader
company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). All employees will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in an office, subject to local estate capacity.

Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised role: all successful candidates will be appointed to the nearest viable office nearest to their home postcode and on its respective pay scale. This will be at either a HQ building (subject to desk allocation, a Justice Collaboration Centre (JCC) or a Justice Satellite Office (JSO) – See Map. All employees will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in an office, subject to local estate capacity).

For current MoJ employees, your base location will need to be changed to the nearest viable office (to your home postcode), either at a HQ building, JCC or JSO within the National Office Network and moved its location’s respective pay scale (any legacy arrangements/locations will need to be amended).

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

MoJ candidates who are on a specialist grade, will be able to retain their grade on lateral transfer.

All candidates who are currently in receipt of Mark Time / Pay Protection should ensure they are familiar with the new policy on permanent and temporary promotion which can be found on the employee intranet.

Flexible working hours

The Ministry of Justice offers a flexible working system in many offices. Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week. MoJ welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the MoJ’s Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service.

There is also a scheme to allow qualifying staff to buy or sell up to three days leave each year. Additional paid time off for public holidays and 1 privilege day. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis.

Pension

The Civil Service offers a choice of pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender employees.

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5359 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Data Science Engineer
description:
Salary: $11,000 – $16,500 per month

Be at the forefront of AI, Digital Health & Clinical Innovation

Join a high-impact Digital Health team where data science, artificial intelligence, and clinical research come together to shape the future of healthcare.

As a Digital Health Data Science Engineer, you will play a key role in developing digital biomarkers, AI-powered clinical analytics and innovative data platforms. Based in Singapore, you will work closely with global teams while serving as a key technical representative for Digital Health initiatives involving the Lilly Centre for Clinical Pharmacology (LCCP), Singapore Economic Development Board (EDB) and regional partners.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced data science or data engineering professional who enjoys working at the intersection of technology, AI, healthcare and clinical research.

What You Will Do

Digital Health & Technical Leadership

  • Act as the Singapore-based technical representative for Digital Health data engineering and data science activities.

  • Collaborate with LCCP, EDB, local partners and global Digital Health teams.

  • Coordinate regional data science and platform initiatives aligned with global innovation strategies.

Data Engineering & Analytics

  • Design and develop scalable data pipelines for wearable sensors, time-series data, and clinical research datasets.

  • Build data ingestion, transformation, and delivery solutions across the data lifecycle.

  • Establish data quality, monitoring, and validation processes to ensure reliable, trial-ready datasets.

  • Optimize data workflows for performance, scalability and reliability.

AI & Algorithm Development

  • Develop machine learning and deep learning algorithms to generate meaningful digital health measures such as activity and sleep.

  • Work with data from wearable and biosensor technologies, including accelerometry, EEG and PPG.

  • Validate models using internal and partner datasets to support clinical applications.

  • Contribute to the integration of AI capabilities, including Large Language Models (LLMs), into cloud-based digital health platforms.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with teams across Sensor Lab, Clinical Operations, Biomedical Engineering, and Product.

  • Translate complex technical and scientific requirements into practical, scalable solutions.

  • Contribute to digital health platform roadmaps and clinical trial design.

  • Communicate technical insights effectively to both technical and clinical/business stakeholders.

What We’re Looking For

  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Informatics or a related discipline.

  • At least 5 years of relevant industry experience in data engineering, data science, analytics and/or algorithm development.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Python, R, SQL and cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.

  • Experience with large-scale data processing, machine learning and/or AI development.

  • Strong project management and collaboration skills, with experience working across geographically distributed teams.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into meaningful business and clinical outcomes.

Interested?

If you are passionate about AI, data science, and healthcare innovation and are looking for an opportunity to apply your technical expertise to meaningful clinical applications, we would like to hear from you.

Apply now and take your next step in Digital Health innovation.

We regret to inform only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Applicants who do not possess necessary experience or qualification will still be considered on individual merits and may be contacted for other opportunities

title: Business Analyst Intern (6 months) - 2027
description:
There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.

At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates,
twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the
moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or
services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and
connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact.
You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to
operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and
launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore
across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and
discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment
designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the
world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll
build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed,
while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

Key job responsibilities
You will test your analytical and technical skills. This internship is a learning opportunity, where you will put your skills and bias for action to the test, to complete a project that will support your own growth in the Business Analysis function, as well as the team and our customers' success.

Partner with multiple teams across different geographies, building collaborative relationships while learning from experienced professionals in a global business environment.

Take ownership of data analysis projects with guidance from mentors, turning data insights into actionable business recommendations.

Identify and propose process improvement opportunities, working with the team to develop streamlined solutions that enhance business efficiency.

Lead root cause analyses for assigned projects, collaborating with team members to solve real business challenges and implement solutions.

Support the development of business cases for new programs, gaining hands-on experience in strategic planning and project development.

Own the maintenance and improvement of specific performance metrics dashboards, while learning advanced visualization techniques from experienced analysts.

Develop into a valued team member by bringing fresh perspectives and innovative ideas, while building foundation skills in business analysis.

A day in the life
Location: Berlin
Start Date: Flexible between January - March 2027. We don't offer 2026 start dates.
Duration: 6 months minimum
This is not a remote internship opportunity

Every day is different as a Business Analyst Intern. You'll work alongside experienced analysts and a dedicated mentor on real data analysis projects that directly impact business efficiency. You might spend your morning diving into datasets to perform a root cause analysis on an operational challenge, then spend your afternoon building and refining a performance metrics dashboard to track key business outcomes. You will partner with teams across different geographies, present data-driven recommendations, and contribute fresh perspectives to solve real business problems.

Amazon is a data-driven business, so no matter which project you own, part of your role will involve turning raw data into actionable insights. You'll identify process improvement opportunities, support the development of business cases for new programs, and present your findings to senior stakeholders — building your analytical, technical, and strategic thinking skills in a fast-paced, global environment.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.

About the team
Intern Community:

As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a dynamic, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.



Support:

The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.



Learning Sessions:

Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's industry-leading learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.



Opportunities:

Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.

title: Verzorgende IG flexpool
description:
Wat ga je doen?
Als Verzorgende IG in de flexpool werk je op verschillende locaties, afdelingen en met verschillende doelgroepen binnen BrabantZorg. Je helpt daar waar jouw inzet nodig is en draagt bij aan goede zorg voor onze cliënten.

De zorg gaat 24/7 door en de behoefte aan medewerkers verschilt per locatie en moment. Daarom verwachten we van jou dat je flexibel inzetbaar bent. Je werkt niet alleen overdag, maar bent ook beschikbaar voor diensten in de avonden, weekenden en op feestdagen. Daarnaast kan het nodig zijn dat je op verschillende locaties of afdelingen werkt, afhankelijk van waar de zorgbehoefte het grootst is.

Binnen die kaders heb je zelf invloed op je planning. Via ons roostersysteem InPlanning zie je de openstaande diensten en schrijf je jezelf in op beschikbare diensten. Je bent zelf verantwoordelijk voor het plannen van voldoende uren binnen je contract.

Zo is jouw dag ‘Elke dag zo fijn mogelijk’:

  • Je werkt op verschillende afdelingen met verschillende doelgroepen;

  • Je ondersteunt, begeleidt en verzorgt cliënten met ‘echte’ aandacht;

  • Je hebt invloed op je eigen planning;

  • Je draagt bij waar jouw inzet het hardst nodig is.

Voor de flexpool werken we met een contract van 0 tot 28 uur per week.

Soms is er een periodieke hulpvraag. Dit houdt in dat je de mogelijkheid krijgt om een periode-opdracht van minimaal vier weken tot maximaal zes maanden uit te voeren op één afdeling en/of locatie. Dit gaat altijd in overleg.

Wat krijg je van ons?

title: IT Asset Deployment and Recovery Officer
description:
Overview

IT Asset Deployment and Recovery Officer | Full-Time | Brighton

Change Grow Live are a charity dedicated to the belief that we can make a difference to our Service Users lives, offering support and respect in a safe environment, treating each user as an individual and working with them to find the right treatment and care options.

Our core values are ‘Be open, be compassionate and be bold’ and our team members apply these daily to achieve our mission of helping people change the direction of their lives, grow as individuals, and live life to its full potential.

Our Digital and IT team supports more than 6,500 colleagues and volunteers across over 180 locations nationally.

We are recruiting for an IT Asset Deployment and Recovery Officer to join our on-site Assets team in Brighton.

This role is key to ensuring colleagues receive the equipment they need while maintaining accurate asset records throughout the lifecycle of our IT equipment. You'll play an important part in supporting asset deployment, returns, recovery activity and stock management, helping to improve compliance, reduce costs and deliver an excellent experience for our colleagues and volunteers.

We're looking for someone who is highly organised, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities in a busy environment. You'll have the opportunity to work closely with Service Desk, Asset Engineers and wider Digital and IT teams, contributing to the effective management of thousands of IT assets across the organisation.

Location: Brighton (site-based)

Contract Type: Permanent

Hours: Full-time, 37.5 per week

Responsibilities

We are currently seeking an organised and motivated individual to join our team as an IT Asset Deployment and Recovery Officer. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting the deployment, tracking, recovery and lifecycle management of IT equipment across the organisation, ensuring assets are accurately recorded, effectively managed and available when required.

The ideal candidate will possess the following qualifications and experience:

  • Experience maintaining accurate asset, deployment, recovery or stock records within an ITSM, ITAM, inventory, finance or stock management system.
  • Strong attention to detail and an understanding of the importance of accurate asset management, stock control and compliance processes.
  • Experience using Microsoft Excel to interpret, analyse and manipulate data.
  • Experience using ITSM, ITAM, inventory or stock management systems to manage requests, returns, compliance activity and asset records.
  • Good organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, track outstanding actions and maintain accurate records.
  • Ability to support equipment deployment, recovery, stock movement and inventory management activities in a structured and efficient manner.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to liaise effectively with colleagues, managers, suppliers and technical teams.
  • Ability to follow agreed processes and procedures relating to purchasing, stock control, compliance and data quality.
  • Experience producing documentation, procedures and supporting guidance material.
  • Ability to work independently, use initiative and identify opportunities to improve existing processes.
  • Experience of Microsoft Intune, familiarity with ITIL processes or knowledge of ISO27001 standards would be advantageous.

What We Offer

  • Enjoy a dedicated weekly Wellness Hour, access to our Wellness Hub, and a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme to support your mental and emotional health.
  • We’re committed to your development, with extensive training, funded learning, and pathways into senior or specialist roles.
  • Benefit from transparent pay, a contributory pension scheme, and additional support through our wellbeing resources.
  • Start with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays(pro rata), increasing to the maximum 30 days over five years of service.
  • Join a supportive, values-led team where you’ll feel encouraged and valued from your very first day.
  • Where possible, we’re open to discussing working patterns that help you maintain a healthy work–life balance.
  • Enjoy discounts on shopping, cinema trips, holidays and more, along with our Refer a Friend scheme.

Please read attached Job Description for a more detailed out line of responsibilities and Person Specifications

If you are a proactive, organised and detail-focused professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in delivering a high-quality service, we would love to hear from you. Join our team and help ensure the effective deployment, recovery and management of IT equipment that supports colleagues and volunteers across the organisation.

If this sounds like you and you would like to begin your journey with Change Grow Live, then we would love to talk to you.

A note about using AI in your application

AI can be a really helpful tool when putting together your application, and we're happy for you to use it. However, what we're most interested in is you.

We want to understand your experiences, achievements and strengths, so please make sure your application reflects your own story and clearly shows how you meet the essential criteria and the impact you've made in previous roles.

There's no need to write in a particular style. The strongest applications are those that are authentic, specific and clearly demonstrate your skills, experience and potential. We look forward to learning more about you.

Direct applications only we will not be engaging agencies for this vacancy.

Please note: This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK at the time of application. For applicants with time-limited visas, unfortunately, we are unable to support new visa applications or extensions. More information about eligible roles and occupations can be found here: Skilled Worker visa: Overview - GOV.UK

We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if we receive a high number of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Full-time hours at Change Grow Live are 37.5 hours per week. For part-time roles, the salary and payments will be pro rata based on contracted hours.

Salary Range (pro rata if part time)

CGL points 20 to 21 (£26,296.03 - £27,165.10)

ILW / OLW /Fringe

N/A - Outside London Weighting Area

Closing Date

18/10/2026

If you have any questions on this opportunity that you would like to talk through please contact us using the below details:

Emily May | emily.may@cgl.org.uk

This post is subject to a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) Scheme check at a basic level.
